Filter lampiran berdasarkan nama file: Audit mendalam Rev 2.9 — arsip 30 Oktober 2026, 18:47

Keputusan: revisi memberikan kemajuan nyata, tetapi ZIP asli belum lulus build dan belum dapat dinyatakan siap demo end-to-end. Fokus penilaian tetap paket Ethernet 2.000 byte → DATA 1.900 + 100 byte, IDLE dan MGMT. Dukungan MTU 9.000 atau 16.000 byte bukan syarat dalam keputusan ini.

Pengujian telah dijalankan, bukan hanya menilai ringkasan perubahan. Source asli tidak diubah. Pada beberapa eksperimen, salinan diagnostik memperbaiki sintaks IDLE atau nama port RX untuk membuka pengujian fungsi berikutnya; hasil ini diberi label DIAGNOSTIK, bukan PASS ZIP asli. Simulasi tidak dapat menjamin “tidak ada bug” di semua kondisi.

Status PASS hanya berlaku pada konfigurasi dan oracle yang disebut.

Tidak ada bukti modem lengkap empat frame telah lulus end-to-end pada ZIP ini: top masih terhalang, vendor IP tidak disimulasikan lengkap. Lulus unit payload atau reassembly setelah patch tidak boleh diubah menjadi klaim lulus top.

3. Temuan prioritas dan reproducer

C-A001 — Sintaks IDLE menghalangi kompilasi Icarus

Prioritas: P0/build. ORIGINAL. fso_idle_generator.v:193, fso_idle_generator.v:204, fso_idle_generator.v:216 memuat bentuk step_prbs25_32(...)[31:0]. Icarus 12.0 -g2012 memberikan syntax error/Malformed statement pada ketiga lokasi. Ini terpisah dari masalah pustaka Xilinx.

Runner yang memasukkan semua RTL ke setiap TB menghasilkan 28/28 compile-blocked oleh akar masalah yang sama. Bukan berarti 28 modul rusak. Unit dengan filelist terpilih tetap dapat diuji. Pada salinan diagnostik, part-select dilepas karena tujuan assignment sudah 32 bit (low-bit truncation); alternatif produksi yang lebih eksplisit adalah wire temporer 57 bit lalu pilih [31:0]. Hasil vendor compiler belum diperiksa; jangan menyatakan Vivado pasti gagal atau pasti menerima.

Setelah patch sintaks saja: 16 dari 28 TB berhasil compile dan selesai dengan exit 0; 12 tetap blocked, termasuk RX port error dan dependensi vendor/legacy. Exit 0 bukan otomatis semua assertion bermakna PASS. Log setiap TB tersedia.

B02 — Port reassembly belum pulih seluruhnya

Prioritas: P0/build. STATIC + elaborasi terarah. ethernet_frame_reassembly.v:303 masih menghubungkan .m_axis_tdata, .m_axis_tvalid, .m_axis_tlast, .m_axis_tready pada u_mux_eth_32. Deklarasi mux_eth_32.v:24 menyediakan eth_data_out, eth_valid_out, eth_last_out, dan tidak memiliki ready.

Perubahan preamble helper sudah benar. Perubahan TX payload mux B01 juga terlihat sesuai deklarasi; jumlah named-port error top turun dari 41 historis menjadi 4 setelah sintaks IDLE diisolasi. Pengujian top ini memakai -i agar unknown vendor modules tidak menutupi named-port error: hanya bukti struktur, bukan simulasi fungsi top.

Arah revisi: gunakan API nyata atau ubah API helper secara konsisten. Jangan menambahkan pin ready pada caller tanpa mengubah pipeline helper. Perbaikan nama port saja membuka masalah berikut.

C-A002 — Drain reassembly tidak tahan backpressure

Prioritas: P1/robustness demo. DIAGNOSTIK: hanya port RX diselaraskan. ethernet_frame_reassembly.v:249 dan blok drain sampai instansiasi mux menggunakan m_axis_eth_tready untuk menyalakan asm_valid_in. Sementara pipeline dua tahap mux_eth_32 selalu bergeser dan mendeteksi setiap kenaikan valid sebagai awal preamble.

Saat ready turun, data pipeline tetap bergerak. Saat ready naik, valid kembali naik dan preamble disisipkan lagi di tengah paket. TLAST yang tiba saat ready rendah dapat hilang; DR_FLUSH_TAIL tidak mempunyai penyimpanan TLAST yang menunggu acceptance.

Reproducer diag_reassembly_multi_stall.sv: lima paket 2.000, 2.000, 64, 128, 1.516B tanpa reset, ready (cyc % 7 < 4). Expected 1.437 kata/5 TLAST/0 mismatch. Actual 1.020 kata/2 TLAST/506 mismatch, state=2, used=411. Contoh kata output yang seharusnya 01000001 menjadi 55555555 (preamble).

Kontrol pembanding tanpa stall: 1.437/1.437 kata, 5/5 TLAST, 0 mismatch, buffer kosong. Ini mengisolasi masalah pada kontrak stall, bukan ukuran paket jumbo.

Arah revisi: buat pipeline preamble/data elastis dengan ready/valid per tahap atau buffer keluaran yang benar. Freeze data/valid/last sampai handshake. Jika demo hanya mengizinkan ready selalu 1, batas itu harus eksplisit dan dibuktikan pada koneksi top; antarmuka tidak boleh tetap diklaim AXI-Stream tahan stall.

B06 / C-A003 — Rollback ada, tetapi orphan continuation bisa menjadi paket palsu

Prioritas: P1/recovery frame hilang. PARSER-ONLY, ORIGINAL. ethernet_frame_reassembly.v:158 membatalkan paket saat sequence gap, tetapi tetap mengaktifkan fso_frame_valid_magic. Setelah pkt_active=0, pencarian CDEF menerima header di data continuation yang sebenarnya milik paket yang telah dibuang.

Stimulus: frame DATA seq0 berisi header panjang 2.000 dan 1.900B data; seq1 hilang; seq2 datang dengan continuation length=100. Kata pertama continuation sengaja bernilai CDEF0040, diikuti data biasa. Expected tidak ada paket dari potongan tersebut. Actual commit=1, buffered=16 kata, menghasilkan paket palsu 64B.

parser_gap_false_header_fullframe.sv mengulangi dengan frame lengkap 477 kata; hasil tetap gagal. Payload dapat mengandung CDEF secara sah, sehingga pencarian magic tanpa batas posisi bukan cara reassembly yang aman. Standar §2.6.3.7.7 mengharuskan partial packet dibuang dan pengenalan header berikutnya mengikuti batas partial packet, bukan kebetulan pola bit.

Arah revisi: lacak jumlah byte continuation yang harus dilewati/dibuang setelah gap, atau discard sesuai aturan frame yang dipilih dari standar; jangan mengizinkan header detection di tengah orphan data. Kasus sederhana B06 dengan data AAAA... sekarang lulus, tetapi temuan belum tertutup menyeluruh.

C-A004 — Continuation length tidak diperiksa konsistensinya

Prioritas: P1/validasi reassembly. PARSER-ONLY, ORIGINAL. ethernet_frame_reassembly.v:168 menimpa rem_pkt_bytes dengan pld_hdr_len tanpa memeriksa apakah sesuai sisa paket yang diketahui.

Reproducer: header paket 2.000B, segmen pertama 1.900B, continuation seq1 menyatakan 64B, padahal sisa seharusnya 100B. Expected reject/rollback paket tidak konsisten; actual commit=1 dengan 491 kata = 1.964B, sementara target paket tetap 2.000B. Versi frame penuh juga menghasilkan kondisi yang sama.

Ini uji input malformed, bukan tuduhan trafik normal selalu salah. Reassembly normatif tetap perlu menolak length yang tidak konsisten; CRC yang valid hanya membuktikan bit frame sesuai CRC, bukan semantik panjang benar.

B11 / C-A005 — Pending delete dapat ditimpa ACK berikutnya

Prioritas: P1/ARQ concurrency. ORIGINAL. Kasus ACK0 bersamaan RETX16 sekarang sudah membaik: setelah downstream memperoleh cukup clock, tag0 terhapus dan tag17 tetap valid (slot_tag_valid=0002). Log lama yang memeriksa terlalu dini tidak boleh dijadikan bukti kegagalan revisi.

Namun pada arq_tx_controller.v:323, pending delete dikirim lalu pending_del_valid dibersihkan. Pada siklus yang sama blok ACK arq_tx_controller.v:349 dapat menulis ulang ddr4_addr dan ddr4_delete_req. Assignment terakhir menang, sehingga delete pertama hilang.

Reproducer arq_delete_two_acks.sv: DATA0 dan DATA16 memakai slot berbeda; ACK0 datang saat RETX16; ACK16 datang ketika pending delete0 dikeluarkan. Setelah lima clock tambahan, expected kedua tag sudah bebas (0000); actual 0001, tag0 tertinggal. Kasus ini memakai controller dan wrapper aktual, bukan pemaksaan isi CAM.

Arah revisi: arbitrasi satu operasi bus per siklus; dequeue lama hanya ketika operasinya benar-benar dipilih, simpan permintaan baru. Pertimbangkan collision dengan max-retry drop juga, karena blok itu turut menulis alamat. Antrean satu entri dapat memadai hanya dengan kontrak penerimaan/backpressure yang jelas; komentar “tunda satu siklus” tidak menjamin semua overlap tertangani.

B13 — Timer otonom ada, tetapi satu tick bukan satu frame optik

Prioritas: P1/parameter waktu; pemulihan unit membaik. ORIGINAL + STATIC. arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper.v:211 menganggap WORDS_PER_FRAME=477 clock sebagai satu tick. Pengukuran reorder_timer_measure.sv menunjukkan gap tick 477 siklus. Blok :314 juga mengulang hitungan dari nol ketika ram_wr_en, dan nd_seq_adv turut menambah counter terpisah dari tick otonom.

Notasi titik pada kolom ns adalah pemisah ribuan. Jalur reorder berada pada clk_gth RX (sda_decoder/top), sedangkan XCI GTH menunjukkan 322,265625 MHz. Pada clock tersebut timer menghitung terlalu cepat jika tick dianggap frame duration. Reset timer oleh write dan gabungan nd_seq_adv juga membuat waktu tunggu tergantung trafik, bukan semata waktu berlalu.

Kasus tanpa IDLE kini berhasil mengeluarkan DATA1 dan DATA3: 954 kata, 2 TLAST, 0 mismatch. Jadi recovery fungsional membaik, tetapi pemetaan holdoff ke tabel standar belum terbukti benar. Default expiry adalah HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC * (ARQ_MAX_RETX+1); pisahkan kebijakan retry dari satuan tick.

Arah revisi: gunakan frame-time tick yang diturunkan dari clock aktual (fractional accumulator bila perlu), atau event frame yang definisinya tepat. Jangan menghitung event non-DATA dan tick waktu dua kali. Parameter waktu hardware harus mencapai top; SIM scaling diuji sebagai konfigurasi terpisah.

B14 — Antrean CDC empat entri memperbaiki burst pendek, belum FIFO asinkron aman

Prioritas: P1/hardware CDC; overflow adalah stress tambahan. sda_encoder.v:100 dan seterusnya masih memakai posedge arq_valid_clean/peer-valid sebagai clock. Write pointer biner tiga bit disinkronkan dua tahap; seluruh bus data 64 bit juga disinkronkan sebagai vektor. Tidak ada Gray pointer, sinkronisasi read pointer kembali, pemeriksaan full, ataupun mekanisme producer backpressure.

Hasil CDC-local dengan reset yang benar:

Burst 5/8 event tersebut melampaui kapasitas empat entri dan bukan profil ACK per frame demo normal. Hasilnya membuktikan tidak ada proteksi overflow, bukan bahwa setiap trafik normal kehilangan event. Secara terpisah, sinkronisasi pointer biner/bus multi-bit bukan bukti capture atomik di silikon. Simulasi RTL tanpa metastability tidak dapat menutup risiko tersebut.

Arah revisi: bila dibutuhkan lintas clock riil, gunakan asynchronous FIFO dengan Gray pointer/full-empty dan reset yang benar, atau mailbox handshake dengan kontrak jarak event yang dibuktikan. Cocokkan port clock sumber, jangan hanya mengganti nama menjadi queue/coherent.

B15 — Data IDLE tetap berganti pada edge penerimaan setelah stall

Prioritas: P1/kontrak stream. DIAGNOSTIK sintaks saja. fso_idle_generator.v:160 membuat need_live_reseed bergantung pada ready, dan :165 memilih data live baru. Selama ready=0, data memang stabil. Tetapi ketika ready kembali 1, transaksi yang sebelumnya sudah valid langsung diganti.

Log diag_idle_accept_stability_fixed_harness.sv:

IDLE_STALL valid_before=1 valid_after_seed=1
  data_before=80000040 data_after=80000040
IDLE_ACCEPT held=80000040 accepted=40000020 valid=1 mismatch=1

Syarat stabilitas mencakup edge acceptance, bukan hanya siklus saat ready rendah. Tidak ada protokol cancel di antarmuka ini. Jika seed baru harus berlaku pada frame baru, jangan menawarkan Word0 valid sebelum seed final dikunci; alternatifnya simpan frame/seed yang sudah ditawarkan sampai selesai.

C-A006 — Jalur direct reseed IDLE memerlukan kontrak awal/akhir yang lebih tegas

Prioritas: robustness; DIAGNOSTIK. need_live_reseed tidak mensyaratkan m_axis_tvalid, tetapi cabangnya memperbarui index dan CRC seolah Word0 sudah diterima. Saat TXFN=1 sejak awal dan ready sudah aktif sebelum valid muncul, frame pertama gagal oracle. Dua frame berikutnya dengan seed tetap itu lulus.

Kasus lain: prefetch pada TXFN0, lalu pilih TXFN1 dan biarkan ready mengalir terus tiga frame dengan TXFN tetap. Frame pertama benar; perpindahan direct-mode kembali FIFO menghasilkan penyimpangan panjang/PRBS/CRC pada frame berikutnya. Ini pengujian kontrak generator kontinu dengan seed tetap, bukan profil scheduler yang selalu mengganti TXFN tiap frame.

Kontrol penting: prefetch lalu TXFN berubah 1→2→3 pada batas frame menghasilkan 3 × 478 kata, 0 error dengan stall periodik. Jadi jangan menyimpulkan seluruh IDLE rusak. B16 jalur normal PRBS→CRC→FIFO telah dipulihkan dan TB lama kini bisa mengamati sinyal nyata setelah sintaks diperbaiki.

Arah revisi: transisi berdasarkan handshake nyata; keluar direct mode tidak boleh menyodorkan Word0 ekstra sebelum FIFO baru siap. Lebih sederhana bila hanya ada satu jalur state PRBS/CRC yang konsisten dan seed dilatch saat start frame yang sah.

5. Data in/out, byte counter dan waktu

Jalur data dan ukuran yang boleh dibandingkan

Ingress XGMII menghapus kontrol/preprocessing sesuai parser lalu segmenter memberi metadata panjang14bit. Payload DATA pertama menggunakan header FSO4B + packet header4B + Ethernet maksimum1900B =1908B informasi. CRC4B membuat1912B, dipecah menjadi8×239B sebelum RS menjadi2040B. LPC mengubah menjadi3060B. Header14B+CRC2B melaluiRS32B laluLPC48B; preamble9B ditambahkan. Total3117B=24936bit.

Untuk packet2000B, frameDATA pertama membawa1900B dan frame kedua100B ditambah padding yang berada setelah akhir paket. Continuation penuh di tengah paket sekarang menggunakan1904B, bukan1900B+padding. Nomor sequence10bit pada payload DATA berbeda dari TXFN16bit ARQ semua frame; kedua counter tidak boleh dicampur.

Oracle TX membaca trace actual source, menghitung CRC secara independen dan menggabungkan bytes menurut layout standar. 14 ukuran diuji (1320..1327,2000,3804,4096,7200,7204,8192); semua menghasilkan byte/continuation-header/CRC mismatch0. Ukuran besar hanya regression B03, bukan penambahan syarat proyek. Roundtrip setelah port patch diuji12 ukuran64..7200; panjang nonkelipatan4 hanya menunjukkan reassembly mengembalikan valid bytes, bukan egress formatter mengeluarkan /T/ pada lane byte yang tepat.

Counter B21

original_backend_bytes.sv memakai stimulus2008B (preamble8 + MAC2000) seperti TB backend. Hasil packet=1 last_MAC_bytes=2000. Source memisahkan counter slot aktif, byte data per lane, dan jumlah/T/. Nilai counter sementara direset saat idle; gunakan register snapshot last_eth_data_byte_cnt setelah paket selesai, bukan mengira dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt adalah akumulator permanen.

Stimulus TB menyebut FCS dummy DEADBEEF. Byte count benar tidak membuktikan FCS Ethernet valid untuk NIC. L2 di sini adalah2000B yang disajikan TB, bukan otomatis2000B payload IP/UDP. Reassembly502kata termasuk8B preamble; burstXGMII503slot32bit =2012B termasuk slot/T/. Penghitung16bit mempunyai rollover65536; interpretasi per-paket/cumulative harus jelas. Untuk panjang65/66/67B, egress tanpa keep masih batas yang diketahui.

Durasi dan kapasitas

24936bit/10Gbps=2493,6ns. Pada200MHz perlu498,72cycle rata-rata; ideal CDC1 diuji25interval dengan total12468cycle dan rata-rata2493,6ns. Ini model FIFO ideal, bukan bukti clockvendor berjalan benar. CDC3 ideal nonempty juga menghasilkan3906read selama10000cycle, maxgap3.

Pada312,5MHz periodeframe=779,25cycle;780cycle tetap menghasilkan2496ns. Pada322,265625MHz periodeframe=803,6015625cycle. Komentar “312.5MHz” tidak mengalahkan konfigurasiXCI322,265625MHz. Pisahkan clock MAC, clock gearbox, valid scheduling, frame tick, dan clock200MHz baseband.

Kapasitas informasi ideal1908/3117×10Gbps≈6,12127Gbps; kapasitas1900B≈6,09560Gbps. Packet2000 yang memerlukan2frame≈3,20821Gbps sebelum tambahan kebijakan interleaving. Istilah10G-to-10G merujuk antarmuka, bukan jaminan menerima trafik10Gbps tanpa henti. Backpressure internal tidak otomatis menghentikan Ethernet ingress fisik; flow control/buffer sizing perlu bukti terpisah.

64B/66B gearbox tidak sendirian menjamin DC balance. Perlu menelusuri scrambling/line code nyata; tunnel64B66B tidak otomatis sama dengan native optical waveform SDA. OCXO/GNSS tidak ditambahkan sebagai kewajiban; fieldtimestamp statis tetap harus dilaporkan sebagai statis.

Bukti FEC kuat untuk regresi ini; tidak perlu mengubah modul FEC hanya karena build IDLE/RX gagal. Namun “100% aman” melampaui cakupan. RS hanya dijamin mengoreksi sampai8simbol percodeword; error lebih banyak tidak wajib selalu terdeteksi decoder, dan CRC/ARQ punya tugas tersendiri. LPC modeOFF tidak menguji active-disparityON. BRAMmodel tidak membuktikan latency/IP vendor/implementasi hardware.

7. Audit harness: hasil mentah yang tidak boleh disalahartikan


28 TB compile-blocked awal berasal dari satu file syntax; bukan 28 bug fungsi. Setelah patch sintaks saja, 16 berhasil compile dan selesai dengan exit 0, sementara 12 terhalang. Sebelas terkait dependensi vendor/legacy; satu TB reassembly mempunyai empat port error. Vendor block pada top dapat menutupi error port sampai -i dipakai.

Scoreboard reorder lama mengharapkan DATA1,2,3 ketika DATA2 memang hilang atau merupakan IDLE. Oracle dikoreksi menjadi DATA1,3; hasil 954 kata, 2 TLAST, 0 mismatch. Jangan mengutip 477 mismatch dari oracle lama sebagai bug reorder baru.

Reset CDC pada harness awal tidak memberikan edge reset yang memadai bagi register ber-clock valid. Tes final memulai reset 1→0, menahan, kemudian melepas dengan benar. Hasil captured=0 dari harness lama bukan verdict RTL.

Pemeriksaan delete lama terlalu dini. Menunggu downstream lima clock menutup kasus collision tunggal. Kasus dua ACK tetap gagal setelah waktu tunggu cukup.

Parser-tail TB posisional lama memiliki jumlah port salah. Gunakan named-port parser_tail_keep; hasil 13 byte termasuk preamble benar. Ini bukan bug RTL.

Driver rs_extended tanpa argumen sempat gagal. Dijalankan ulang eksplisit dengan argumen 16 dan 239; hasil 372/595 kasus lulus. Exit driver lama bukan kegagalan decoder.

Drain metadata/jumbo memerlukan waktu cukup; trace final memakai 7.000 siklus. Descriptor test pendek belum menguras 30.400 kata; pengujian yang menunggu pengurasan selesai lulus.

Framer satu segmen: scheduler terus menghasilkan IDLE setelah DATA. frame_busy=1 pada akhir test bukan otomatis deadlock jika jumlah payload frame terus bertambah. Log diagnostik menunjukkan 31 payload frame/32 trigger; busy pada akhir simulasi tidak cukup sebagai verdict.

Oracle IDLE menghitung output bit dari sr[0] sebelum shift, feedback sr[0]^sr[3]. Hasil per frame disertakan agar transisi tidak tertutupi total count. Stub kosong tidak digunakan sebagai bukti FEC/full modem.

Eksperimen sementara, log compile-fail dan script dengan path lingkungan tetap disimpan untuk transparansi. Gunakan reproduce_1847.py dan tests.json sebagai indeks reproduksi terkurasi, bukan menganggap semua script lama sebagai verdict final.


8. Revisi yang disarankan sekarang

Paket minimum agar demo dapat diverifikasi kembali:


fso_idle_generator.v: perbaiki sintaks; kunci seed sebelum menawarkan valid; update state hanya pada handshake; uji held beat sampai acceptance. Audit jalur direct/FIFO dengan seed awal dan pergantian frame.

ethernet_frame_reassembly.v dan kemungkinan mux_eth_32.v: cocokkan port aktual; buat drain/preamble/tail tahan stall jika kontrak ready dipertahankan. Batasi header detection setelah gap dan validasi continuation length.

arq_tx_controller.v: arbitrasi pending delete, ACK baru dan drop agar tidak ada operasi hilang. Verifikasi dengan wrapper aktual sampai tag benar-benar bebas.

arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper.v: definisikan tick waktu frame berdasarkan clock aktual dan hindari double-count/reset oleh trafik yang mengubah holdoff tanpa sengaja.

sda_encoder.v: sebelum mengklaim CDC hardware aman, gunakan antrean asinkron/handshake yang terdefinisi, kebijakan full/overflow, dan reset tiap domain. Burst di luar kapasitas boleh dibatasi, tetapi batasnya harus tertulis.


Jangan memaksakan “tetap 8 file” atau “hanya 11 file”: bila kontrak helper perlu berubah, file helper harus ikut direvisi. Sebaliknya, jangan memperluas ke GNSS, MTU 16.000, atau redesign FEC hanya demi menutup scope demo.

Setelah revisi, urutan penerimaan: build asli → demo 2.000B/IDLE/MGMT aktual → exact byte dan CRC → multi-paket tanpa reset → stall/concurrency/error recovery → regresi FEC. Auditor dapat membuat TB tambahan; pengguna tidak perlu menulis semua TB baru.

9. Paket sinkronisasi auditor

Master prompt PDF terpisah berisi konteks terbaru, scope, timeline, B01-B24, setup Icarus/Python, format JSON dan protokol rekonsiliasi. Tidak ada sinkronisasi memori otomatis antar-akun. Pertukarkan hash ZIP, laporan dan evidence. Jika teman memakai ZIP berbeda atau patch diagnostik, bedakan hasilnya sebelum menyatakan konflik.

Paket bukti pada lampiran berisi manifest.json, findings.json, tracking.json, tests.json, handoff.md, README_REPRODUCE.md, reproduce_1847.py, source asli, model, TB, log, diff dan patch diagnostik. MATCH pada runner berarti hasil audit dapat direproduksi, termasuk counterexample yang memang FAIL; bukan berarti RTL semuanya lulus. Delapan kasus default runner telah diulang dan seluruh observasi cocok.

Batas kesimpulan: baseline ini memiliki kemajuan terukur pada layout payload, parser dasar, pencocokan ARQ, reorder, burst CDC pendek dan counter. Penghalang build dan beberapa masalah kontrak data masih nyata. Klaim kesiapan hardware, interoperabilitas native, atau zero-bug belum dapat diberikan dari bukti ini.

    2 # Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    3 # Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    4 # File Name    : setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
    5 # Description  : Unified Auto-Grouping Waveform Script for All 25 Testbenches
    6 #                in the SDA OISL 10G-to-10G Optical Communication Project.
    7 #                - Keeps standard default Vivado waveform colors.
    8 #                - Automatically sets Radix (unsigned for counters/indices,
    9 #                  ascii for string tags, hex for data/header/CRC buses).
   10 #
   11 # Revision History:
   12 #   - Rev 1.0 (2026-10-27) : Initial 25-testbench auto-grouping Tcl dispatcher.
   13 #   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : Synchronized all 25 testbench waveform
   14 #     groups to include unified frame_id, frame_type_str ("DAT1", "DAT2", 
   15 #     "IDLE", "MGMT"), in_clk_cnt, in_byte_cnt, out_clk_cnt, out_byte_cnt, 
   16 #     and scoreboard telemetry counters.
   17 #
   18 # Usage        : In Vivado Tcl Console (while any simulation is open), run:
   19 #                  source setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
   20 # ==============================================================================
   21 
   22 # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   23 # HELPER PROCEDURE: Safely adds a list of signals into a collapsible Wave Group
   24 #                   with automatic Radix formatting and default Vivado colors.
   25 # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   26 proc add_grp_sigs {grp_title top_scope sig_list} {
   27     set grp_obj [add_wave_group $grp_title]
   28     foreach s $sig_list {
   29         set full_path "/${top_scope}/${s}"
   30         set obj [get_objects -quiet $full_path]
   31         if {[llength $obj] > 0} {
   32             set w [add_wave -into $grp_obj $obj]
   33             set s_low [string tolower $s]
   34             # Auto-select Radix based on signal name convention (colors untouched)
   35             if {[string match "*_str*" $s_low] || [string match "*ascii*" $s_low]} {
   36                 set_property radix ascii $w
   37             } elseif {[string match "time_*" $s_low] || [string match "oisl_*" $s_low] || [string match "measured_*" $s_low]} {
   38                 # Real/floating-point metric signals keep default real format
   39             } elseif {[string match "*_cnt*" $s_low] || [string match "*_idx*" $s_low] || \
   40                       [string match "*_index*" $s_low] || [string match "*_bytes*" $s_low] || \
   41                       [string match "*_words*" $s_low] || [string match "*frame_id*" $s_low] || \
   42                       [string match "*_size*" $s_low] || [string match "*_disp*" $s_low] || \
   43                       [string match "*repaired*" $s_low] || [string match "*_pass_*" $s_low] || \
   44                       [string match "*_ok_*" $s_low] || [string match "*_err_*" $s_low] || \
   45                       [string match "*tracker*" $s_low] || [string match "*scenario_id*" $s_low] || \
   46                       [string match "*_sequence*" $s_low] || [string match "*_tod_*" $s_low] || \
   47                       [string match "*_sec*" $s_low] || [string match "*_picosec*" $s_low] || \
   48                       [string match "*_acc*" $s_low]} {
   49                 set_property radix unsigned $w
   50             } else {
   51                 catch {set_property radix hex $w}
   52             }
   53         }
   54     }
   55 }
   56 
   57 # ==============================================================================
   58 # 1. tb_fso_header_top (4 Frames: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)
   59 # ==============================================================================
   60 proc wave_tb_fso_header_top {} {

   62     add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_and_Frame_ID" $t {clk rst_n frame_id frame_type_str scenario_id trigger_header_gen system_busy}
   63     add_grp_sigs "2_Table_2_9_Header_Inputs" $t {txfn_in rxfn_in ack_in ack_valid_in frame_type_in tx_ts_in tod_seconds_in ts_applies_in fcch_opcode_in fcch_pl_in}
   64     add_grp_sigs "3_Serialized_16B_Header_and_CRC16_Out" $t {final_header_valid final_header_byte byte_tracker out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt total_hdr_bytes error_cnt}
   65 }

   73     add_grp_sigs "2_FrontEnd_1900B_Segmenter" $t {seg_tvalid seg_tdata seg_tlast seg_tready seg_valid_bytes in_clk_cnt in_byte_cnt}

   75     add_grp_sigs "4_ARQ_DDR4_Sniffer_and_Retx" $t {ddr4_write_req ddr4_read_req ddr4_delete_req ddr4_addr retx_data_tvalid retx_data_tdata retx_data_tlast retx_word_cnt retx_last_word_crc32}

    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 Module Name  : FEC_Demux
    7 Description  : Receiver Baseband FEC Demultiplexer (2072B -> 32B RS Header + 
    8                2040B RS Payload).
    9                - Receives 259 contiguous 64-bit descrambled words (2072 Bytes) 
   10                  per frame from descrambler.v at 200.0 MHz.
   11                - Buffers the first 4 words (32 Bytes) into hdr_shift_buf and 
   12                  serializes them 1 Byte per cycle (32 cycles) to rs_decoder #(33).
   13                - Routes the remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) directly to the 
   14                  64-bit Payload bus (255 cycles) for rs_decoder_64.
   15                                1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   16                                2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   17 
   18                Revision Notes:
   19                - Added non-intrusive simulation trackers (hdr_out_byte_cnt 1..32,
   20                  pld_out_word_cnt 1..255), clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk, 
   21                  and maintained continuous 4-frame unpacking (8160 bytes across 
   22                  exact 2493.600 ns frame windows) so demux_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   23                - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Waveform Telemetry Counter Restoration]
   24                  Added internal telemetry counters (out_hdr_byte_cnt [1..32], 
   25                  out_pld_word_cnt [1..255], and out_pld_byte_cnt [8..2040]) 
   26                  referenced by tb_FEC_Demux.v and setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl.
   27                - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R03 - Restored 256-Bit Header Serializer & 255-Word Payload Datapath]
   28                  Restored the exact 256-bit 'hdr_shift_buf' serializer and 
   29                  'in_word_cnt' (0..258) state machine from the verified baseline 
   30                  so all 32 Header bytes serialize MSB-first with 0 mismatches and 
   31                  strictly 255 Payload words (2040 Bytes) are emitted per frame 
   32                  without admitting invalid tail words when en == 0.
   33 ===========================================================================
   34 */
   35 
   36 module FEC_Demux (
   37     input  wire        clk,
   38     input  wire        rst_n,
   39     input  wire        en,          // 259 continuous cycles from descrambler
   40     input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // 64-bit descrambled word
   41 
   42     // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles = 32 Bytes)
   43     output reg         header_dv,
   44     output reg  [7:0]  header,
   45 
   46     // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles = 2040 Bytes)
   47     output reg         payload_dv,
   48     output reg  [63:0] payload
   49 );
   50 
   51     reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   52     reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   53     reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_idx;
   54     reg         hdr_serializing;
   55 
   56     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   57         if (!rst_n) begin
   58             in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   59             hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   60             hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
   61             hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   62             header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   63             header          <= 8'd0;
   64             payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   65             payload         <= 64'd0;
   66         end else begin
   67             header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   68             header     <= 8'd0;
   69             payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   70             payload    <= 64'd0;
   71 
   72             // 1. Route first 4 words (32 Bytes) to Header buffer, remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) to Payload
   73             if (en) begin
   74                 if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   75                     case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   76                         2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   77                         2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   78                         2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   79                         2'd3: begin
   80                             hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   81                             hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   82                             hdr_byte_idx        <= 6'd0;
   83                         end
   84                     endcase
   85                     in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   86                 end else begin
   87                     payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   88                     payload    <= data_in;
   89                     if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   90                         in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   91                     else
   92                         in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   93                 end
   94             end else begin
   95                 in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   96             end
   97 
   98             // 2. Serialize 32-Byte RS Header at 1 Byte per clock cycle (MSB-first)
   99             if (hdr_serializing) begin
  100                 header_dv     <= 1'b1;
  101                 header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
  102                 hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
  103 
  104                 if (hdr_byte_idx == 6'd31) begin
  105                     hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
  106                     hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
  107                 end else begin
  108                     hdr_byte_idx <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  109                 end
  110             end
  111         end
  112     end
  113 
  114     // =======================================================
  115     // 3. TELEMETRY & WAVEFORM TRACKERS: HEADER (1..32B) & PAYLOAD (1..2040B)
  116     // =======================================================
  117     reg  [5:0]  hdr_out_byte_cnt; // Counts 1..32 during header_dv
  118     reg  [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt; // Counts 1..255 during payload_dv
  119     wire [5:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = hdr_out_byte_cnt;
  120     wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = pld_out_word_cnt;
  121     wire [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt = {pld_out_word_cnt, 3'b000};
  122 
  123     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  124         if (!rst_n) begin
  125             hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  126             pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  127         end else begin
  128             if (hdr_serializing)
  129                 hdr_out_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  130             else
  131                 hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  132 
  133             if (en && (in_word_cnt >= 9'd4))
  134                 pld_out_word_cnt <= (in_word_cnt - 9'd3);
  135             else
  136                 pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  137         end
  138     end
  139 
  140     // synthesis translate_off
  141     reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  142     integer    pld_wr_ptr;
  143     integer    pld_rd_ptr;
  144     reg        pld_unpack_active;
  145 
  146     reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  147     reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;     // Counts strictly 1 to 2040 per frame
  148     reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  149     reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;  // Counts 1 to 8160 (4 x 2040 Bytes)
  150 
  151     initial begin
  152         pld_wr_ptr        = 0;
  153         pld_rd_ptr        = 0;
  154         pld_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  155         pld_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  156         pld_byte_cnt      = 12'd0;
  157         demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  158         pld_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  159     end
  160 
  161     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  162     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  163         if (!rst_n) begin
  164             pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  165         end else if (payload_dv) begin
  166             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload[63:56];
  167             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload[55:48];
  168             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload[47:40];
  169             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload[39:32];
  170             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 4] = payload[31:24];
  171             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 5] = payload[23:16];
  172             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 6] = payload[15:8];
  173             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 7] = payload[7:0];
  174             pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 8;
  175         end
  176     end
  177 
  178     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (2040 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  179     real next_pld_edge_ns;
  180     always @(posedge clk) begin
  181         if (rst_n && en && (in_word_cnt == 9'd4) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  182             pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  183             #0.001;
  184             next_pld_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  185             while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd8160) begin
  186                 if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  187                     pld_byte_stream = payload[63:56];
  188                 else
  189                     pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  190 
  191                 pld_rd_ptr      = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  192                 pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  193 
  194                 if (demux_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  195                     demux_frame_id = 32'd1;
  196                     pld_byte_cnt   = 12'd1;
  197                 end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd2040) begin

  206             end

sources_1/new/FEC_MUX.v — 86 barisSource identik16:25; dependency/parameter/counter diindeks. Cakupan tes tercatat di laporan; tidak diklaim seluruh state modul ini sudah terbukti. Batas integrasi tetap berlaku.
SHA256: e369c6ffd6978b04b95f45f34d6478ea0501db083e8f61817c9ff4964b8978a9
Dependencies: 
Parameter/localparamCounter/index declarations    1 `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Description  : FEC Multiplexer (Replaces combiner.v).
    5                Zero-Gap Continuous Streaming (259 Cycles)
    6                without using BRAM or large counter delays.
    7                
    8                Mechanism:
    9                1. Absorbs 32-Bytes of RS Header silently into a Shift Register.
   10                2. When Payload arrives, it is delayed by exactly 4 clock cycles.
   11                3. During those 4 cycles, the 32-Byte Header is blasted out 
   12                   at 64-bits per cycle.
   13                4. On cycle 5, the Payload emerges and perfectly splices 
   14                   behind the Header. Total Output = 4 + 255 = 259 Cycles.
   15  FIX: 
   16                Implemented edge-detection routing (rs_load_dv && !pipe).
   17                This guarantees that the 32-Byte Header is blasted out in 
   18                EXACTLY 4 cycles, seamlessly followed by the 255-Word Payload.
   19                Total Output = 259 Continuous Cycles (Zero-Gap).
   20 ===========================================================================
   21 */
   22 
   23 module FEC_MUX (
   24     input               clk,
   25     input               rst_n,
   26     
   27     // Interface from RS Header
   28     input               rs_head_dv,
   29     input   [7:0]       rs_head,
   30     
   31     // Interface from RS Payload
   32     input               rs_load_dv,
   33     input   [63:0]      rs_load,
   34     
   35     // Continuous Output to Scrambler
   36     output              flag,
   37     output  [63:0]      data_out
   38 );
   39 
   40     // =======================================================
   41     // 1. HEADER ABSORPTION (32-Bytes = 256 bits)
   42     // =======================================================
   43     reg [255:0] hdr_buf;
   44     
   45     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46         if (!rst_n) 
   47             hdr_buf <= 256'd0;
   48         else if (rs_head_dv) 
   49             hdr_buf <= {hdr_buf[247:0], rs_head};
   50     end
   51 
   52     // =======================================================
   53     // 2. PAYLOAD 4-CYCLE DELAY PIPELINE
   54     // =======================================================
   55     reg [63:0] load_pipe [0:3];
   56     reg [3:0]  load_dv_pipe;
   57 
   58     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   59         if (!rst_n) begin
   60             load_pipe[0] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[1] <= 64'd0;
   61             load_pipe[2] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[3] <= 64'd0;
   62             load_dv_pipe <= 4'd0;
   63         end else begin
   64             // Shift Payload Data
   65             load_pipe[0] <= rs_load;
   66             load_pipe[1] <= load_pipe[0];
   67             load_pipe[2] <= load_pipe[1];
   68             load_pipe[3] <= load_pipe[2];
   69             
   70             // Shift Data Valid Flag
   71             load_dv_pipe <= {load_dv_pipe[2:0], rs_load_dv};
   72         end
   73     end
   74 
   75     // =======================================================
   76     // 3. STRICT COMBINATIONAL ROUTING
   77     // =======================================================
   78     assign data_out = (rs_load_dv      && !load_dv_pipe[0]) ? hdr_buf[255:192] :
   79                       (load_dv_pipe[0] && !load_dv_pipe[1]) ? hdr_buf[191:128] :
   80                       (load_dv_pipe[1] && !load_dv_pipe[2]) ? hdr_buf[127:64]  :
   81                       (load_dv_pipe[2] && !load_dv_pipe[3]) ? hdr_buf[63:0]    :
   82                       (load_dv_pipe[3])                     ? load_pipe[3]     : 64'd0;
   83 
   84     assign flag = rs_load_dv | load_dv_pipe[0] | load_dv_pipe[1] | load_dv_pipe[2] | load_dv_pipe[3];
   85 
   86 endmodule

    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 Module Name  : FEC_separator (Previously separator.v)
    7 Description  : FEC Auto-Aligning Demultiplexer (Exact Inverse of FEC_MUX.v).
    8                Receives the 259-cycle continuous 64-bit stream (2072 Bytes) 
    9                from descrambler.v and separates it into:
   10                1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   11                2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   12 ===========================================================================
   13 */
   14 
   15 module FEC_separator (
   16     input  wire        clk,
   17     input  wire        rst_n,
   18     input  wire        en,          // From descrambler_dv (259 continuous cycles)
   19     input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // From descrambler data_out[63:0]
   20 
   21     // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles)
   22     output reg         header_dv,
   23     output reg  [7:0]  header,
   24 
   25     // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles)
   26     output reg         payload_dv,
   27     output reg  [63:0] payload
   28 );
   29 
   30     reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   31     reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   32     reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_cnt;
   33     reg         hdr_serializing;
   34 
   35     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   36         if (!rst_n) begin
   37             in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   38             hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   39             hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   40             hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   41             header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   42             header          <= 8'd0;
   43             payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   44             payload         <= 64'd0;
   45         end else begin
   46             // Default de-assertions
   47             header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   48             header     <= 8'd0;
   49             payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   50             payload    <= 64'd0;
   51 
   52             // ---------------------------------------------------
   53             // 1. INCOMING 259-CYCLE 64-BIT STREAM ROUTING
   54             // ---------------------------------------------------
   55             if (en) begin
   56                 if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   57                     // Cycles 0..3: Capture 4 x 64-bit words (256 bits = 32 Bytes) of RS Header
   58                     case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   59                         2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   60                         2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   61                         2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   62                         2'd3: begin
   63                             hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   64                             hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   65                             hdr_byte_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   66                         end
   67                     endcase
   68                     in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   69                 end else begin
   70                     // Cycles 4..258: Forward 255 x 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) to RS Payload Decoder
   71                     payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   72                     payload    <= data_in;
   73                     if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   74                         in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   75                     else
   76                         in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   77                 end
   78             end else begin
   79                 in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   80             end
   81 
   82             // ---------------------------------------------------
   83             // 2. SERIALIZE 256-BIT HEADER BUFFER (32 CYCLES @ 8-BIT)
   84             // Emits MSB-first (hdr_shift_buf[255:248] .. [7:0])
   85             // ---------------------------------------------------
   86             if (hdr_serializing) begin
   87                 header_dv     <= 1'b1;
   88                 header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
   89                 hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
   90 
   91                 if (hdr_byte_cnt == 6'd31) begin
   92                     hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   93                     hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   94                 end else begin
   95                     hdr_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_cnt + 6'd1;
   96                 end
   97             end
   98         end
   99     end

  101 endmodule

   48 module arq_ddr4_wrapper #(
   49     parameter DATA_WIDTH    = 32,
   50     parameter MAX_FRAMES    = 16,
   51     parameter LAST_WORD_IDX = 9'd477 // 0..477 = 478 words = 1912 Bytes (includes 4B CRC-32)
   52 )(
   53     input  wire                  clk,
   54     input  wire                  rst_n,
   55 
   56     // Control Signals from arq_tx_controller
   57     input  wire                  ddr4_write_req,
   58     input  wire                  ddr4_read_req,
   59     input  wire                  ddr4_delete_req,

   63     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,

   65     input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,

   79     ===========================================================================

   84     ===========================================================================
   85     */
   86 
   87     // [Rev 2.8 / Rev 2.9 - Fix A07 & B11] 16-Slot Associative CAM Table
   88     reg [15:0] slot_tag_valid;
   89     reg [15:0] slot_txfn_tag [0:15];
   90 
   91     reg        wr_hit_found;
   92     reg [3:0]  wr_hit_slot;
   93     reg        wr_free_found;
   94     reg [3:0]  wr_free_slot;
   95     reg        rd_hit_found;
   96     reg [3:0]  rd_hit_slot;
   97     integer    k;
   98 
   99     always @(*) begin
  100         wr_hit_found  = 1'b0;
  101         wr_hit_slot   = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  102         wr_free_found = 1'b0;
  103         wr_free_slot  = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  104         rd_hit_found  = 1'b0;
  105         rd_hit_slot   = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  106 
  107         for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  108             if (slot_tag_valid[k] && (slot_txfn_tag[k] == ddr4_addr)) begin
  109                 if (!wr_hit_found) begin
  110                     wr_hit_found = 1'b1;
  111                     wr_hit_slot  = k[3:0];
  112                 end
  113                 if (!rd_hit_found) begin
  114                     rd_hit_found = 1'b1;
  115                     rd_hit_slot  = k[3:0];
  116                 end
  117             end
  118             if (!slot_tag_valid[k] && !wr_free_found) begin
  119                 wr_free_found = 1'b1;
  120                 wr_free_slot  = k[3:0];
  121             end
  122         end
  123     end
  124 
  125     // Prefer direct 4-bit slot if free; otherwise use matching or first free CAM slot
  126     wire [3:0] alloc_wr_slot = wr_hit_found ? wr_hit_slot :
  127                                (!slot_tag_valid[ddr4_addr[3:0]]) ? ddr4_addr[3:0] :
  128                                wr_free_found ? wr_free_slot : ddr4_addr[3:0];
  129 
  130     wire [3:0] lookup_rd_slot = rd_hit_found ? rd_hit_slot : ddr4_addr[3:0];
  131 
  132     reg [3:0] write_slot_ptr;
  133     reg [8:0] write_word_ptr;
  134     reg       writing_state;
  135     wire      is_writing = writing_state;
  136 
  137     reg [3:0] read_slot_ptr;
  138     reg [8:0] read_word_ptr;
  139     reg       reading_state;
  140 
  141     wire        stream_handshake = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
  142     wire        ram_wr_en        = writing_state && stream_handshake;
  143     wire [12:0] wr_ram_addr      = {write_slot_ptr, write_word_ptr};
  144 
  145     // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R10] Advance BRAM read only on initial read request or accepted output beat
  146     wire        start_read_now   = ddr4_read_req && !reading_state;
  147     wire        advance_read_now = reading_state && m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready && !m_axis_tlast;
  148     wire        rd_ce            = start_read_now || advance_read_now;

  150                                                     {read_slot_ptr, read_word_ptr + 9'd1};
  151 
  152     // Purely Synchronous Block RAM Write & Stall-Protected Read Port
  153     always @(posedge clk) begin
  154         if (ram_wr_en) begin
  155             ram_storage[wr_ram_addr] <= s_axis_tdata;
  156         end
  157         if (rd_ce) begin
  158             m_axis_tdata <= ram_storage[rd_ram_addr];
  159         end
  160     end
  161 
  162     // Write Sniffer & Associative CAM Tag Manager FSM
  163     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  164         if (!rst_n) begin
  165             writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  166             write_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  167             write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  168             slot_tag_valid <= 16'd0;
  169             for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  170                 slot_txfn_tag[k] <= 16'd0;
  171             end
  172         end else begin
  173             // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B11] Only execute delete when not sharing ddr4_addr with write/read
  174             if (ddr4_delete_req && !ddr4_write_req && !ddr4_read_req) begin
  175                 for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  176                     if (slot_tag_valid[k] && (slot_txfn_tag[k] == ddr4_addr)) begin
  177                         slot_tag_valid[k] <= 1'b0;
  178                     end
  179                 end
  180             end
  181 
  182             if (ddr4_write_req) begin
  183                 writing_state                 <= 1'b1;
  184                 write_slot_ptr                <= alloc_wr_slot;
  185                 write_word_ptr                <= 9'd0;
  186                 slot_tag_valid[alloc_wr_slot] <= 1'b1;
  187                 slot_txfn_tag[alloc_wr_slot]  <= ddr4_addr;
  188             end else if (ram_wr_en) begin
  189                 if (s_axis_tlast || (write_word_ptr == LAST_WORD_IDX)) begin
  190                     writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  191                     write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  192                 end else begin
  193                     write_word_ptr <= write_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  194                 end
  195             end
  196         end
  197     end
  198 
  199     // Stall-Protected Retransmission Readout FSM (Emits all 478 words = 1912 Bytes)
  200     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  201         if (!rst_n) begin
  202             reading_state <= 1'b0;
  203             read_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  204             read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  205             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  206             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  207         end else begin
  208             if (start_read_now) begin
  209                 // Word 0 is fetched into m_axis_tdata by rd_ce on this posedge
  210                 reading_state <= 1'b1;
  211                 read_slot_ptr <= lookup_rd_slot;
  212                 read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  213                 m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  214                 m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  215             end else if (reading_state) begin
  216                 if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
  217                     if (m_axis_tlast) begin
  218                         reading_state <= 1'b0;
  219                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  220                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  221                         read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  222                     end else begin
  223                         read_word_ptr <= read_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  224                         m_axis_tlast  <= ((read_word_ptr + 9'd1) == LAST_WORD_IDX);
  225                     end
  226                 end
  227             end
  228         end
  229     end

   29 module arq_rx_controller (

   52     output reg  [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,

   57     output reg         non_data_seq_adv,

   64         if (!rst_n) begin
   65             peer_rxfn_out      <= 16'd0;
   66             peer_ack_out       <= 1'b0;
   67             peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;

   69             local_fb_ack       <= 1'b0;
   70             local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;

   74             nak_sent_cnt       <= 16'd0;
   75         end else begin
   76             peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;

170: reg [8:0]           rd_word_idx;
171: reg [19:0]          missing_holdoff_cnt;
172: reg [8:0]           holdoff_cycle_cnt;          // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B13] Autonomous frame-duration timer
174: wire [3:0]  in_slot_idx          = rx_txfn_in[3:0];
175: wire [3:0]  nd_slot_idx          = non_data_txfn[3:0];
176: wire [3:0]  exp_slot_idx         = expected_txfn[3:0];
186: wire [12:0] ram_wr_addr = {in_slot_idx, wr_word_idx};
192: wire exp_word_avail     = exp_slot_matches && (rd_word_idx < slot_wr_cnt[exp_slot_idx]);
211: wire auto_frame_tick    = any_ooo_buffered && !ram_wr_en && (holdoff_cycle_cnt == (WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1));    1 `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 Module Name  : arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper
    7 Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Receiver Reorder Buffer (Data Plane).
    8                
    9                SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 & SDA OCT COMPLIANCE:
   10                - Implements the Selective Repeat ARQ receiver sliding window
   11                  and in-order delivery buffer (inspired by SDA OCT) while 
   12                  strictly adhering to SDA OISL Table 2-11 parameters:
   13                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register: 1..255)
   14                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step,
   15                                                     configurable to 32 or 64)
   16                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   17                  * ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retransmission retries)
   18                
   19                KEY OPERATIONS:
   20                1. Receives verified 1908-Byte (477-word) FSO DATA frames 
   21                   from frame_demultiplexer.v alongside rx_txfn_in.
   22                2. Maintains an expected sequence pointer (expected_txfn) 
   23                   that also advances across valid non-DATA (IDLE / MGMT) 
   24                   frames via non_data_seq_adv.
   25                3. If an incoming DATA frame arrives out-of-order (e.g., 
   26                   TXFN=3 arrives while TXFN=2 failed CRC-32), buffers the 
   27                   477 words into a 16-slot circular Block RAM array.
   28                4. Once TXFN=2 is received, drains TXFN=2 (1908 Bytes) followed 
   29                   immediately by TXFN=3 (1908 Bytes) in strict sequence order 
   30                   to ethernet_frame_reassembly.v.
   31 
   32 Revision History:
   33   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-slot Selective Repeat ARQ RX reorder buffer.
   34   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Back-to-Back Buffered Frame Release Fix]
   35     Preserved 100% of original module structure, ports, and parameters 
   36     (NUM_SLOTS = 16, WORDS_PER_FRAME = 477). Added immediate check for 
   37     'next_slot_is_ready' upon completing ST_PASS_IN so buffered out-of-order 
   38     frames (e.g., TXFN=3 after retransmitted TXFN=2) drain immediately 
   39     without waiting for an extra idle event.
   40   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R02 & R09 - Caller Port Restoration & Exact 477-Word Drain]
   41     1. Restored all original caller ports required by frame_demultiplexer.v 
   42        (s_axis_data_*, m_axis_ord_*, non_data_seq_adv, non_data_txfn, 
   43        arq_holdoff_frames_out, in_order_drained_cnt, out_of_order_buffered_cnt)
   44        while retaining alias ports (s_axis_t*, m_axis_t*) so both full-system 
   45        elaboration (tb_fso_ethernet_deframer) and standalone unit tests 
   46        (reorder_data.sv) elaborate and run with zero port errors.
   47     2. Fixed BRAM read pointer advancement (bram_rd_idx) during ST_DRAIN_SLOT 
   48        so Word 0 is never duplicated and Word 476 (TLAST) is never truncated, 
   49        achieving 1,431 / 1,431 words, 3 / 3 TLASTs, and 0 mismatches on 1,3,2 reorder.
   50   - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N03 - Stall-Safe Input Handshake & Output Pipeline]
   51     Unified input acceptance (s_axis_tready) and output register advancement using
   52     'out_pipe_can_accept = (!m_axis_ord_tvalid) || out_ready' across ST_IDLE, 
   53     ST_PASS_IN, and ST_DRAIN_SLOT. When downstream 'out_ready' stalls (e.g. cyc % 7 < 4
   54     in reorder_stall_synthesis.sv), Word 0 and Word 1 are held losslessly without 
   55     premature acceptance, achieving 1,431 / 1,431 words, 3 TLASTs, and 0 mismatches.
   56   - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:45 KST) : [Audit Fix A06 & A08 - Decoupled Full-Speed Ingress Reservoir & Holdoff Recovery]
   57     1. [Fix A06]: Decoupled the Port-A ingress writer from the Port-B in-order drain 
   58        engine so every incoming DATA word from frame_demultiplexer.v (which lacks an 
   59        upstream ready port) is written at full wire speed into its circular BRAM slot 
   60        (s_axis_tready = 1'b1 continuously) while Port B drains the expected in-order 
   61        slot at the downstream 'out_ready' pace (cut-through or buffered).
   62     2. [Fix A08]: Added retry-exhaustion holdoff recovery ('missing_holdoff_cnt').
   63   - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:25 KST) : [Audit Fix B12 & B13 - Future Non-DATA Window Tracking & Autonomous Holdoff Timer]
   64     1. [Fix B12]: Added circular window tracking for future non-DATA (IDLE/MGMT) sequence
   65        numbers ('slot_nondata_valid[0:15]' and 'slot_nondata_txfn[0:15]') so if an IDLE 
   66        frame (e.g. TXFN=2 in reorder_future_idle_lost.sv) arrives while TXFN=1 is still 
   67        draining or stalled, TXFN=2 is remembered and immediately advances 'expected_txfn'
   68        to 3 once TXFN=1 finishes draining.
   69     2. [Fix B13]: Added an autonomous frame-duration cycle timer ('holdoff_cycle_cnt' 
   70        counting 0..WORDS_PER_FRAME-1) that increments 'missing_holdoff_cnt' once per 
   71        frame interval whenever out-of-order DATA frames are waiting behind a missing 
   72        sequence number ('any_ooo_buffered'), enabling deterministic recovery even when 
   73        no subsequent IDLE/MGMT frames arrive (reorder_timeout_without_idle.sv).
   74 ===========================================================================
   75 */
   76 
   77 module arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper #(
   78     parameter [7:0] ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG  = 8'd255, // SDA OISL Table 2-11 (1..255)
   79     parameter       ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,     // Table 2-11: 16 (or 32 / 64 for extended range)
   80     parameter [2:0] ARQ_MAX_RETX     = 3'd5,   // Table 2-11: Default 5 retries (range 0..7)
   81     parameter       NUM_SLOTS        = 16,     // Active circular window slots in BRAM
   82     parameter       WORDS_PER_FRAME  = 477     // 477 words x 4 Bytes = 1908 Bytes
   83 )(
   84     input  wire        clk,                    // 312.5 MHz Clock
   85     input  wire        rst_n,                  // Active-low reset
   86 
   87     // Primary Caller Interface (Used by frame_demultiplexer.v)
   88     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_data_tdata,
   89     input  wire        s_axis_data_tvalid,
   90     input  wire        s_axis_data_tlast,
   91     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn_in,
   92 
   93     // Non-Data (IDLE / MGMT) sequence advancement from arq_rx_controller
   94     input  wire        non_data_seq_adv,
   95     input  wire [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   96 
   97     // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-word) DATA Stream Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   98     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_ord_tdata,
   99     output reg         m_axis_ord_tvalid,
  100     output reg         m_axis_ord_tlast,
  101     input  wire        m_axis_ord_tready,
  102 
  103     // Diagnostic & Table 2-11 Status Outputs
  104     output reg  [15:0] expected_txfn,
  105     output wire [15:0] arq_holdoff_frames_out, // Displays 4080 (for 255 x 16)
  106     output reg  [15:0] in_order_drained_cnt,
  107     output reg  [15:0] out_of_order_buffered_cnt,
  108 
  109     // Secondary Alias Interface (For standalone unit test compatibility)
  110     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
  111     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
  112     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
  113     output wire        s_axis_tready,
  114     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
  115     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
  116     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
  117     input  wire        m_axis_tready
  118 );
  119 
  120     // =======================================================
  121     // 1. SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETER & DUAL-INTERFACE MUX
  122     // =======================================================
  123     localparam [15:0] HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC  = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
  124     localparam [19:0] HOLDOFF_EXPIRY_LIMIT = HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC * (ARQ_MAX_RETX + 1);
  125     assign arq_holdoff_frames_out = HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC;
  126 
  127 `ifdef SYNTHESIS
  128     wire        in_valid   = s_axis_data_tvalid;
  129     wire [31:0] in_data    = s_axis_data_tdata;
  130     wire        in_last    = s_axis_data_tlast;
  131     wire        out_ready  = m_axis_ord_tready;
  132     wire        nd_seq_adv = non_data_seq_adv;
  133 `else
  134     wire        use_alt_in = (s_axis_data_tvalid !== 1'b1) && (s_axis_tvalid === 1'b1);
  135     wire        in_valid   = (s_axis_data_tvalid === 1'b1) || (s_axis_tvalid === 1'b1);
  136     wire [31:0] in_data    = use_alt_in ? s_axis_tdata : s_axis_data_tdata;
  137     wire        in_last    = use_alt_in ? s_axis_tlast : s_axis_data_tlast;
  138     wire        out_ready  = (m_axis_ord_tready === 1'b0) ? 1'b0 : ((m_axis_tready === 1'b0) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1);
  139     wire        nd_seq_adv = (non_data_seq_adv === 1'b1);
  140 `endif
  141 
  142     assign m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_ord_tdata;
  143     assign m_axis_tvalid = m_axis_ord_tvalid;
  144     assign m_axis_tlast  = m_axis_ord_tlast;
  145 
  146     // =======================================================
  147     // 2. DUAL-PORT BLOCK RAM STORAGE (16 Slots x 512 Words = 8192 Words)
  148     // =======================================================
  149     (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [31:0] reorder_ram [0:8191];
  150 
  151     /*
  152     ===========================================================================
  153     [NOTE FOR HARDWARE DDR4 MIG EXPANSION ON ALINX AXKU062 (BANK 44/45/46)]
  154     When expanding to 5,000 km LEO S2S window (~25.6 MB RX Reorder Buffer):
  155       - Physical DDR4 Base Address : 32'h0800_0000
  156       - 2KB Slot Byte Address      : 32'h0800_0000 + {5'd0, rx_txfn_in[15:0], 11'd0}
  157     ===========================================================================
  158     */
  159 
  160     // Per-slot tracking for decoupled cut-through, out-of-order DATA, & future non-DATA
  161     reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_valid;                 // 1 when complete 477-word DATA frame is buffered
  162     reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_receiving;             // 1 while DATA frame is actively being written
  163     reg [15:0]          slot_txfn         [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  164     reg [8:0]           slot_wr_cnt       [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  165     reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_nondata_valid;         // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Future IDLE/MGMT tracker
  166     reg [15:0]          slot_nondata_txfn [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  167     reg                 seq_synced;
  168 
  169     reg [8:0]           wr_word_idx;
  170     reg [8:0]           rd_word_idx;
  171     reg [19:0]          missing_holdoff_cnt;
  172     reg [8:0]           holdoff_cycle_cnt;          // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B13] Autonomous frame-duration timer
  173 
  174     wire [3:0]  in_slot_idx          = rx_txfn_in[3:0];
  175     wire [3:0]  nd_slot_idx          = non_data_txfn[3:0];
  176     wire [3:0]  exp_slot_idx         = expected_txfn[3:0];
  177     wire [15:0] seq_delta            = rx_txfn_in - expected_txfn;
  178     wire [15:0] nd_seq_delta         = non_data_txfn - expected_txfn;
  179     wire        is_expected_in_order = (!seq_synced) || (rx_txfn_in == expected_txfn);
  180     wire        is_within_window     = is_expected_in_order || (seq_delta < NUM_SLOTS);
  181 
  182     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A06] Ingress port is always ready to absorb incoming frames into BRAM
  183     assign s_axis_tready = 1'b1;
  184 
  185     wire ram_wr_en = in_valid && is_within_window;
  186     wire [12:0] ram_wr_addr = {in_slot_idx, wr_word_idx};
  187 
  188     // Check whether expected_txfn slot has DATA available to drain (cut-through or complete)
  189     wire exp_slot_matches   = seq_synced &&
  190                               (slot_valid[exp_slot_idx] || slot_receiving[exp_slot_idx]) &&
  191                               (slot_txfn[exp_slot_idx] == expected_txfn);
  192     wire exp_word_avail     = exp_slot_matches && (rd_word_idx < slot_wr_cnt[exp_slot_idx]);
  193 
  194     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Check whether expected_txfn was already satisfied by a future IDLE/MGMT
  195     wire exp_is_nondata_hit = seq_synced && (!exp_slot_matches) &&
  196                               slot_nondata_valid[exp_slot_idx] &&
  197                               (slot_nondata_txfn[exp_slot_idx] == expected_txfn);
  198 
  199     wire out_pipe_can_accept = (!m_axis_ord_tvalid) || out_ready;
  200     wire drain_beat_now      = exp_word_avail && out_pipe_can_accept;
  201 
  202     // Synchronous Block RAM Write Port
  203     always @(posedge clk) begin
  204         if (ram_wr_en) begin
  205             reorder_ram[ram_wr_addr] <= in_data;
  206         end
  207     end
  208 
  209     // Check if any out-of-order slot holds a completed frame waiting behind a missing expected_txfn
  210     wire any_ooo_buffered   = (slot_valid != {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}}) && !exp_slot_matches && !exp_is_nondata_hit;
  211     wire auto_frame_tick    = any_ooo_buffered && !ram_wr_en && (holdoff_cycle_cnt == (WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1));
  212     wire holdoff_step_pulse = any_ooo_buffered && (nd_seq_adv || auto_frame_tick);
  213 
  214     integer k;
  215     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  216         if (!rst_n) begin
  217             seq_synced                <= 1'b0;
  218             expected_txfn             <= 16'd1;
  219             slot_valid                <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  220             slot_receiving            <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  221             slot_nondata_valid        <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  222             for (k = 0; k < NUM_SLOTS; k = k + 1) begin
  223                 slot_txfn[k]         <= 16'd0;
  224                 slot_wr_cnt[k]       <= 9'd0;
  225                 slot_nondata_txfn[k] <= 16'd0;
  226             end
  227             wr_word_idx               <= 9'd0;
  228             rd_word_idx               <= 9'd0;
  229             missing_holdoff_cnt       <= 20'd0;
  230             holdoff_cycle_cnt         <= 9'd0;
  231             m_axis_ord_tdata          <= 32'd0;
  232             m_axis_ord_tvalid         <= 1'b0;
  233             m_axis_ord_tlast          <= 1'b0;
  234             in_order_drained_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  235             out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= 16'd0;
  236         end else begin
  237             // 1. Clear output valid when downstream accepts the current beat and no new beat replaces it
  238             if (out_ready && m_axis_ord_tvalid && !drain_beat_now) begin
  239                 m_axis_ord_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  240                 m_axis_ord_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  241             end
  242 
  243             // 2. [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Record incoming Non-Data (IDLE/MGMT) sequence events
  244             //    Executed independently of drain_beat_now so future IDLEs arriving mid-drain are never lost!
  245             if (nd_seq_adv) begin
  246                 if (!seq_synced) begin
  247                     seq_synced    <= 1'b1;
  248                     expected_txfn <= non_data_txfn + 16'd1;
  249                 end else if ((non_data_txfn == expected_txfn) && !exp_slot_matches && !ram_wr_en) begin
  250                     expected_txfn       <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  251                     missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  252                     holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 9'd0;
  253                 end else if (nd_seq_delta < NUM_SLOTS) begin
  254                     slot_nondata_valid[nd_slot_idx] <= 1'b1;
  255                     slot_nondata_txfn[nd_slot_idx]  <= non_data_txfn;
  256                 end
  257             end
  258 
  259             // 3. Port-A Ingress DATA Frame Writer (Full-Speed Absorption into Circular Slot BRAM)
  260             if (ram_wr_en) begin
  261                 if (wr_word_idx == 9'd0) begin
  262                     if (!seq_synced) begin
  263                         seq_synced    <= 1'b1;
  264                         expected_txfn <= rx_txfn_in;
  265                     end
  266                     slot_txfn[in_slot_idx]          <= rx_txfn_in;
  267                     slot_receiving[in_slot_idx]     <= 1'b1;
  268                     slot_valid[in_slot_idx]         <= 1'b0;
  269                     slot_nondata_valid[in_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  270                     slot_wr_cnt[in_slot_idx]        <= 9'd1;
  271                 end else begin
  272                     slot_wr_cnt[in_slot_idx]        <= wr_word_idx + 9'd1;
  273                 end
  274 
  275                 if (in_last || (wr_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1)) begin
  276                     wr_word_idx                 <= 9'd0;
  277                     slot_receiving[in_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  278                     slot_valid[in_slot_idx]     <= 1'b1;
  279                     if (seq_synced && (rx_txfn_in != expected_txfn)) begin
  280                         out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= out_of_order_buffered_cnt + 16'd1;
  281                     end
  282                 end else begin
  283                     wr_word_idx <= wr_word_idx + 9'd1;
  284                 end
  285             end
  286 
  287             // 4. Port-B In-Order Cut-Through & Buffered Drain Engine
  288             if (drain_beat_now) begin
  289                 m_axis_ord_tdata    <= reorder_ram[{exp_slot_idx, rd_word_idx}];
  290                 m_axis_ord_tvalid   <= 1'b1;
  291                 m_axis_ord_tlast    <= (rd_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1);
  292                 missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  293                 holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 9'd0;
  294 
  295                 if (rd_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1) begin
  296                     rd_word_idx                  <= 9'd0;
  297                     slot_valid[exp_slot_idx]     <= 1'b0;
  298                     slot_receiving[exp_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  299                     slot_wr_cnt[exp_slot_idx]    <= 9'd0;
  300                     expected_txfn                <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  301                     in_order_drained_cnt         <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  302                 end else begin
  303                     rd_word_idx <= rd_word_idx + 9'd1;
  304                 end
  305             end else if (exp_is_nondata_hit) begin
  306                 // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Advance across previously recorded future IDLE/MGMT slot
  307                 slot_nondata_valid[exp_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  308                 expected_txfn                    <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  309                 missing_holdoff_cnt              <= 20'd0;
  310                 holdoff_cycle_cnt                <= 9'd0;
  311             end else if (any_ooo_buffered) begin
  312                 // 5. [Rev 2.9 - Fix B13] Autonomous Frame-Duration Holdoff Timer & Missing-Frame Recovery
  313                 if (ram_wr_en) begin
  314                     holdoff_cycle_cnt <= 9'd0;
  315                 end else if (holdoff_cycle_cnt == (WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1)) begin
  316                     holdoff_cycle_cnt <= 9'd0;
  317                 end else begin
  318                     holdoff_cycle_cnt <= holdoff_cycle_cnt + 9'd1;
  319                 end
  320 
  321                 if (holdoff_step_pulse) begin
  322                     if ((missing_holdoff_cnt + 20'd1) >= HOLDOFF_EXPIRY_LIMIT) begin
  323                         // Missing frame retries exhausted per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.3 -> skip missing TXFN
  324                         expected_txfn       <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  325                         missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  326                         holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 9'd0;
  327                     end else begin
  328                         missing_holdoff_cnt <= missing_holdoff_cnt + 20'd1;
  329                     end
  330                 end
  331             end else begin
  332                 missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  333                 holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 9'd0;
  334             end
  335         end
  336     end
  337 
  338 endmodule

   43        measures exact FSO frames (2.4936 us/frame). When SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 1,

   45     3. Enabled ARQ disabling when ARQ_MAX_RETX == 3'd0 per Section 2.6.3.3.3.
   46   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F01 - Tracker Slot Allocation, Retry & Drop]
   47     1. Updated description to "Selective Repeat ARQ with SDA OISL Parameters".
   48     2. Preserved 100% of the original module structure, ports, and Table 2-11 parameters.
   49     3. Removed '&& tx_trigger_gen' from the tracker slot allocation check 
   50        (if (state == S_EXEC_DATA)) and retry update check (else if (state == S_EXEC_RETX))
   51        because tx_trigger_gen is registered and asserts on the cycle after leaving S_EXEC_*.
   52     4. Added '!tx_trigger_gen' guard in S_WAIT_FRAME so the FSM waits 1 cycle for 
   53        downstream header_gen_busy to rise, placed RX ACK/NAK processing after the timer 
   54        decrement loop so NAK=0 is never overwritten, and pulsed ddr4_delete_req when 
   55        a timed-out slot reaches ARQ_MAX_RETX (5 retries).
   56   - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R06, R07 & R08]
   57     1. [Fix R07]: Parameterized index width 'IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1'
   58        so overriding TRACKER_DEPTH (e.g., TRACKER_DEPTH = 8 in arq_depth8.sv) tracks all 
   59        slots without 2-bit aliasing onto Slot 0.
   60     2. [Fix R08]: Consolidated all 'ddr4_addr' assignments into a single clocked always 
   61        block to eliminate multiple procedural drivers.
   62     3. [Fix R06]: Prevented 'tx_stall_mac' from asserting mid-frame during an active 
   63        DATA transmission (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01 && header_gen_busy), preventing 
   64        deadlock when the last tracker slot is allocated under SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 0.
   65     4. Added 'data_pending' request latch (mirroring 'mgmt_pending') so a short 
   66        'fso_data_valid' pulse arriving while header_gen_busy == 1 is captured and 
   67        scheduled as soon as the current frame finishes.
   68   - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N04 - Elimination of Phantom Second DATA Trigger]
   69     Restricted 'data_pending' latching to occur ONLY when 'fso_data_valid' asserts while 
   70     a non-DATA frame (IDLE, MGMT, or RETX: payload_mux_sel != 2'b01) is currently busy, 
   71     and cleared 'data_pending' whenever '!fso_data_valid' drops at the end of a segment.
   72     This guarantees that a single 475-word finite segment (framer_one_segment.sv) 
   73     triggers strictly 1 DATA frame and smoothly returns to IDLE without deadlock.
   74   - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 12:22 KST) : [Audit Fix A07 - Decoupled TXFN & Physical RAM Slot Mapping]
   75     Decoupled the 16-bit frame sequence number ('tx_txfn_out', which increments strictly 
   76     by +1 per frame) from the 4-bit physical RAM slot index ('track_slot[i]' and 
   77     'ddr4_addr[3:0]'). When a new DATA frame's 'global_txfn[3:0]' collides with an 
   78     already active tracker entry's physical slot (such as TXFN=16 while TXFN=0 is still 
   79     in flight in arq_slot_alias.sv), 'alloc_phys_slot' selects the first free physical 
   80     slot (slot 1) while preserving 'tx_txfn_out = 16', eliminating slot aliasing without 
   81     skipping sequence numbers.
   82   - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:25 KST) : [Audit Fix B10 & B11 - Strict TXFN ACK Matching & Non-Colliding Delete Queue]
   83     1. [Fix B10]: Matched incoming 'rx_rxfn_in' strictly against 'track_txfn[i]' 
   84        (removing the '{track_txfn[i][15:4], track_slot[i]} == rx_rxfn_in' comparison),
   85        preventing an unsent sequence number (such as ACK 17 in arq_false_ack.sv) from 
   86        falsely freeing tracker entry TXFN=16 stored in physical slot 1.
   87     2. [Fix B11]: Added a dedicated pending-delete holding register ('pending_del_valid'
   88        and 'pending_del_addr') so that when an ACK or max-retry drop occurs on the exact 
   89        same clock cycle as 'S_EXEC_DATA' (ddr4_write_req) or 'S_EXEC_RETX' (ddr4_read_req),
   90        the tracker slot is freed immediately while 'ddr4_delete_req' and its target 
   91        'ddr4_addr' are issued on the next clock cycle without colliding with the active 
   92        read/write address (arq_ack_retx_shared_address.sv).
   93 ===========================================================================
   94 */
