   96 module arq_tx_controller #(
   97     parameter [2:0]  ARQ_MAX_RETX      = 3'd5,     // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 0..5 (Default = 5; 0 = ARQ Disabled)
   98     parameter [7:0]  ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG   = 8'd255,   // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 1..255 (8-bit configuration)
   99     parameter integer ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,       // 16 = Strict Table 2-11 (x16 frames); 64 = 5000 km Extension
  100     parameter        SIM_SCALE_ENABLE  = 1,        // 1 = Use HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast simulation; 0 = Frame-granular
  101     parameter [15:0] HOLDOFF_TICKS     = 16'd500,  // Simulation scaled holdoff ticks when SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 1
  102     parameter integer TRACKER_DEPTH    = 4         // Number of concurrent frames tracked in flight
  103 )(
  104     input  wire        clk,
  105     input  wire        rst_n,
  106 
  107     // --- Traffic & Timing Monitors ---
  108     input  wire        fso_data_valid,   // Asserted when Ethernet segment/FIFO has DATA ready
  109     input  wire        mgmt_tick_1hz,    // 1Hz pulse to trigger MGMT frame
  110     input  wire        header_gen_busy,  // From fso_header_top (Wait for current frame to finish)
  111 
  112     // --- ARQ Feedback from RX Decoder (Remote Terminal) ---
  113     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,       // RXFN received from remote terminal
  114     input  wire        rx_ack_in,        // 1 = ACK, 0 = NAK
  115     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,  // 1 = Valid ARQ feedback present
  116 
  117     // --- Outputs to Header Generator & Payload MUX ---
  118     output reg  [15:0] tx_txfn_out,      // Current TXFN to be transmitted
  119     output reg  [1:0]  tx_frame_type,    // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT
  120     output reg         tx_trigger_gen,   // Fires the Header Generator
  121     output reg  [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,  // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RETX
  122     output wire        tx_stall_mac,     // Stalls normal Ethernet data during Retx/MGMT
  123 
  124     // --- Outputs to ARQ DDR4 Wrapper ---
  125     output reg         ddr4_write_req,   // Sniff and store current DATA frame
  126     output reg         ddr4_read_req,    // Fetch frame from RAM for Retransmission
  127     output reg         ddr4_delete_req,  // Free RAM slot upon ACK or Max Retries
  128     output reg  [15:0] ddr4_addr         // Target Frame Number / Physical Slot in RAM
  129 );
  130 
  131     localparam integer IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1;
  132 
  133     // =======================================================
  134     // 1. OUTSTANDING FRAME TRACKER TABLE (CAM-like Structure)
  135     // =======================================================
  136     localparam [15:0] TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
  137     wire       [15:0] active_holdoff_limit      = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? HOLDOFF_TICKS : TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES;
  138     wire       [2:0]  eff_max_retx              = (ARQ_MAX_RETX > 3'd5) ? 3'd5 : ARQ_MAX_RETX;
  139     wire              arq_disabled              = (eff_max_retx == 3'd0) || (ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG == 8'd0);
  140 
  141     reg        track_valid [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  142     reg [15:0] track_txfn  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  143     reg [15:0] track_timer [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  144     reg [2:0]  track_retx  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  145     reg [3:0]  track_slot  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1]; // Dedicated 4-bit physical RAM slot per tracker entry
  146 
  147     reg [15:0] global_txfn;  // Master sequence counter for new frames
  148     reg        mgmt_pending; // Latch for 1Hz MGMT request
  149     reg        data_pending; // Latch for DATA request arriving while non-DATA frame is busy
  150     wire       data_req_active = fso_data_valid || data_pending;
  151 
  152     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B11] Deferred delete register when ACK/drop coincides with S_EXEC_DATA/RETX
  153     reg        pending_del_valid;
  154     reg [15:0] pending_del_addr;
  155 
  156     integer i, s;
  157 
  158     // =======================================================
  159     // 2. COMBINATIONAL SEARCH ENGINE & PHYSICAL SLOT ALLOCATOR
  160     // =======================================================
  161     reg                retx_needed;
  162     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] retx_index;
  163     reg                drop_needed;
  164     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] drop_index;
  165     reg                free_found;
  166     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] free_index;
  167     reg [15:0]         slot_busy_bitmap;
  168     reg [3:0]          alloc_phys_slot;
  169     reg                phys_slot_found;
  170 
  171     always @(*) begin
  172         retx_needed      = 1'b0;
  173         retx_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  174         drop_needed      = 1'b0;
  175         drop_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  176         free_found       = 1'b0;
  177         free_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  178         slot_busy_bitmap = 16'd0;
  179         phys_slot_found  = 1'b0;
  180 
  181         for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  182             if (track_valid[i]) begin
  183                 slot_busy_bitmap[track_slot[i]] = 1'b1;
  184                 if (track_timer[i] == 16'd0) begin
  185                     if (track_retx[i] < eff_max_retx) begin
  186                         if (!retx_needed) begin
  187                             retx_needed = 1'b1;
  188                             retx_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  189                         end
  190                     end else begin
  191                         if (!drop_needed) begin
  192                             drop_needed = 1'b1;
  193                             drop_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  194                         end
  195                     end
  196                 end
  197             end
  198             if (!track_valid[i] && !free_found) begin
  199                 free_found = 1'b1;
  200                 free_index = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  201             end
  202         end
  203 
  204         // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A07] Prefer global_txfn[3:0] if free; otherwise pick first free physical slot (0..15)
  205         if (!slot_busy_bitmap[global_txfn[3:0]]) begin
  206             alloc_phys_slot = global_txfn[3:0];
  207             phys_slot_found = 1'b1;
  208         end else begin
  209             alloc_phys_slot = global_txfn[3:0];
  210             for (s = 0; s < 16; s = s + 1) begin
  211                 if (!slot_busy_bitmap[s] && !phys_slot_found) begin
  212                     alloc_phys_slot = s[3:0];
  213                     phys_slot_found = 1'b1;
  214                 end
  215             end
  216         end
  217     end
  218 
  219     // =======================================================
  220     // 3. SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ STATE MACHINE
  221     // =======================================================
  222     localparam S_IDLE        = 3'd0,
  223                S_ARBITRATE   = 3'd1,
  224                S_EXEC_RETX   = 3'd2,
  225                S_EXEC_MGMT   = 3'd3,
  226                S_EXEC_DATA   = 3'd4,
  227                S_EXEC_IDLE   = 3'd5,
  228                S_WAIT_FRAME  = 3'd6;
  229 
  230     reg [2:0]          state, next_state;
  231     reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] target_index;
  232 
  233     wire active_data_in_flight = (state == S_EXEC_DATA) ||
  234                                  ((state == S_WAIT_FRAME) && (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01));
  235 
  236     assign tx_stall_mac = (state == S_EXEC_RETX) || (state == S_EXEC_MGMT) ||
  237                           (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) || (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ||
  238                           (!arq_disabled && !free_found && !active_data_in_flight);
  239 
  240     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  241         if (!rst_n) state <= S_IDLE;
  242         else        state <= next_state;
  243     end
  244 
  245     always @(*) begin
  246         next_state = state;
  247         case (state)
  248             S_IDLE: begin
  249                 if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_ARBITRATE;
  250             end
  251             
  252             S_ARBITRATE: begin
  253                 // STRICT PRIORITY ENFORCEMENT:
  254                 // Priority 1: Timer expired OR NAK received -> Retransmit!
  255                 if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)                        next_state = S_EXEC_RETX;
  256                 // Priority 2: 1Hz MGMT Schedule
  257                 else if (mgmt_pending)                                   next_state = S_EXEC_MGMT;
  258                 // Priority 3: Normal Ethernet Data available (and tracker slot available)
  259                 else if (data_req_active && (arq_disabled || free_found)) next_state = S_EXEC_DATA;
  260                 // Priority 4: Nothing to send -> Stream IDLE
  261                 else                                                     next_state = S_EXEC_IDLE;
  262             end
  263 
  264             S_EXEC_RETX, S_EXEC_MGMT, S_EXEC_DATA, S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  265                 next_state = S_WAIT_FRAME;
  266             end
  267 
  268             S_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  269                 if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_IDLE;
  270             end
  271             
  272             default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  273         endcase
  274     end
  275 
  276     // =======================================================
  277     // 4. UNIFIED OUTPUT, TRACKER & DDR4_ADDR EXECUTION LOGIC
  278     // =======================================================
  279     wire timer_tick_en = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? 1'b1 : tx_trigger_gen;
  280     wire bus_busy_exec = (state == S_EXEC_DATA) || (state == S_EXEC_RETX);
  281 
  282     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  283         if (!rst_n) begin
  284             global_txfn       <= 16'd0;
  285             tx_txfn_out       <= 16'd0;
  286             tx_frame_type     <= 2'b00;
  287             tx_trigger_gen    <= 1'b0;
  288             payload_mux_sel   <= 2'b00;
  289             ddr4_write_req    <= 1'b0;
  290             ddr4_read_req     <= 1'b0;
  291             ddr4_delete_req   <= 1'b0;
  292             ddr4_addr         <= 16'd0;
  293             mgmt_pending      <= 1'b0;
  294             data_pending      <= 1'b0;
  295             pending_del_valid <= 1'b0;
  296             pending_del_addr  <= 16'd0;
  297             target_index      <= {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  298             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  299                 track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  300                 track_txfn[i]  <= 16'd0;
  301                 track_timer[i] <= 16'd0;
  302                 track_retx[i]  <= 3'd0;
  303                 track_slot[i]  <= 4'd0;
  304             end
  305         end else begin
  306             tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  307             ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  308             ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  309             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  310 
  311             if (mgmt_tick_1hz) mgmt_pending <= 1'b1;
  312 
  313             // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N04] Only latch data_pending if fso_data_valid asserts while a
  314             // non-DATA frame (IDLE/MGMT/RETX) is currently busy, and clear it if fso_data_valid
  315             // drops during an active DATA frame.
  316             if (fso_data_valid && header_gen_busy && (payload_mux_sel != 2'b01)) begin
  317                 data_pending <= 1'b1;
  318             end else if (!fso_data_valid && active_data_in_flight) begin
  319                 data_pending <= 1'b0;
  320             end
  321 
  322             // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B11] Issue deferred delete when bus is not executing DATA/RETX
  323             if (pending_del_valid && !bus_busy_exec) begin
  324                 ddr4_delete_req   <= 1'b1;
  325                 ddr4_addr         <= pending_del_addr;
  326                 pending_del_valid <= 1'b0;
  327             end
  328 
  329             // A. Autonomous Timer Decrement & Max-Retry Exhaustion Drop
  330             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  331                 if (track_valid[i]) begin
  332                     if (track_timer[i] > 16'd0) begin
  333                         if (timer_tick_en) begin
  334                             track_timer[i] <= track_timer[i] - 1'b1;
  335                         end
  336                     end else if (drop_needed && (i[IDX_BITS-1:0] == drop_index) && !bus_busy_exec) begin
  337                         track_valid[i]  <= 1'b0;
  338                         ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  339                         ddr4_addr       <= {track_txfn[i][15:4], track_slot[i]};
  340                     end
  341                 end
  342             end
  343 
  344             // B. Process Incoming RX Feedback (ACK / NAK)
  345             // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B10 & B11] Match strictly against track_txfn[i] (never slot address!),
  346             // and defer ddr4_delete_req by 1 cycle if bus_busy_exec is active.
  347             if (rx_ack_valid_in) begin
  348                 for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  349                     if (track_valid[i] && (track_txfn[i] == rx_rxfn_in)) begin
  350                         if (rx_ack_in == 1'b1) begin
  351                             track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  352                             if (bus_busy_exec) begin
  353                                 pending_del_valid <= 1'b1;
  354                                 pending_del_addr  <= {track_txfn[i][15:4], track_slot[i]};
  355                             end else begin
  356                                 ddr4_delete_req   <= 1'b1;
  357                                 ddr4_addr         <= {track_txfn[i][15:4], track_slot[i]};
  358                             end
  359                         end else begin
  360                             track_timer[i] <= 16'd0;
  361                         end
  362                     end
  363                 end
  364             end
  365 
  366             // C. State Machine Command & Tracker Slot Execution
  367             case (state)
  368                 S_ARBITRATE: begin
  369                     if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)       target_index <= retx_index;
  370                     else if (data_req_active && free_found) target_index <= free_index;
  371                 end
  372 
  373                 S_EXEC_RETX: begin
  374                     tx_txfn_out     <= track_txfn[target_index];
  375                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  376                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b11;
  377                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  378                     ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b1;
  379                     ddr4_addr       <= {track_txfn[target_index][15:4], track_slot[target_index]};
  380 
  381                     track_retx[target_index]  <= track_retx[target_index] + 1'b1;
  382                     track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  383                 end
  384 
  385                 S_EXEC_MGMT: begin
  386                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  387                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b10;
  388                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b10;
  389                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  390                     mgmt_pending    <= 1'b0;
  391                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  392                 end
  393 
  394                 S_EXEC_DATA: begin
  395                     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A07] Keep tx_txfn_out strictly sequential (global_txfn)
  396                     // while routing ddr4_addr[3:0] to conflict-free physical slot alloc_phys_slot
  397                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  398                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  399                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b01;
  400                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  401                     ddr4_write_req  <= ~arq_disabled;
  402                     ddr4_addr       <= {global_txfn[15:4], alloc_phys_slot};
  403                     data_pending    <= 1'b0;
  404                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  405 
  406                     if (!arq_disabled && free_found) begin
  407                         track_valid[target_index] <= 1'b1;
  408                         track_txfn[target_index]  <= global_txfn;
  409                         track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  410                         track_retx[target_index]  <= 3'd0;
  411                         track_slot[target_index]  <= alloc_phys_slot;
  412                     end
  413                 end
  414 
  415                 S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  416                     tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  417                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  418                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  419                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  420                     global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  421                 end
  422             endcase
  423         end
  424     end
  425 
  426 endmodule

    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5 Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6 Module Name  : lpc_dec
    7 Description  : 24-bit to 16-bit Line Product Code (LPC) Sub-Decoder.
    8                Performs 2D horizontal (H[0:3]) and vertical (V[0:3]) parity 
    9                syndrome checking to correct single-bit errors in the 16-bit 
   10                encoded data matrix (E[0:15]) and reverses the differential 
   11                encoding to recover the 16-bit descrambled word (U[0:15]).
   12 
   13 Revision History:
   14   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 2D syndrome single-bit error corrector & differential decoder.
   15   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and added 
   16     corrected_bit_stb tracker for lpc_dec_top.v.
   17   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8]
   18     Added matching Active Disparity Management state tracker (running_disparity).
   19   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path, All 24-Bit Error Positions & Monitor Fix]
   20     Fixed clean-path false inversion and added internal monitor alias wires 
   21     (E_rx, P_rx, P_calc, SH, SV).
   22   - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Fix F05 - CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Vertical Parity E[8]]
   23     1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0..2.2 history.
   24     2. Synchronized vertical syndrome equations V[1:3] and P_calc[2:0] with lpc.v Rev 2.4
   25        by using E[8] (e_2,0) per CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Section 3.3.2.3.4 and Figure 2-13.
   26     3. Under the normative E[0]/E[8] coupling:
   27        - A single-bit error on E[0] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1000.
   28        - A single-bit error on E[8] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111.
   29        - Single-bit errors on the remaining 14 data bits produce (h_wt == 1 && v_wt == 1).
   30        This guarantees 100% orthogonal single-bit error correction across all 24 bit positions.
   31 ===========================================================================
   32 */
   33 
   34 module lpc_dec #(
   35     parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   36 )(

   50         integer idx;
   51         reg [4:0] sum;
   52         begin
   53             sum = 5'd0;
   54             for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
   55                 sum = sum + w[idx];
   56             end

  121     assign H[0] = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3]  ^ (~P[7]);
  122     assign H[1] = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7]  ^ (~P[6]) ^ E[0];
  123     assign H[2] = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11] ^ (~P[5]) ^ E[0];

  133     // - E[8] error (bit 15) flips H[2] and V[0..3] -> H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111

  219                     5'd4:  cdc4_RXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[2]};

  221                         cdc4_ACK        <= header_out[3];
  222                         cdc4_ACK_VALID  <= header_out[2];
  223                         cdc4_FRAME_TYPE <= header_out[1:0];
  224                     end
  225                     5'd10: cdc4_TX_TS     <= {header_out, hdr_buf[8], hdr_buf[7], hdr_buf[6], hdr_buf[5]};
  226                     5'd11: cdc4_TOD_SEC   <= header_out[5:0];
  227                     5'd12: begin
  228                         cdc4_TS_APPLIES <= header_out[6:4];
  229                         cdc4_FCCH_OP    <= header_out[3:0];
  230                     end
  231                     5'd14: cdc4_FCCH_PL   <= {header_out, hdr_buf[12]};
  232                     5'd16: cdc4_HDR_CRC16 <= {hdr_buf[14], header_out};
  233                 endcase
  234             end
  235 
  236             // 2. Payload Marker Extraction (Uses progressive cdc4_TXFN & cdc4_FRAME_TYPE)
  237             if (payload_dv) begin
  238                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd1) cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= payload_out;
  239                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd2) cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= payload_out;
  240 
  241                 // Frame 1 (DAT1): Extract 12-Byte ASCII Tag "Kookmin FSO " (Words 13, 14, 15)
  242                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd13 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  243                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[95:64] <= payload_out;
  244                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd14 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  245                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[63:32] <= payload_out;
  246                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd15 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  247                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[31:0]  <= payload_out;
  248 
  249                 // Frame 2 (DAT2): Extract Ethernet FCS 0xDEADBEEF at 100th segment byte (Word 27 or Word 26)
  250                 if ((out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd26 || out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd27) &&
  251                     (cdc4_TXFN == 16'd2) && (payload_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))
  252                     cdc4_ETH_FCS <= payload_out;
  253 
  254                 // Frame 4 (MGMT): Extract 64-bit IEEE-754 Range (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) across Words 3, 4, 5
  255                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd3) begin
  256                     mgmt_range_hi4 <= payload_out[3:0];
  257                     mgmt_range_lo4 <= payload_out[31:28];
  258                 end
  259                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd4)
  260                     mgmt_range_mid32 <= payload_out;
  261                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd5 && cdc4_FRAME_TYPE == 2'b10) begin
  262                     if (mgmt_range_hi4 != 4'd0)
  263                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {mgmt_range_hi4, mgmt_range_mid32, payload_out[31:4]};
  264                     else
  265                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4};
  266                 end
  267 
  268                 // Final 32-bit Word (Word 478): Extract FSO Payload CRC-32
  269                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd478)
  270                     cdc4_PLD_CRC32 <= payload_out;
  271             end
  272         end
  273     end
  274 
  275     // 3. Race-Free Negedge Queue Writer & Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1..1912 Bytes/frame)
  276     reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  277     integer    pld_wr_ptr, pld_rd_ptr;
  278     reg        pld_unpack_active;
  279 
  280     reg [7:0]  out_pld_byte_stream;
  281     reg [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt;    // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  282     reg [15:0] out_pld_total_bytes; // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  283     reg [31:0] cdc4_frame_id;       // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  284 
  285     initial begin
  286         pld_wr_ptr          = 0;
  287         pld_rd_ptr          = 0;
  288         pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  289         out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  290         out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  291         out_pld_total_bytes = 16'd0;
  292         cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  293     end
  294 
  295     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (1.6 ns before posedge clk_gth)
  296     always @(negedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  297         if (~rst_n) begin
  298             pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  299         end else if (payload_dv) begin
  300             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload_out[31:24];
  301             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload_out[23:16];
  302             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload_out[15:8];
  303             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload_out[7:0];
  304             pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 4;
  305         end
  306     end
  307 
  308     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  309     real next_cdc4_edge_ns;
  310     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  311         if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == st_load + 16'd3) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  312             pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  313             #0.001; // Align with payload_dv Word 1 at count == 23
  314             next_cdc4_edge_ns = $realtime;
  315             while (out_pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  316                 if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  317                     out_pld_byte_stream = payload_out[31:24];
  318                 else
  319                     out_pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  320 
  321                 pld_rd_ptr          = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  322                 out_pld_total_bytes = out_pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  323 
  324                 if (cdc4_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  325                     cdc4_frame_id    = 32'd1;
  326                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  327                 end else if (out_pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  328                     cdc4_frame_id    = cdc4_frame_id + 32'd1;
  329                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  330                 end else begin
  331                     out_pld_byte_cnt = out_pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  332                 end
  333 
  334                 next_cdc4_edge_ns = next_cdc4_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  335                 #((next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  336             end
  337             out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  338             out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  339             cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  340             pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  341         end
  342     end
  343     // synthesis translate_on
  344 
  345 endmodule

   33 module demux_preamble_128 (
   34     input  wire         clk,
   35     input  wire         rst_n,

   37     // Upstream Interface from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic @ 200 MHz)
   38     input  wire [127:0] cdc_data_in,

   55     // 1. INGRESS 128-BIT SYNCHRONOUS QUEUE (512 x 128-bit)

   57     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [127:0] in_queue [0:511];

   67     localparam ST_WAIT_FRAME = 2'd0;

   70     localparam ST_INTER_GAP  = 2'd3;

   79     wire [5:0]  bytes_consumed_now = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? 6'd9  :
   80                                      (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? 6'd12 : 6'd0;
   81     wire [5:0]  rem_bytes_after_op = buf_bytes - bytes_consumed_now;

   88

   90     always @(posedge clk) begin

  102             buf_bytes          <= 6'd0;

  104             lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  105             gap_cnt            <= 5'd0;

  107             preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;

  120             end

  123                 2'b01:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt - 10'd1;

  125             endcase

  161                     if (lpc_word_idx == 9'd258) begin

  163                         gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;

  165                     end else begin
  166                         lpc_word_idx <= lpc_word_idx + 9'd1;

  173                     end else begin

  176                     end
  177                 end
  178 
  179                 default: state <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  180             endcase
  181         end
  182     end

  204     initial begin

  223                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd12;
  224             end else begin
  225                 out_lpc_word_cnt <= out_lpc_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  226                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= out_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12;

149: wire        is_hdr_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd1 && count <= 16'd4);
150: wire        is_pld_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd5 && count <= 16'd259);
153: integer     desc_wr_ptr;
154: integer     desc_rd_ptr;
158: reg  [11:0] frame_byte_idx;    1 `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5 Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6 Module Name  : descrambler
    7 Description  : 64-bit Parallel Additive PRBS Descrambler.
    8                Processes 259 contiguous 64-bit words per frame (4 Header 
    9                words = 32B + 255 Payload words = 2040B; Total = 2072 Bytes).
   10                Resets the internal LFSR state to 'init' at the end of every
   11                259-word frame to maintain frame-synchronous descrambling.
   12 
   13                CRITICAL BUG FIXES (4 LFSR Matrix Typos Fixed to Match scrambler.v):
   14                1. B[27] : Fixed 1st XOR term from 'B[26][63] ^ B[26][61]' to 'B[26][64] ^ B[26][61]'.
   15                2. B[58] : Fixed 22nd XOR term from 'B[57][44] ^ B[57][40]' to 'B[57][43] ^ B[57][40]'.
   16                3. B[60] : Fixed slice prefix from 'B[58][4:0]' to 'B[59][4:0]'.
   17                4. B[61] : Fixed 41st XOR term from 'B[60][25] ^ B[60][21]' to 'B[60][24] ^ B[60][21]'.
   18 
   19 Revision History:
   20   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 64-bit parallel descrambler with 4 matrix fixes.
   21   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and preserved 
   22     simulation byte unpackers (out_byte_cnt 1..2072, desc_frame_id 1..4).
   23   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 4 - SDA OISL Page 39-40, Table 2-17 & Fig. 2-12]
   24     Updated PRBS generator to the 25-bit shift register X[24:0] initialized with
   25     SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007 at the start of every frame header and unrolled 64 bits
   26     per cycle (step_prbs25_64) to match scrambler.v Rev 2.00 bit-for-bit.
   27 ===========================================================================
   28 */
   29 
   30 module descrambler (
   31     input  wire        clk,
   32     input  wire        rst_n,
   33     input  wire        en,
   34     input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   35     output wire        flag,
   36     output wire [63:0] data_out
   37 );
   38 
   39     parameter max  = 258;
   40     reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   41 
   42     parameter IDLE   = 3'b001;
   43     parameter ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   44     parameter END    = 3'b100;
   45 
   46     reg [2:0] state;
   47     reg [2:0] next_state;
   48 
   49     parameter init = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   50     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   51     parameter [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   52 
   53     reg  [63:0] data_in_d0;
   54     reg  [63:0] scr_out;
   55     wire [63:0] S;
   56 
   57     reg  [24:0] Q = SEED_INIT;
   58     wire [24:0] D;
   59 
   60     function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   61         reg [24:0] sr;
   62         reg [63:0] s_vec;
   63         reg        fb;
   64         integer    k;
   65         begin
   66             sr = q_in;
   67             for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   68                 s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];
   69                 fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
   70                 sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
   71             end
   72             step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   73         end
   74     endfunction
   75 
   76     wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   77     assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   78     assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   79 
   80     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   81         if (~rst_n)
   82             state <= IDLE;
   83         else
   84             state <= next_state;
   85     end
   86 
   87     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   88         if (~rst_n)
   89             count <= 16'd0;
   90         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   91             count <= count + 1'b1;
   92         else
   93             count <= 16'd0;
   94     end
   95 
   96     always @(*) begin
   97         case (state)
   98             IDLE: begin
   99                 if (en)
  100                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  101                 else
  102                     next_state = IDLE;
  103             end
  104             ACTIVE: begin
  105                 if (count < max)
  106                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  107                 else
  108                     next_state = END;
  109             end
  110             END:     next_state = IDLE;
  111             default: next_state = IDLE;
  112         endcase
  113     end
  114 
  115     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116         if (~rst_n)
  117             data_in_d0 <= 64'b0;
  118         else
  119             data_in_d0 <= data_in;
  120     end
  121 
  122     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123         if (~rst_n)
  124             Q <= SEED_INIT;
  125         else if (state == ACTIVE)
  126             Q <= D;
  127         else
  128             Q <= SEED_INIT;
  129     end
  130 
  131     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  132         if (~rst_n)
  133             scr_out <= 64'd0;
  134         else if (state == ACTIVE)
  135             scr_out <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  136         else
  137             scr_out <= 64'd0;
  138     end
  139 
  140     assign flag     = (count != 0);
  141     assign data_out = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  142 
  143     // =====================================================================
  144     // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 259-WORD COUNTER & 2072-BYTE STREAM UNPACKER
  145     // =====================================================================
  146     // synthesis translate_off
  147     wire [8:0]  out_word64_cnt  = flag ? count[8:0] : 9'd0;
  148     wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt    = flag ? (count[11:0] * 12'd8) : 12'd0;
  149     wire        is_hdr_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd1 && count <= 16'd4);
  150     wire        is_pld_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd5 && count <= 16'd259);
  151 
  152     reg  [7:0]  desc_sim_q [0:16383];
  153     integer     desc_wr_ptr;
  154     integer     desc_rd_ptr;
  155     reg         desc_unpack_active;
  156 
  157     reg  [7:0]  byte_stream_out;
  158     reg  [11:0] frame_byte_idx;
  159     reg  [31:0] desc_frame_id;
  160     reg  [15:0] desc_total_bytes;
  161 
  162     initial begin
  163         desc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  164         desc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  165         desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  166         byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  167         frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  168         desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  169         desc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  170     end
  171 
  172     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  173         if (~rst_n) begin
  174             desc_wr_ptr = 0;
  175         end else if (flag) begin
  176             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  177             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  178             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  179             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  180             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  181             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  182             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  183             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  184             desc_wr_ptr                 = desc_wr_ptr + 8;
  185         end
  186     end
  187 
  188     real next_desc_edge_ns;
  189     always @(posedge clk) begin
  190         if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == 16'd0) && !desc_unpack_active) begin
  191             desc_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  192             @(posedge clk);
  193             #0.001;
  194             next_desc_edge_ns = $realtime;
  195             while (desc_total_bytes < 16'd8288) begin
  196                 if (desc_rd_ptr == 0)
  197                     byte_stream_out = data_out[63:56];
  198                 else
  199                     byte_stream_out = desc_sim_q[desc_rd_ptr];
  200 
  201                 desc_rd_ptr      = desc_rd_ptr + 1;
  202                 desc_total_bytes = desc_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  203 
  204                 if (desc_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  205                     desc_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  206                     frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  207                 end else if (frame_byte_idx == 12'd2072) begin
  208                     desc_frame_id  = desc_frame_id + 32'd1;
  209                     frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  210                 end else begin
  211                     frame_byte_idx = frame_byte_idx + 12'd1;
  212                 end
  213 
  214                 next_desc_edge_ns = next_desc_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 2072.0);
  215                 #((next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  216             end
  217             byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  218             frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  219             desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  220             desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  221         end
  222     end
  223     // synthesis translate_on
  224 
  225 endmodule

  103     endfunction

  105     wire [31:0] wr_frame_cnt_gth = gray2bin32(wr_frame_gray_sync2);
  106 
  107     // =======================================================
  108     // 2. ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (128-bit @ 200M -> 32-bit @ 312.5M)
  109     // =======================================================
  110     reg  [11:0] pop_word_idx;
  111     wire         need_word;
  112     wire        fifo_rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && need_word;
  113 
  114     cross_logic_gth u_async_fifo (
  115         .srst        (~rst_n),
  116         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  117         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  118         .din         (data_in),
  119         .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
  120         .rd_en       (fifo_rd_en),
  121         .dout        (fifo_dout),
  122         .full        (fifo_full),
  123         .empty       (fifo_empty),
  124         .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  125         .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
  126     );
  127 
  128     // =======================================================
  129     // 3. READ DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 3117-BYTE BARREL SHIFTER
  130     // =======================================================
  131     reg  [1:0]  pipe_valid;
  132     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_0;
  133     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_1;
  134     wire [2:0]  popped_valid_bytes = (pop_word_idx == 12'd779) ? 3'd1 : 3'd4;
  135 
  136     reg  [95:0] shift_reg;
  137     reg  [4:0]  avail_bytes;
  138     reg         stream_active;
  139     reg  [31:0] rd_frame_cnt;
  140     reg  [11:0] rd_frame_bytes;
  141 
  142     wire        has_4_bytes    = (avail_bytes >= 5'd4);
  143     wire        is_final_flush = stream_active && (rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1 >= wr_frame_cnt_gth) &&
  144                                  fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) &&
  145                                  (avail_bytes > 5'd0) && (avail_bytes < 5'd4);
  146     wire [4:0]  bytes_consumed = has_4_bytes ? 5'd4 : (is_final_flush ? avail_bytes : 5'd0);
  147     wire [4:0]  next_avail_pre = avail_bytes - bytes_consumed;
  148 
  149     assign need_word = stream_active && (avail_bytes <= 5'd8);
  150 
  151     wire [95:0] shifted_reg    = shift_reg << (bytes_consumed * 8);
  152     wire [95:0] incoming_alg   = ({fifo_dout, 64'd0} &
  153                                   ((pipe_bytes_1 == 3'd1) ? 96'hFF00_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000 :
  154                                                             96'hFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000_0000_0000))
  155                                  >> (next_avail_pre * 8);
  156 
  157     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  158         if (!rst_n) begin
  159             pop_word_idx   <= 12'd0;
  160             pipe_valid     <= 2'b00;
  161             pipe_bytes_0   <= 3'd0;
  162             pipe_bytes_1   <= 3'd0;
  163             shift_reg      <= 96'd0;
  164             avail_bytes    <= 5'd0;
  165             stream_active  <= 1'b0;
  166             rd_frame_cnt   <= 32'd0;
  167             rd_frame_bytes <= 12'd0;
  168             flag           <= 1'b0;
  169             data_out       <= 32'd0;
  170         end else begin
  171             // 2-Cycle FIFO Read Pipeline (C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
  172             pipe_valid[0] <= fifo_rd_en;
  173             pipe_valid[1] <= pipe_valid[0];
  174             pipe_bytes_0  <= fifo_rd_en ? popped_valid_bytes : 3'd0;
  175             pipe_bytes_1  <= pipe_bytes_0;
  176 
  177             if (fifo_rd_en) begin
  178                 if (pop_word_idx == 12'd779)
  179                     pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  180                 else
  181                     pop_word_idx <= pop_word_idx + 12'd1;
  182             end else if (!stream_active && fifo_empty) begin
  183                 pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  184             end
  185 
  186             // Start streaming once at least 1 complete frame is buffered in FIFO
  187             if (!stream_active) begin
  188                 if (wr_frame_cnt_gth > rd_frame_cnt) begin
  189                     stream_active <= 1'b1;
  190                 end
  191                 flag     <= 1'b0;
  192                 data_out <= 32'd0;
  193             end else begin
  194                 if (has_4_bytes || is_final_flush) begin
  195                     flag     <= 1'b1;
  196                     data_out <= shift_reg[95:64];
  197                     if (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed} >= 12'd3117) begin
  198                         rd_frame_bytes <= (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed}) - 12'd3117;
  199                         rd_frame_cnt   <= rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
  200                     end else begin
  201                         rd_frame_bytes <= rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed};
  202                     end
  203                 end else begin
  204                     flag     <= 1'b0;
  205                     data_out <= 32'd0;
  206                     if (fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) && (avail_bytes == 5'd0)) begin
  207                         stream_active <= 1'b0;
  208                     end
  209                 end
  210             end
  211 
  212             // Update Barrel Shifter
  213             if (pipe_valid[1]) begin
  214                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg | incoming_alg;
  215                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre + {2'd0, pipe_bytes_1};
  216             end else begin
  217                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg;
  218                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre;
  219             end
  220         end
  221     end
  222 
  223     // =======================================================
  224     // 4. SUB-CYCLE 0.8 NS BYTE & FRAME TRACKERS (For Waveform)
  225     // =======================================================
  226     reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  227     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  228     reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  229     reg [31:0] frame_out_id;
  230 
  231 `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  232     integer b_sub;
  233     reg [31:0] cur_w;
  234     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  235         if (!rst_n) begin
  236             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  237             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  238             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  239             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  240         end else begin
  241             #0.001;
  242             if (flag) begin
  243                 cur_w = data_out;
  244                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  245                     frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  246                     out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  247                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  248                 end else begin
  249                     out_clk_cnt    = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  250                 end
  251 
  252                 for (b_sub = 0; b_sub < 4; b_sub = b_sub + 1) begin
  253                     if (b_sub > 0) #(0.8);
  254                     byte_out = cur_w[31 - (b_sub * 8) -: 8];
  255                     if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  256                         frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  257                         frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  258                         out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  259                     end else begin
  260                         frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  261                     end
  262                 end
  263             end else begin
  264                 byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  265                 out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  266                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  267                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  268             end
  269         end
  270     end
  271 `else
  272     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  273         if (!rst_n) begin
  274             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  275             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  276             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  277             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  278         end else if (flag) begin
  279             byte_out       <= data_out[31:24];
  280             out_clk_cnt    <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  281             frame_byte_cnt <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3114) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd4);
  282             if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  283         end else begin
  284             byte_out       <= 8'h00;

   23     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_2 = 32'h6D_69_6E_20, // ASCII "min "
   24     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_3 = 32'h46_53_4F_20  // ASCII "FSO "
   25 )(
   26     input  wire        clk,
   27     input  wire        rst_n,
   28     input  wire        trigger,           // Trigger 1 cycle HIGH to fire
   29     input  wire [15:0] frame_size_bytes,  // Target size (e.g., 2000 for Jumbo)
   30     
   31     // --- AXI4-Stream Output ---
   32     output reg [31:0]  m_axis_tdata,
   33     output reg [3:0]   m_axis_tkeep,
   34     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   35     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   36     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   37 );
   38 
   39     localparam S_IDLE = 2'd0, S_DATA = 2'd1, S_DONE = 2'd2;
   40 
   41     reg [1:0]  state;
   42     reg [15:0] word_count; 
   43     reg [15:0] total_words;
   44 
   45     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46         if (~rst_n) begin
   47             state         <= S_IDLE;
   48             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   49             m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'd0;
   50             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   51             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   52             word_count    <= 16'd0;
   53             total_words   <= 16'd0;
   54         end else begin
   55             case (state)
   56                 S_IDLE: begin
   57                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   58                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   59                     word_count    <= 16'd0;
   60                     if (trigger) begin
   61                         // Convert bytes to 32-bit words (divide by 4)
   62                         total_words <= frame_size_bytes >> 2; 
   63                         state       <= S_DATA;
   64                     end
   65                 end
   66 
   67                 S_DATA: begin
   68                     // Backpressure control: only advance if receiver is ready
   69                     if (m_axis_tready || !m_axis_tvalid) begin
   70                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   71                         m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'hF; // All 4 bytes valid
   72 
   73                         // Packet Assembly Multiplexer
   74                         case (word_count)
   75                             // Ethernet MAC Header
   76                             16'd0: m_axis_tdata <= DEST_MAC[47:16]; 
   77                             16'd1: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_MAC[15:0], SRC_MAC[47:32]};
   78                             16'd2: m_axis_tdata <= SRC_MAC[31:0];
   79                             16'd3: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType (IPv4) + IP Header
   80                             
   81                             // IP & UDP Headers
   82                             16'd4: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h002E_0000; 
   83                             16'd5: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h4000_4011; // Protocol UDP
   84                             16'd6: m_axis_tdata <= {16'h0000, SRC_IP[31:16]}; 
   85                             16'd7: m_axis_tdata <= {SRC_IP[15:0], DEST_IP[31:16]}; 
   86                             16'd8: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_IP[15:0], 16'h1234}; 
   87                             
   88                             // Payload Data
   89                             16'd9:  m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_1; 
   90                             16'd10: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_2; 
   91                             16'd11: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_3; 
   92                             
   93                             // End of Frame & Padding
   94                             (total_words - 1): m_axis_tdata <= 32'hDEADBEEF; // Simulated FCS
   95                             default: m_axis_tdata <= {16'hAAAA, word_count}; // Dummy Jumbo Data
   96                         endcase
   97 
   98                         // Frame termination logic
   99                         if (word_count == (total_words - 1)) begin
  100                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b1;
  101                             state        <= S_DONE;
  102                         end else begin
  103                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b0;
  104                             word_count   <= word_count + 1'b1;
  105                         end
  106                     end
  107                 end
  108 
  109                 S_DONE: begin
  110                     // Wait for last word to be accepted
  111                     if (m_axis_tready && m_axis_tvalid) begin
  112                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  113                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  114                         state         <= S_IDLE;
  115                     end
  116                 end
  117             endcase
  118         end
  119     end
  120 endmodule

  114 
  115     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B04 & B05] Accept Ethernet payload words strictly when frame magic is valid,
  116     // a packet is currently active, and rem_pkt_bytes > 0 (never dropping zero-valued data words!)
  117     wire is_eth_data_word  = fso_accept && (!is_word0) && fso_frame_valid_magic &&
  118                              pkt_active && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0);
  119     wire is_final_eth_word = is_eth_data_word && (rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd4);
  120 
  121     wire drain_word_en;
  122     wire pkt_drain_done;
  123 
  124     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
  125     always @(posedge clk) begin
  126         if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  127             pkt_buf[wr_ptr] <= {is_final_eth_word, s_axis_fso_tdata};
  128         end
  129     end
  130 
  131     // De-Segmentation, Magic Validation, Sequence-Gap Rollback & Table 2-18 Parser FSM
  132     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  133         if (!rst_n) begin
  134             fso_word_idx          <= 9'd0;
  135             fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  136             expected_fso_seq      <= 10'd0;
  137             seq_initialized       <= 1'b0;
  138             pkt_active            <= 1'b0;
  139             in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  140             rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  141             target_pkt_bytes      <= 16'd0;
  142             wr_ptr                <= 12'd0;
  143             committed_wr_ptr      <= 12'd0;
  144             uncommit_words        <= 13'd0;
  145             reassembled_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  146             reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  147         end else if (fso_accept) begin
  148             if (s_axis_fso_tlast || (fso_word_idx == 9'd476))
  149                 fso_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  150             else
  151                 fso_word_idx <= fso_word_idx + 9'd1;
  152 
  153             if (is_word0) begin
  154                 // Word 0: Validate FSO Payload Header Magic (8'hAB) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  155                 if (is_pld_hdr) begin
  156                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b1;
  157                     seq_initialized       <= 1'b1;
  158                     expected_fso_seq      <= rx_fso_seq + 10'd1;
  159 
  160                     if (seq_gap_err) begin
  161                         // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B06] Sequence gap detected: rollback partial packet!
  162                         pkt_active     <= 1'b0;
  163                         in_cont_frame  <= 1'b0;
  164                         rem_pkt_bytes  <= 16'd0;
  165                         wr_ptr         <= committed_wr_ptr;
  166                         uncommit_words <= 13'd0;
  167                     end else if (pkt_active && (pld_hdr_len != 14'd0)) begin
  168                         // Valid Table 2-18 Continuation Frame
  169                         in_cont_frame  <= 1'b1;
  170                         rem_pkt_bytes  <= {2'b00, pld_hdr_len};
  171                     end else begin
  172                         // New initial frame boundary (if previous packet was incomplete, roll it back)
  173                         if (pkt_active) begin
  174                             pkt_active     <= 1'b0;
  175                             rem_pkt_bytes  <= 16'd0;
  176                             wr_ptr         <= committed_wr_ptr;
  177                             uncommit_words <= 13'd0;
  178                         end
  179                         in_cont_frame <= 1'b0;
  180                     end
  181                 end else begin
  182                     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B05] Invalid Payload Header magic: discard entire FSO frame!
  183                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  184                     in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  185                 end
  186             end else if (is_pkt_hdr) begin
  187                 // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B07] Start of new Ethernet packet (0xCDEF header)
  188                 pkt_active       <= 1'b1;
  189                 rem_pkt_bytes    <= {2'b00, pkt_hdr_len};
  190                 target_pkt_bytes <= {2'b00, pkt_hdr_len};
  191                 uncommit_words   <= 13'd0;
  192             end else if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  193                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  194                 if (is_final_eth_word) begin
  195                     rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  196                     pkt_active            <= 1'b0;
  197                     in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  198                     committed_wr_ptr      <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  199                     uncommit_words        <= 13'd0;
  200                     reassembled_pkt_bytes <= target_pkt_bytes;
  201                     reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= reassembled_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
  202                 end else begin
  203                     rem_pkt_bytes  <= rem_pkt_bytes - 16'd4;
  204                     uncommit_words <= uncommit_words + 13'd1;
  205                 end
  206             end
  207         end
  208     end
  209 
  210     // Track Buffer Occupancy (with Sequence-Gap Rollback Support) and 11-Bit Committed Packet Count
  211     wire pkt_commit_pulse = is_final_eth_word;
  212     wire rollback_now     = fso_accept && is_word0 && (
  213                             (is_pld_hdr && seq_gap_err && pkt_active) ||
  214                             (is_pld_hdr && !seq_gap_err && pkt_active && (pld_hdr_len == 14'd0))
  215                             );
  216 
  217     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  218         if (!rst_n) begin
  219             buf_used       <= 13'd0;
  220             commit_pkt_cnt <= 11'd0;
  221         end else begin
  222             if (rollback_now) begin
  223                 buf_used <= buf_used - uncommit_words - (drain_word_en ? 13'd1 : 13'd0);
  224             end else if (is_eth_data_word && !drain_word_en) begin
  225                 buf_used <= buf_used + 13'd1;
  226             end else if (!is_eth_data_word && drain_word_en) begin
  227                 buf_used <= buf_used - 13'd1;
  228             end
  229 
  230             if (pkt_commit_pulse && !pkt_drain_done)
  231                 commit_pkt_cnt <= commit_pkt_cnt + 11'd1;
  232             else if (!pkt_commit_pulse && pkt_drain_done)
  233                 commit_pkt_cnt <= commit_pkt_cnt - 11'd1;
  234         end
  235     end
  236 
  237     // =======================================================
  238     // 2. ETHERNET PREAMBLE INJECTION (eth_preamble_gen + mux_eth_32)
  239     //    [Rev 2.9 - Fix B02]: Exact port mapping and 2-word tail flush
  240     // =======================================================
  241     localparam DR_IDLE       = 2'd0,
  242                DR_STREAM     = 2'd1,
  243                DR_FLUSH_TAIL = 2'd2;
  244 
  245     reg  [1:0]  dr_state;
  246     wire [63:0] preamble_sfd_wire;
  247     wire [32:0] head_buf_word = pkt_buf[rd_ptr];
  248 
  249     reg  [31:0] asm_data_in;
  250     reg         asm_valid_in;
  251     reg         asm_last_in;
  252 
  253     assign drain_word_en  = (dr_state == DR_STREAM) && asm_valid_in && m_axis_eth_tready;
  254     assign pkt_drain_done = drain_word_en && asm_last_in;
  255 
  256     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  257         if (!rst_n) begin
  258             dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  259             rd_ptr   <= 12'd0;
  260         end else begin
  261             case (dr_state)
  262                 DR_IDLE: begin
  263                     if ((commit_pkt_cnt > 11'd0) && m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  264                         dr_state <= DR_STREAM;
  265                     end
  266                 end
  267                 DR_STREAM: begin
  268                     if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  269                         rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  270                         if (head_buf_word[32]) begin
  271                             // Last word of Ethernet payload fed into mux_eth_32; wait for
  272                             // mux_eth_32 to flush its 2 delayed words and assert m_axis_eth_tlast
  273                             dr_state <= DR_FLUSH_TAIL;
  274                         end
  275                     end
  276                 end
  277                 DR_FLUSH_TAIL: begin
  278                     if (m_axis_eth_tvalid && m_axis_eth_tready && m_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  279                         dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  280                     end
  281                 end
  282                 default: dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  283             endcase
  284         end
  285     end
  286 
  287     always @(*) begin
  288         if (dr_state == DR_STREAM && m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  289             asm_valid_in = 1'b1;
  290             asm_data_in  = head_buf_word[31:0];
  291             asm_last_in  = head_buf_word[32];
  292         end else begin
  293             asm_valid_in = 1'b0;
  294             asm_data_in  = 32'd0;
  295             asm_last_in  = 1'b0;
  296         end
  297     end
  298 
  299     eth_preamble_gen u_eth_preamble_gen (
  300         .preamble_sfd (preamble_sfd_wire)
  301     );
  302 
  303     mux_eth_32 u_mux_eth_32 (
  304         .clk          (clk),
  305         .rst_n        (rst_n),
  306         .preamble_sfd (preamble_sfd_wire),
  307         .asm_data_in  (asm_data_in),
  308         .asm_valid_in (asm_valid_in),
  309         .asm_last_in  (asm_last_in),
  310         .m_axis_tdata (m_axis_eth_tdata),
  311         .m_axis_tvalid(m_axis_eth_tvalid),
  312         .m_axis_tlast (m_axis_eth_tlast),
  313         .m_axis_tready(m_axis_eth_tready)
  314     );

   10                Processes 14 Bytes of Header data sequentially (8-bit/clock).
   11 ===========================================================================
   12 */
   13 
   14 module fso_crc_16 #(parameter max = 15) (
   15     input  wire       clk,
   16     input  wire       rst_n,
   17     input  wire       en,
   18     input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   19     output wire       flag,
   20     output wire [7:0] data_out
   21 );
   22 
   23     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   24 
   25     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   26     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   27     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   28 
   29     reg [2:0] state, next_state;
   30     reg [7:0] temp, crc_out;
   31 
   32     wire [15:0] D;
   33     reg  [15:0] Q = 16'b0;
   34     reg  [15:0] R = 16'b0;
   35 
   36     // FSM State Register
   37     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   38         if (~rst_n) state <= IDLE;
   39         else        state <= next_state;
   40     end
   41 
   42     // Byte Counter
   43     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44         if (~rst_n) count <= 8'd0;
   45         else if (state == ACTIVE) count <= count + 1'b1;
   46         else count <= 8'd0;
   47     end
   48 
   49     // Next State Logic
   50     always @(*) begin
   51         case(state)
   52             IDLE:    next_state = en ? ACTIVE : IDLE;
   53             ACTIVE:  next_state = (count < max) ? ACTIVE : END;
   54             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   55             default: next_state = IDLE;
   56         endcase
   57     end
   58 
   59     // Input Register
   60     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   61         if (~rst_n) temp <= 8'd0;
   62         else        temp <= data_in;

   65     // Shift Register Processing
   66     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67         if(~rst_n) begin
   68             Q <= 16'b0;
   69             R <= 16'b0;
   70         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   71             if (count < max) begin
   72                 Q <= D;
   73                 if (count == max - 2) R <= D; // Latch final CRC
   74             end else begin
   75                 Q <= 16'b0;
   76                 R <= 16'b0;
   77             end
   78         end
   79     end

   88         end
   89     end

   14   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Header CRC-16 verifier.
   15   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-16 Verification]
   16     Added parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0 (disabled by default) so operational 
   17     synthesis and compliance verification strictly require (rx_crc_word == Q) 
   18     without accepting the legacy simulation marker (16'hC160 + TXFN).
   19 ===========================================================================
   20 */
   21 
   22 module fso_crc_16_checker #(
   23     parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   24 )(
   25     input  wire       clk,
   26     input  wire       rst_n,
   27     input  wire       en,             // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   28     input  wire [7:0] data_in,        // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   29     output reg        hdr_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse after 16th byte
   30     output reg        hdr_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-16 PASS, 0 = CRC-16 FAIL
   31     output reg [15:0] calculated_crc,
   32     output reg [15:0] received_crc
   33 );
   34 
   35     reg [4:0]  byte_cnt;
   36     reg [15:0] Q;
   37     reg [7:0]  txfn_lsb;
   38     reg [7:0]  txfn_msb;
   39     reg [7:0]  crc_msb_rx;
   40 
   41     // Parallel LFSR feedback equations for x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
   42     wire [15:0] D;
   43     assign D[0]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12];
   44     assign D[1]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   45     assign D[2]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   46     assign D[3]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   47     assign D[4]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[12];
   48     assign D[5]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13];
   49     assign D[6]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14];
   50     assign D[7]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15];
   51     assign D[8]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[0]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   52     assign D[9]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[1]  ^ Q[12];
   53     assign D[10] = data_in[5] ^ Q[2]  ^ Q[13];
   54     assign D[11] = data_in[6] ^ Q[3]  ^ Q[14];
   55     assign D[12] = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[4]  ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15];
   56     assign D[13] = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[5]  ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   57     assign D[14] = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[6]  ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   58     assign D[15] = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[7]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   59 
   60     wire [15:0] rx_crc_word    = {crc_msb_rx, data_in};
   61     wire [15:0] sim_marker_crc = 16'hC160 + {txfn_msb, txfn_lsb};
   62 
   63     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64         if (!rst_n) begin
   65             byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   66             Q              <= 16'd0;
   67             txfn_lsb       <= 8'd0;
   68             txfn_msb       <= 8'd0;
   69             crc_msb_rx     <= 8'd0;
   70             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   71             hdr_crc_ok     <= 1'b0;
   72             calculated_crc <= 16'd0;
   73             received_crc   <= 16'd0;
   74         end else begin
   75             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   76 
   77             if (en) begin
   78                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd0)  txfn_lsb <= data_in;
   79                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd1)  txfn_msb <= data_in;
   80 
   81                 if (byte_cnt < 5'd14) begin
   82                     // Bytes 0..13: Accumulate CRC-16 over 14-Byte Header
   83                     Q        <= D;
   84                     byte_cnt <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   85                 end else if (byte_cnt == 5'd14) begin
   86                     // Byte 14: Capture received CRC-16 MSB
   87                     crc_msb_rx <= data_in;
   88                     byte_cnt   <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   89                 end else begin
   90                     // Byte 15 (16th Byte): Capture CRC-16 LSB and verify
   91                     calculated_crc <= Q;
   92                     received_crc   <= rx_crc_word;
   93                     hdr_check_done <= 1'b1;
   94                     hdr_crc_ok     <= (rx_crc_word == Q) ||
   95                                       (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && (rx_crc_word == sim_marker_crc));
   96                     byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   97                     Q              <= 16'd0;
   98                 end
   99             end else begin
  100                 byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
  101                 Q        <= 16'd0;
  102             end
  103         end
  104     end
  105 
  106 endmodule

    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj, Irzal Zaini, & Giovanni Dwi
    6 Description  : SDA OISL FSO CRC-32 Generator (AXI4-Stream Compliant).
    7                Utilizes parallel 32-bit XOR tree for zero-latency computation.
    8                Dynamic FSM intercepts the `tlast` signal from the 1908-Byte 
    9                payload, suppresses it, appends the 4-Byte calculated CRC, 
   10                and re-asserts the true `tlast` at the 1912th Byte.
   11 ===========================================================================
   12 */
   13 
   14 module fso_crc_32 (
   15     input  wire        clk,
   16     input  wire        rst_n,
   17 
   18     // Input from fso_payload.v (1908 Bytes / 477 Words)
   19     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   20     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   21     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   22     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   23 
   24     // Output to fifo_data (1912 Bytes / 478 Words)
   25     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   26     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   27     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   28     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   29 );
   30 
   31     localparam S_DATA = 1'b0, S_CRC = 1'b1;
   32     reg state;
   33 
   34     reg  [31:0] crc_reg;
   35     wire [31:0] next_crc;
   36 
   37     // =======================================================
   38     // AXI4-Stream Handshake Logic
   39     // =======================================================
   40     // We can accept new data if we are in S_DATA and the output 
   41     // register is either empty (!m_axis_tvalid) or being read this cycle.
   42     assign s_axis_tready = (state == S_DATA) && (!m_axis_tvalid || m_axis_tready);
   43     
   44     wire fire_in  = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   45     wire fire_out = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   46 
   47     // =======================================================
   48     // Dynamic FSM & Data Pipeline
   49     // =======================================================
   50     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   51         if (!rst_n) begin
   52             state         <= S_DATA;
   53             crc_reg       <= 32'd0;
   54             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   55             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   56             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   57         end else begin
   58             // Clear valid flag if downstream accepted the data
   59             if (fire_out) begin
   60                 m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   61             end
   62 
   63             case (state)
   64                 S_DATA: begin
   65                     if (fire_in) begin
   66                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   67                         m_axis_tdata  <= s_axis_tdata; // Passthrough payload
   68                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;         // Suppress incoming tlast
   69                         crc_reg       <= next_crc;     // Update running CRC
   70 
   71                         // Intercept the end of the payload
   72                         if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   73                             state <= S_CRC;
   74                         end
   75                     end
   76                 end
   77 
   78                 S_CRC: begin
   79                     // Wait until output is free to append the CRC
   80                     if (!m_axis_tvalid || fire_out) begin
   81                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   82                         m_axis_tdata  <= crc_reg;      // Inject 4-Byte CRC
   83                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b1;         // Assert true end of frame
   84                         crc_reg       <= 32'd0;        // Reset CRC for next frame
   85                         state         <= S_DATA;       // Loop back
   86                     end
   87                 end
   88             endcase
   89         end
   90     end
   91

   93     // Combinational Parallel 32-bit CRC XOR Tree
   94     // Adapted from Irzal Zaini's original architecture

   54 module fso_idle_generator (
   55     input  wire        clk,
   56     input  wire        rst_n,
   57 
   58     // Current Transmit Frame Number from ARQ TX Controller

   68     // =======================================================
   69     // 1. PRBS GENERATOR ENGINE (1908 Bytes = 477 Words)
   70     // Uses the 25-bit Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   71     // seeded dynamically with (TXFN + 1) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2.
   72     // =======================================================
   73     localparam MAX_WORDS = 9'd477; // 477 words * 4 bytes = 1908 Bytes
   74

  102     wire [24:0] seed_val = (raw_seed == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : raw_seed;

  104     // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R16] Exact 32-step unrolled Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
  105     // Identical recurrence (fb = sr[0] ^ sr[3]) and shift orientation to scrambler.v
  106     function [56:0] step_prbs25_32(input [24:0] q_in);
  107         reg [24:0] sr;
  108         reg [31:0] w_out;
  109         reg        fb;
  110         integer    k;
  111         begin
  112             sr = (q_in == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : q_in;
  113             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  114                 w_out[31 - k] = sr[0];
  115                 fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
  116                 sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
  117             end
  118             step_prbs25_32 = {sr, w_out};
  119         end
  120     endfunction
  121 
  122     // Zero-initial-state IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 step function (matching fso_crc_32.v 100%)
  123     function [31:0] next_crc32_word(input [31:0] crc_in, input [31:0] data_w);
  124         reg [31:0] c;
  125         reg        fb_bit;
  126         integer    b;
  127         begin
  128             c = crc_in;
  129             for (b = 31; b >= 0; b = b - 1) begin
  130                 fb_bit = c[31] ^ data_w[b];
  131                 c      = {c[30:0], 1'b0} ^ (fb_bit ? 32'h04C1_1DB7 : 32'h0000_0000);
  132             end
  133             next_crc32_word = c;
  134         end
  135     endfunction

  137     wire [24:0] active_q_in = (word_cnt == 9'd0) ? seed_val : lfsr_q;
  138     wire [56:0] prbs_next   = step_prbs25_32(active_q_in);

  140     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B15 & B16] Output Stage with Stall-Stability Lock:
  141     // - While m_axis_tready == 0 and out_hold_valid == 1 (stalled at first beat in 
  142     //   idle_firstbeat_stall.sv), m_axis_tvalid and m_axis_tdata remain 100% frozen!

  168     wire   sub_rst_n       = rst_n && !(need_live_reseed || direct_reseed_mode);

  170     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  171         if (!rst_n) begin
  172             out_hold_valid        <= 1'b0;
  173             out_hold_data         <= 32'd0;
  174             out_hold_last         <= 1'b0;
  175             out_hold_txfn         <= 16'd0;

  177             direct_reseed_mode    <= 1'b0;
  178             direct_word_idx       <= 9'd0;

  180             direct_crc_acc        <= 32'd0;
  181         end else begin
  182             if (need_live_reseed) begin
  183                 // First beat accepted simultaneously with a new txfn_in: lock onto live seed
  184                 out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b1;
  185                 direct_reseed_mode    <= 1'b1;

  187                 direct_word_idx       <= 9'd1;
  188                 direct_lfsr_q         <= direct_step[56:32];
  189                 direct_crc_acc        <= next_crc32_word(32'd0, direct_step[31:0]);
  190 
  191                 // Prepare Word 1 into out_hold_data for the next cycle
  192                 out_hold_valid        <= 1'b1;
  193                 out_hold_data         <= step_prbs25_32(direct_step[56:32])[31:0];
  194                 out_hold_last         <= 1'b0;
  195             end else if (direct_reseed_mode) begin
  196                 if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin

  199                         direct_reseed_mode    <= 1'b0;
  200                         direct_word_idx       <= 9'd0;

  203                         out_hold_valid        <= 1'b1;

  208                         direct_lfsr_q   <= direct_step[56:32];

  213                             out_hold_data <= next_crc32_word(direct_crc_acc, out_hold_data);

  215                         end else begin
  216                             out_hold_data <= step_prbs25_32(direct_step[56:32])[31:0];
  217                             out_hold_last <= 1'b0;
  218                         end
  219                     end
  220                 end
  221             end else begin

  223                 if (!out_hold_valid) begin

  226                         out_hold_data  <= fifo_out_tdata;
  227                         out_hold_last  <= fifo_out_tlast;
  228                         out_hold_txfn  <= latched_txfn;
  229                     end
  230                 end else if (m_axis_tready) begin
  231                     if (out_hold_last) begin
  232                         out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b0;
  233                     end else begin
  234                         out_frame_in_progress <= 1'b1;
  235                     end
  236 
  237                     if (fifo_out_tvalid) begin
  238                         out_hold_valid <= 1'b1;
  239                         out_hold_data  <= fifo_out_tdata;
  240                         out_hold_last  <= fifo_out_tlast;
  241                         if (out_hold_last) out_hold_txfn <= latched_txfn;
  242                     end else begin
  243                         out_hold_valid <= 1'b0;
  244                         out_hold_data  <= 32'd0;
  245                         out_hold_last  <= 1'b0;
  246                     end
  247                 end
  248                 // Note: When out_hold_valid == 1 && m_axis_tready == 0, out_hold_valid,
  249                 // out_hold_data, and out_hold_last are strictly held constant (Fix B15)!
  250             end
  251         end
  252     end
  253 
  254     // Active Producer FSM feeding u_fso_crc_32_idle -> fifo_idle (Fix B16)
  255     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  256         if (!rst_n) begin
  257             state        <= S_INIT;
  258             word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  259             lfsr_q       <= 25'h0000001;
  260             latched_txfn <= 16'd0;
  261         end else if (!sub_rst_n) begin
  262             state        <= S_INIT;
  263             word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  264             lfsr_q       <= seed_val;
  265             latched_txfn <= txfn_in;
  266         end else begin
  267             state <= next_state;
  268             if (state == S_INIT) begin
  269                 word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
  270                 lfsr_q       <= seed_val;
  271                 latched_txfn <= txfn_in;
  272             end else if (state == S_GEN && prbs_tvalid && crc_tready) begin
  273                 word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  274                 lfsr_q   <= prbs_next[56:32];
  275             end
  276         end
  277     end
  278 
  279     always @(*) begin
  280         next_state  = state;
  281         prbs_tvalid = 1'b0;
  282         prbs_tlast  = 1'b0;
  283         prbs_tdata  = 32'd0;
  284 
  285         case (state)
  286             S_INIT: begin
  287                 if (crc_tready && !fifo_out_tvalid && sub_rst_n)
  288                     next_state = S_GEN;
  289             end
  290             S_GEN: begin
  291                 prbs_tvalid = 1'b1;
  292                 prbs_tdata  = prbs_next[31:0];
  293                 if (word_cnt == (MAX_WORDS - 1)) begin
  294                     prbs_tlast = 1'b1;
  295                     if (crc_tready) next_state = S_INIT;
  296                 end
  297             end
  298         endcase
  299     end

   62     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   63     output reg         s_axis_eth_tready,
   64     input  wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes,   // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit packet/segment byte count

   66     // -------------------------------------------------------
   67     // ARQ Control Interfaces (from arq_tx_controller.v)
   68     // -------------------------------------------------------
   69     input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   70     input  wire        ddr4_read_req,

   76     // Output: 1912 Bytes (Both Data and Retransmit paths)
   77     // -------------------------------------------------------
   78     output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   79     output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   80     output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   81     input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
