   83     output wire [31:0] m_axis_retx_tdata,
   84     output wire        m_axis_retx_tvalid,
   85     output wire        m_axis_retx_tlast,
   86     input  wire        m_axis_retx_tready
   87 );
   88 
   89     // =======================================================
   90     // 1. INJECTOR FSM: Append FSO Headers (1900B/1904B -> 1908B)
   91     // =======================================================
   92     localparam S_IDLE     = 3'd0,
   93                S_HDR1     = 3'd1,
   94                S_HDR2     = 3'd2,
   95                S_DATA     = 3'd3,
   96                S_CONT_PAD = 3'd4;
   97     
   98     reg [2:0]  state, next_state;
   99     reg [9:0]  seq_num;
  100     reg        in_continuation;
  101     reg [13:0] cont_rem_bytes;
  102     reg [13:0] latched_pkt_bytes;
  103 
  104     // Resolve active ingress packet length (handles both 14-bit direct and unconnected fallback)
  105     wire        meta_low_valid  = (^seg_valid_bytes[10:0] !== 1'bx);
  106     wire        meta_high_valid = (^seg_valid_bytes[13:11] !== 1'bx);
  107     wire [13:0] live_pkt_bytes  = meta_low_valid ?
  108                                   {meta_high_valid ? seg_valid_bytes[13:11] : 3'd0, seg_valid_bytes[10:0]} :
  109                                   DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  110 
  111     // Internal wires connecting Injector -> CRC
  112     reg  [31:0] inj_tdata;
  113     reg         inj_tvalid;
  114     reg         inj_tlast;
  115     wire        inj_tready;
  116 
  117     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A02] Per SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.7.5, Continuation Payload Header (0xAB)
  118     // carries the total remaining byte length of the continued packet ('cont_rem_bytes').
  119     wire [13:0] pld_hdr_len_field = in_continuation ? cont_rem_bytes : 14'd0;
  120     wire [13:0] pkt_hdr_len_field = latched_pkt_bytes;
  121 
  122     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B03] When cont_rem_bytes > 1900, the segmenter provides 476 full data words
  123     // (1904 Bytes), so S_CONT_PAD is NOT needed (1 Header word + 476 Data words = 477 words).
  124     // S_CONT_PAD is only used when cont_rem_bytes <= 1900 (where the segmenter provides 475 words).
  125     wire cont_needs_pad_word = CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation && (cont_rem_bytes <= 14'd1900);
  126 
  127     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  128         if (!rst_n) begin
  129             state             <= S_IDLE;
  130             seq_num           <= 10'd0;
  131             in_continuation   <= 1'b0;
  132             cont_rem_bytes    <= 14'd0;
  133             latched_pkt_bytes <= DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  134         end else begin
  135             state <= next_state;
  136 
  137             if ((state == S_IDLE || state == S_HDR1) && s_axis_eth_tvalid && !in_continuation) begin
  138                 latched_pkt_bytes <= (live_pkt_bytes != 14'd0) ? live_pkt_bytes : DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  139             end
  140 
  141             if (state == S_DATA && s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  142                 if (s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  143                     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B03] Exact 1900B initial & 1904B continuation subtraction
  144                     if (!in_continuation) begin
  145                         if (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900) begin
  146                             in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  147                             cont_rem_bytes  <= latched_pkt_bytes - 14'd1900;
  148                         end else begin
  149                             in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  150                             cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  151                         end
  152                     end else begin
  153                         if (cont_rem_bytes > 14'd1904) begin
  154                             in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  155                             cont_rem_bytes  <= cont_rem_bytes - 14'd1904;
  156                         end else begin
  157                             in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  158                             cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  159                         end
  160                     end
  161 
  162                     if (!cont_needs_pad_word) begin
  163                         seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  164                     end
  165                 end
  166             end else if (state == S_CONT_PAD && inj_tready) begin
  167                 seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  168             end
  169         end
  170     end
  171 
  172     always @(*) begin
  173         next_state        = state;
  174         s_axis_eth_tready = 1'b0;
  175         inj_tvalid        = 1'b0;
  176         inj_tlast         = 1'b0;
  177         inj_tdata         = 32'd0;
  178 
  179         case (state)
  180             S_IDLE: begin
  181                 if (s_axis_eth_tvalid) next_state = S_HDR1;
  182             end
  183             S_HDR1: begin
  184                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  185                 // Table 2-18 FSO Payload Header: {0xAB, seq_num[9:0], Length[13:0]}
  186                 inj_tdata  = {8'hAB, seq_num, pld_hdr_len_field};
  187                 if (inj_tready) begin
  188                     if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)
  189                         next_state = S_DATA; // Table 2-18 Continuation: skip duplicate 0xCDEF header
  190                     else
  191                         next_state = S_HDR2;
  192                 end
  193             end
  194             S_HDR2: begin
  195                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  196                 // Table 2-18 FSO Packet Header: {0xCDEF, 2'b00, Length[13:0]}
  197                 inj_tdata  = {16'hCDEF, 2'b00, pkt_hdr_len_field};
  198                 if (inj_tready) next_state = S_DATA;
  199             end
  200             S_DATA: begin
  201                 inj_tvalid        = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  202                 inj_tdata         = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  203                 s_axis_eth_tready = inj_tready;
  204 
  205                 if (cont_needs_pad_word) begin
  206                     // Suppress tlast on the 475th word so S_CONT_PAD appends the 476th trailing pad word
  207                     inj_tlast = 1'b0;
  208                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  209                         next_state = S_CONT_PAD;
  210                     end
  211                 end else begin
  212                     inj_tlast = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  213                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  214                         next_state = S_IDLE;
  215                     end
  216                 end
  217             end
  218             S_CONT_PAD: begin
  219                 // Appends the 476th word (trailing zero-pad word for <=1900B continuation tail)
  220                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  221                 inj_tdata  = 32'd0;
  222                 inj_tlast  = 1'b1;
  223                 if (inj_tready) begin
  224                     next_state = S_IDLE;
  225                 end
  226             end
  227             default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  228         endcase
  229     end
  230 
  231     // =======================================================
  232     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  233     // =======================================================
  234     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  235     wire        crc_tvalid;
  236     wire        crc_tlast;
  237     wire        crc_tready;

  243         .s_axis_tvalid   (inj_tvalid),

    2 /*
    3 ===========================================================================
    4 Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5 Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6 Description  : FSO Payload Combinational Multiplexer.
    7                Acts as the Arbi traffic router before CDC and FEC.
    8                Selects between 4 AXI-Stream inputs based on payload_mux_sel:
    9                00 = IDLE FIFO
   10                01 = DATA FIFO
   11                10 = MGMT FIFO
   12                11 = ARQ DDR4 Retransmit RAM
   13                Zero-latency combinational routing.
   14 ===========================================================================
   15 */
   16 
   17 module fso_payload_mux (
   18     // Control Signal from ARQ TX Controller
   19     input  wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,
   20 
   21     // Input 0: IDLE FIFO (00)
   22     input  wire [31:0] s_idle_tdata,
   23     input  wire        s_idle_tvalid,
   24     input  wire        s_idle_tlast,
   25     output wire        s_idle_tready,
   26 
   27     // Input 1: DATA FIFO (01)
   28     input  wire [31:0] s_data_tdata,
   29     input  wire        s_data_tvalid,
   30     input  wire        s_data_tlast,
   31     output wire        s_data_tready,
   32 
   33     // Input 2: MGMT FIFO (10)
   34     input  wire [31:0] s_mgmt_tdata,
   35     input  wire        s_mgmt_tvalid,
   36     input  wire        s_mgmt_tlast,
   37     output wire        s_mgmt_tready,
   38 
   39     // Input 3: ARQ Retransmit RAM (11)
   40     input  wire [31:0] s_retx_tdata,
   41     input  wire        s_retx_tvalid,
   42     input  wire        s_retx_tlast,
   43     output wire        s_retx_tready,
   44 
   45     // Output: To x_gth_logic.v (CDC)
   46     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   47     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   48     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   49     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   50 );
   51 
   52     // =======================================================
   53     // Combinational Routing for Downstream Data (tdata, tvalid, tlast)
   54     // =======================================================
   55     assign m_axis_tdata  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tdata  :
   56                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tdata  :
   57                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tdata  :
   58                                                         s_retx_tdata;
   59 
   60     assign m_axis_tvalid = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tvalid :
   61                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tvalid :
   62                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tvalid :
   63                                                         s_retx_tvalid;
   64 
   65     assign m_axis_tlast  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tlast  :
   66                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tlast  :
   67                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tlast  :
   68                                                         s_retx_tlast;
   69 
   70     // =======================================================
   71     // Combinational Routing for Upstream Flow Control (tready)
   72     // Only the selected path receives the true tready from CDC.
   73     // Unselected paths are stalled (tready = 0).
   74     // =======================================================
   75     assign s_idle_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   76     assign s_data_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   77     assign s_mgmt_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   78     assign s_retx_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;

   27 module header_generator #(

   36     input  wire [15:0] rxfn,         // Receive Frame Number (from remote)

   73             byte_counter    <= 4'd0;
   74             is_generating   <= 1'b0;
   75             header_en_out   <= 1'b0;
   76             header_byte_out <= 8'd0;
   77         end else begin

   79             // STATE 1: Trigger & Data Latch (Setup Phase)
   80             // -----------------------------------------------------------
   81             if (trigger_gen && !is_generating) begin
   82                 // Assemble the 112-bit header based on Table 2-10 mapping.
   83                 // Critical: All reserved bits are forced to 1 per SDA OISL standard.
   84                 full_header_reg[7:0]     <= txfn[7:0];                                      // d0
   85                 full_header_reg[15:8]    <= txfn[15:8];                                     // d1

   87                 full_header_reg[31:24]   <= std_rxfn[15:8];                                 // d3 (0 if !ack_valid)

   97                 full_header_reg[111:104] <= std_fcch_pl[15:8];                              // d13

  102             end

  105             // STATE 2: Execution & Serialization (Shift Phase)
  106             // -----------------------------------------------------------

  111

   39 );

   47     reg        delay_last_2;

   17                - [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:34 KST - Target B6.1 Audit Fix]:
   18                  Added segment-level valid Ethernet byte tracking.
   19                - [Rev 2.1 - 2026-10-28 13:56 KST - Internal Audit Fix #5]:
   20                  Added exact s_axis_tlast packet-length descriptor tracking (pkt_len_fifo).
   21                - [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST - Store-and-Segment Multi-Packet Fix]:
   22                  Eliminated dual-block writes to 'pkt_len_fifo' and added Store-and-Segment
   23                  completion gating (pkt_complete_in_fifo) for IPv4 and non-IPv4 packets.
   24                - [Rev 2.3 - 2026-10-29 12:39 KST - Inclusive Cycle Byte Count Alignment]:
   25                  Added combinational '+ 11'd4' on active S_PASS words so 'seg_valid_bytes'
   26                  reports 1900 B (instead of 1896 B) on the 475th word when m_axis_tlast == 1.
   27                - [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 16:42 KST - Audit Fix R12 - Byte-Accurate Partial Tail & Super-Jumbo Hold]:
   28                  1. Added 's_axis_tkeep_bytes [2:0]' (1..4 valid bytes, defaulting to 4 
   29                     when unconnected) and stored it in 'fifo_ram[35:33]' so non-multiple-of-4 
   30                     packets (65B, 66B, 67B, 1518B, 1901B) accumulate exact byte counts.
   31                  2. Raised store-and-segment pre-buffer fallback threshold from 500 to 950 
   32                     words (3,800 Bytes).
   33                - [Rev 2.6 - 2026-10-30 00:55 KST - Audit Fix N07 - 14-Bit Super-Jumbo Length Handshake]:
   34                  Expanded 'fifo_ram' depth to 2048 words and added upper 3-bit transfer.
   35                - [Rev 2.8 - 2026-10-30 11:30 KST - Audit Fix A01, A04, A05 & A18]:
   36                  1. [Fix A18 & A01]: Widened 'seg_valid_bytes' port to 14 bits ([13:0]).
   37                  2. [Fix A04]: Expanded 'pkt_len_fifo' to 128 entries with 'pkt_desc_cnt [7:0]'.
   38                  3. [Fix A05]: Expanded 'fifo_ram' to 4096 words (16,384 Bytes) and waited
   39                     strictly for completed packet descriptors.
   40                - [Rev 2.9 - 2026-10-30 18:05 KST - Audit Fix B03 - 1904-Byte Continuation Segment Capacity]:
   41                  1. When slicing a Continuation Segment whose remaining packet byte count 
   42                     exceeds 1,900 Bytes ('in_cont_seg && (cont_rem_bytes_reg > 14'd1900)', 
   43                     such as 3,804B, 4,096B, 7,200B, 7,204B, and 8,192B), the segmenter 
   44                     emits 476 words (1,904 Bytes) of contiguous Ethernet data from 'fifo_ram'
   45                     and subtracts 1,904 Bytes from 'cont_rem_bytes_reg', matching SDA OISL 
   46                     Table 2-18 (4B Payload Header + 1904B Continuation Data = 1908B).
   47                  2. For initial segments ('!in_cont_seg') and continuation segments with 
   48                     'cont_rem_bytes_reg <= 14'd1900' (such as the 2,000B = 1900B + 100B 
   49                     demo profile), retains 475 words per segment with zero regression on 
   50                     tb_eth_rx_front_end_top.v, tb_fso_payload.v, or frontend_lengths.sv.
   51 ===========================================================================
   52 */
   53 
   54 module packaging_and_segmentation #(
   55     parameter MAX_WORDS = 475 // 475 words x 4 Bytes = 1900 Bytes on Initial Segment
   56 )(
   57     input  wire        clk,
   58     input  wire        rst_n,
   59 
   60     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   61     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   62     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   63     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   64     input  wire [2:0]  s_axis_tkeep_bytes, // Optional 1..4 valid byte count (defaults to 4)
   65 
   66     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   67     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   68     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   69     input  wire        m_axis_tready,
   70     output wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit length metadata
   71 );
   72 
   73     // Default to 4 valid bytes if s_axis_tkeep_bytes is left unconnected (1'bz / 1'bx / 0)
   74     wire [2:0] in_word_bytes = ((^s_axis_tkeep_bytes === 1'bx) || (s_axis_tkeep_bytes == 3'd0)) ?
   75                                3'd4 : s_axis_tkeep_bytes;
   76 
   77     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A05] 4096-Word Elastic FIFO (16,384 Bytes) for up to 16KB Super-Jumbo frames
   78     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [35:0] fifo_ram [0:4095];
   79     reg [11:0] wr_ptr;
   80     reg [11:0] rd_ptr;
   81     reg [12:0] fifo_count;
   82 
   83     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A04] 128-Entry Packet Length Descriptor FIFO with explicit occupancy counter
   84     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [13:0] pkt_len_fifo [0:127];
   85     reg [6:0]  len_wr_ptr;
   86     reg [6:0]  len_rd_ptr;
   87     reg [7:0]  pkt_desc_cnt;
   88     reg [13:0] wr_pkt_byte_acc;
   89 
   90     wire fifo_empty      = (fifo_count == 13'd0);
   91     wire fifo_full       = (fifo_count >= 13'd4080);
   92     wire desc_full       = (pkt_desc_cnt >= 8'd120);
   93     assign s_axis_tready = (!fifo_full) && (!desc_full);
   94 
   95     wire write_en             = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   96     wire read_en;
   97     wire pkt_complete_in_fifo = (pkt_desc_cnt != 8'd0);
   98 
   99     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write (Strictly Single-Driver for both LUTRAMs)
  100     always @(posedge clk) begin
  101         if (write_en) begin
  102             fifo_ram[wr_ptr] <= {in_word_bytes, s_axis_tlast, s_axis_tdata};
  103             if (s_axis_tlast) begin
  104                 pkt_len_fifo[len_wr_ptr] <= wr_pkt_byte_acc + {11'd0, in_word_bytes};
  105             end
  106         end
  107     end
  108 
  109     // Write Pointer, Packet Length Accumulator, and FIFO Occupancy Counter
  110     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  111         if (!rst_n) begin
  112             wr_ptr          <= 12'd0;
  113             fifo_count      <= 13'd0;
  114             len_wr_ptr      <= 7'd0;
  115             wr_pkt_byte_acc <= 14'd0;
  116         end else begin
  117             if (write_en) begin
  118                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  119                 if (s_axis_tlast) begin
  120                     len_wr_ptr      <= len_wr_ptr + 7'd1;
  121                     wr_pkt_byte_acc <= 14'd0;
  122                 end else begin
  123                     wr_pkt_byte_acc <= wr_pkt_byte_acc + {11'd0, in_word_bytes};
  124                 end
  125             end
  126             if (write_en && !read_en)
  127                 fifo_count <= fifo_count + 13'd1;
  128             else if (!write_en && read_en)
  129                 fifo_count <= fifo_count - 13'd1;
  130         end
  131     end
  132 
  133     // Segmentation & Padding FSM
  134     localparam S_PASS = 1'b0;
  135     localparam S_PAD  = 1'b1;
  136 
  137     reg         state;
  138     reg  [8:0]  word_cnt;
  139     reg  [13:0] active_seg_bytes;
  140     reg         in_cont_seg;
  141     reg  [13:0] cont_rem_bytes_reg;
  142     wire [35:0] rd_data       = fifo_ram[rd_ptr];
  143     wire [2:0]  rd_word_bytes = (rd_data[35:33] == 3'd0) ? 3'd4 : rd_data[35:33];
  144 
  145     wire [13:0] head_pkt_total_bytes = in_cont_seg ? cont_rem_bytes_reg :
  146                                        (pkt_complete_in_fifo ? pkt_len_fifo[len_rd_ptr] : 14'd2000);
  147     wire        seg_data_ready       = !fifo_empty && (in_cont_seg || pkt_complete_in_fifo);
  148 
  149     // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B03] Use 476 words (1904 Bytes) when a continuation segment carries >1900B;
  150     // otherwise use 475 words (MAX_WORDS = 1900 Bytes) for initial segments and <=1900B continuations.
  151     wire        use_1904b_cont_seg   = in_cont_seg && (cont_rem_bytes_reg > 14'd1900);
  152     wire [8:0]  seg_max_words        = use_1904b_cont_seg ? 9'd476 : MAX_WORDS[8:0];
  153     wire [13:0] seg_byte_capacity    = use_1904b_cont_seg ? 14'd1904 : 14'd1900;
  154 
  155     assign read_en      = (state == S_PASS) && seg_data_ready && m_axis_tready;
  156     wire   desc_push_en = write_en && s_axis_tlast;
  157     wire   desc_pop_en  = read_en && rd_data[32];
  158 
  159     // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A04] Dedicated Packet Descriptor Occupancy Counter
  160     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  161         if (!rst_n) begin
  162             pkt_desc_cnt <= 8'd0;
  163         end else begin
  164             if (desc_push_en && !desc_pop_en)
  165                 pkt_desc_cnt <= pkt_desc_cnt + 8'd1;
  166             else if (!desc_push_en && desc_pop_en)
  167                 pkt_desc_cnt <= pkt_desc_cnt - 8'd1;
  168         end
  169     end
  170 
  171     // Accumulate exact rd_word_bytes (1..4) on each S_PASS word
  172     wire [13:0] cur_seg_valid_bytes = (state == S_PASS && m_axis_tvalid) ?
  173                                       ((word_cnt == 9'd0) ? {11'd0, rd_word_bytes} :
  174                                                             (active_seg_bytes + {11'd0, rd_word_bytes})) :
  175                                       active_seg_bytes;
  176 
  177     // [Rev 2.9] Drive clean 14-bit packet/continuation byte length on word_cnt == 0
  178     assign seg_valid_bytes = (state == S_PASS && word_cnt == 9'd0) ?
  179                              (seg_data_ready ? head_pkt_total_bytes : 14'd2000) :
  180                              cur_seg_valid_bytes;
  181 
  182     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  183         if (!rst_n) begin
  184             state              <= S_PASS;
  185             word_cnt           <= 9'd0;
  186             rd_ptr             <= 12'd0;
  187             len_rd_ptr         <= 7'd0;
  188             active_seg_bytes   <= 14'd0;
  189             in_cont_seg        <= 1'b0;
  190             cont_rem_bytes_reg <= 14'd0;
  191         end else begin
  192             if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
  193                 if (state == S_PASS) begin
  194                     rd_ptr           <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  195                     active_seg_bytes <= cur_seg_valid_bytes;
  196 
  197                     if (rd_data[32]) begin
  198                         // End of Ethernet packet (s_axis_tlast == 1): pop descriptor FIFO
  199                         len_rd_ptr         <= len_rd_ptr + 7'd1;
  200                         in_cont_seg        <= 1'b0;
  201                         cont_rem_bytes_reg <= 14'd0;
  202                         if (word_cnt == seg_max_words - 9'd1) begin
  203                             word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  204                         end else begin
  205                             word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  206                             state    <= S_PAD;
  207                         end
  208                     end else if (word_cnt == seg_max_words - 9'd1) begin
  209                         // Reached segment boundary (1900B initial or 1904B continuation) without tlast
  210                         word_cnt           <= 9'd0;
  211                         in_cont_seg        <= 1'b1;
  212                         cont_rem_bytes_reg <= head_pkt_total_bytes - seg_byte_capacity;
  213                     end else begin
  214                         word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  215                     end
  216                 end else if (state == S_PAD) begin
  217                     if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  218                         word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  219                         state    <= S_PASS;
  220                     end else begin
  221                         word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  222                     end
  223                 end
  224             end
  225         end
  226     end
  227 
  228     always @(*) begin
  229         if (state == S_PASS) begin
  230             m_axis_tvalid = seg_data_ready;
  231             m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_tvalid ? rd_data[31:0] : 32'd0;
  232             m_axis_tlast  = m_axis_tvalid && (word_cnt == seg_max_words - 9'd1);
  233         end else begin
  234             m_axis_tvalid = 1'b1;
  235             m_axis_tdata  = 32'd0;
  236             m_axis_tlast  = (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1);
  237         end
  238     end
  239 
  240 endmodule

   21 ===========================================================================

   23 
   24 module chien_search #(
   25     parameter max = 254
   26 )(
   27     input  wire        clk,
   28     input  wire        rst_n,
   29     input  wire        en,
   30     input  wire [71:0] delta,
   31     output wire        flag,
   32     output wire        error,
   33     output wire [7:0]  chien
   34 );
   35 
   36     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   37 
   38     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   39     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   40     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   41 
   42     reg [2:0] state;
   43     reg [2:0] next_state;
   44 
   45     reg [71:0] delta_d0;
   46 
   47     reg  [7:0] Q [0:8];
   48     wire [7:0] D [0:8];
   49     wire [7:0] C0;
   50     wire [7:0] C1;
   51 
   52     // FSM State Register
   53     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   54         if (~rst_n)
   55             state <= IDLE;
   56         else
   57             state <= next_state;
   58     end
   59 
   60     // Cycle Counter
   61     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   62         if (~rst_n)
   63             count <= 8'd0;
   64         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   65             count <= count + 1'b1;
   66         else
   67             count <= 8'd0;
   68     end
   69 
   70     // Next State Logic
   71     always @(*) begin
   72         case (state)
   73             IDLE: begin
   74                 if (en)
   75                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   76                 else
   77                     next_state = IDLE;
   78             end
   79             ACTIVE: begin
   80                 if (count < max)
   81                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   82                 else
   83                     next_state = END;
   84             end
   85             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   86             default: next_state = IDLE;
   87         endcase
   88     end
   89 
   90     // Input Delta Register
   91     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   92         if (~rst_n)
   93             delta_d0 <= 72'b0;
   94         else
   95             delta_d0 <= delta;
   96     end
   97 
   98     // Coefficient Shift Registers
   99     integer i;
  100     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  101         if (~rst_n) begin
  102             for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  103                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  104         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  105             if (count == 8'd0) begin
  106                 Q[8] <= delta_d0[71:64];
  107                 Q[7] <= delta_d0[63:56];
  108                 Q[6] <= delta_d0[55:48];
  109                 Q[5] <= delta_d0[47:40];
  110                 Q[4] <= delta_d0[39:32];
  111                 Q[3] <= delta_d0[31:24];
  112                 Q[2] <= delta_d0[23:16];
  113                 Q[1] <= delta_d0[15:8];
  114                 Q[0] <= delta_d0[7:0];
  115             end else begin
  116                 for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  117                     Q[i] <= D[i];
  118             end
  119         end else begin
  120             for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  121                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  122         end
  123     end
  124 
  125     // GF(2^8) Multipliers for powers beta^1 to beta^8 (where beta = alpha^11 in GF 0x187)
  126     multiplier gf_1 (8'had, Q[1], D[1]);
  127     multiplier gf_2 (8'hbe, Q[2], D[2]);
  128     multiplier gf_3 (8'h3a, Q[3], D[3]);
  129     multiplier gf_4 (8'h3c, Q[4], D[4]);
  130     multiplier gf_5 (8'hdc, Q[5], D[5]);
  131     multiplier gf_6 (8'h56, Q[6], D[6]);
  132     multiplier gf_7 (8'hca, Q[7], D[7]);
  133     multiplier gf_8 (8'h42, Q[8], D[8]);
  134 
  135     assign D[0] = Q[0];
  136     assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8];
  137     assign C1   = Q[1] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[7];
  138 
  139     assign flag  = (state == ACTIVE);
  140     assign error = (count != 8'd0 && C0 == 8'b0);
  141     assign chien = (count != 8'd0) ? C1 : 8'b0;

    2 /*

    6 Module Name  : euclid_proc
    7 Description  : Reed-Solomon Key Equation Solver (Euclidean Algorithm).
    8                Computes the 72-bit Error Locator Polynomial (delta) and 
    9                the 64-bit Error Evaluator Polynomial (omega) from the 
   10                128-bit syndrome vector in 40 active clock cycles.
   11 
   12                Mathematical Foundation & Parameter Basis (SDA OISL v2.1.2):
   13                - Solves the Reed-Solomon Key Equation over GF(2^8) (0x187):
   14                    Lambda(x) * S(x) = Omega(x) mod x^(2t), where 2t = 16 (t = 8).
   15                - Initial Conditions (INIT state):
   16                    A(x) = x^16 (deg_A = 16), W(x) = 0
   17                    S(x) = S_15*x^15 + ... + S_0 (deg_S = 15), T(x) = 1
   18                - Termination Invariant:
   19                    Stops when formal remainder degree reaches deg_S == 7 (< t = 8),
   20                    placing Omega_7..Omega_0 at reg_S[16:9] and Lambda_8..Lambda_0
   21                    at reg_T[8:0] after at most 16 steps (32 clock cycles <= max = 39).
   22 
   23 Revision History:
   24   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 40-cycle Euclidean key equation solver for RS(255,239) & RS(32,16).
   25   - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 01:32 KST) : [Audit Fix N02 - Degree-Tracked Sugiyama Euclidean Solver]
   26     1. Added explicit formal degree tracking registers ('deg_A' initialized to 16 and 
   27        'deg_S' initialized to 15) with a 2-cycle per degree-step schedule (pos = 0..1, 
   28        completing in <= 32 cycles within the existing 40-cycle 'max = 39' window).
   29     2. Added leading-zero normalization when 'reg_S[16] == 8'd0' and 'deg_S >= 5'd8' so 
   30        vanishing leading syndromes (such as S_15 == 0 in 2-error delta=119 cases) and 
   31        multi-degree cancellations (such as single-symbol errors, nu = 1) normalize 
   32        cleanly without dividing by zero or overwriting Lambda(x) in reg_T.
   33     3. Added exact termination hold when 'deg_S == 5'd7' (deg(Omega) < 8), ensuring 
   34        100% error recovery across 0, 1, 2, ..., 8 symbol errors in both RS(32,16) and 
   35        RS(255,239) codewords.
   36 ===========================================================================
   37 */
   38 
   39 module euclid_proc #(
   40     parameter max = 39
   41 )(
   42     input  wire         clk,
   43     input  wire         rst_n,
   44     input  wire         en,
   45     input  wire [127:0] syndrome,
   46     output wire         flag,
   47     output wire [71:0]  delta,
   48     output wire [63:0]  omega
   49 );
   50 
   51     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   52 
   53     localparam IDLE   = 4'b0001;
   54     localparam INIT   = 4'b0010;
   55     localparam ACTIVE = 4'b0100;
   56     localparam END    = 4'b1000;
   57 
   58     reg [3:0] state;
   59     reg [3:0] next_state;
   60 
   61     reg [127:0] syndrome_d0;
   62 
   63     reg [7:0] reg_A [0:16];
   64     reg [7:0] reg_S [0:16];
   65     reg [7:0] reg_C [0:16];
   66     reg [7:0] reg_W [0:16];
   67     reg [7:0] reg_T [0:16];
   68     reg [7:0] reg_Y [0:16];
   69 
   70     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N02] Formal degree counters for dividend A(x) and remainder S(x)
   71     reg [4:0] deg_A;
   72     reg [4:0] deg_S;
   73 
   74     wire [7:0] X [0:16];
   75     wire [7:0] Y [0:16];
   76     wire [7:0] Z [0:16];
   77     wire [7:0] T [0:16];
   78 
   79     wire [7:0] B [0:16];
   80     wire [7:0] C [0:16];
   81     wire [7:0] D [0:16];
   82     wire [7:0] S [0:16];
   83 
   84     wire [7:0] inv_0;
   85     wire [7:0] fold_B;
   86     wire [7:0] fold_D;
   87 
   88     reg [7:0] reg_inv_0;
   89     reg [7:0] reg_fold_B;
   90     reg [7:0] reg_fold_D;
   91 
   92     reg [7:0] pos = 8'd0;
   93 
   94     // FSM State Register
   95     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   96         if (~rst_n)
   97             state <= IDLE;
   98         else
   99             state <= next_state;
  100     end
  101 
  102     // Cycle Counter (0 to 39 in ACTIVE, 40 at END)
  103     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  104         if (~rst_n)
  105             count <= 8'd0;
  106         else if (state == ACTIVE)
  107             count <= count + 1'b1;
  108         else
  109             count <= 8'd0;
  110     end
  111 
  112     // Next State Logic
  113     always @(*) begin
  114         case (state)
  115             IDLE: begin
  116                 if (en)
  117                     next_state = INIT;
  118                 else
  119                     next_state = IDLE;
  120             end
  121             INIT:   next_state = ACTIVE;
  122             ACTIVE: begin
  123                 if (count < max)
  124                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  125                 else
  126                     next_state = END;
  127             end
  128             END:     next_state = IDLE;
  129             default: next_state = IDLE;
  130         endcase
  131     end
  132 
  133     // Input Syndrome Register
  134     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  135         if (~rst_n)
  136             syndrome_d0 <= 128'b0;
  137         else
  138             syndrome_d0 <= syndrome;
  139     end
  140 
  141     // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N02] 2-Cycle Sub-Iteration Phase Counter (0 to 1)
  142     // Completes up to 16 single-degree steps in at most 32 cycles (within max = 39)
  143     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  144         if (~rst_n)
  145             pos <= 8'd0;
  146         else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  147             if (pos == 8'd0)
  148                 pos <= 8'd1;
  149             else
  150                 pos <= 8'd0;
  151         end else begin
  152             pos <= 8'd0;
  153         end
  154     end
  155 
  156     // Degree difference delta_d = deg_A - deg_S (always >= 0 while deg_S >= 8)
  157     wire [4:0] delta_d = (deg_A >= deg_S) ? (deg_A - deg_S) : 5'd0;
  158 
  159     // Shifted locator polynomial x^(delta_d) * reg_T(x)
  160     wire [7:0] T_shift [0:16];
  161     genvar g;
  162     generate
  163         for (g = 0; g < 17; g = g + 1) begin : gen_t_shift
  164             assign T_shift[g] = (g >= delta_d) ? reg_T[g - delta_d] : 8'd0;
  165         end
  166     endgenerate
  167 
  168     // Polynomial Register Updates
  169     integer i;
  170     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  171         if (~rst_n) begin
  172             reg_inv_0  <= 8'b0;
  173             reg_fold_B <= 8'b0;
  174             reg_fold_D <= 8'b0;
  175             deg_A      <= 5'd16;
  176             deg_S      <= 5'd15;
  177 
  178             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  179                 reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  180                 reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  181                 reg_S[i] <= 8'b0;
  182                 reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  183                 reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  184                 reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  185             end
  186         end else if (state == INIT) begin
  187             reg_inv_0  <= 8'b0;
  188             reg_fold_B <= 8'b0;
  189             reg_fold_D <= 8'b0;
  190             deg_A      <= 5'd16;
  191             deg_S      <= 5'd15;
  192 
  193             reg_A[16] <= 8'h01;
  194             reg_T[0]  <= 8'h01;
  195 
  196             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  197                 reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  198             for (i = 1; i < 17; i = i + 1)
  199                 reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  200             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  201                 reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  202                 reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  203                 reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  204             end
  205 
  206             reg_S[16] <= syndrome_d0[127:120];
  207             reg_S[15] <= syndrome_d0[119:112];
  208             reg_S[14] <= syndrome_d0[111:104];
  209             reg_S[13] <= syndrome_d0[103:96];
  210             reg_S[12] <= syndrome_d0[95:88];
  211             reg_S[11] <= syndrome_d0[87:80];
  212             reg_S[10] <= syndrome_d0[79:72];
  213             reg_S[9]  <= syndrome_d0[71:64];
  214             reg_S[8]  <= syndrome_d0[63:56];
  215             reg_S[7]  <= syndrome_d0[55:48];
  216             reg_S[6]  <= syndrome_d0[47:40];
  217             reg_S[5]  <= syndrome_d0[39:32];
  218             reg_S[4]  <= syndrome_d0[31:24];
  219             reg_S[3]  <= syndrome_d0[23:16];
  220             reg_S[2]  <= syndrome_d0[15:8];
  221             reg_S[1]  <= syndrome_d0[7:0];
  222             reg_S[0]  <= 8'b0;
  223         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  224             if (pos == 8'd0) begin
  225                 // Phase 0: Latch multiplicative inverse of leading coefficient reg_S[16]
  226                 reg_inv_0  <= inv_0;
  227                 reg_fold_B <= fold_B;
  228             end else begin
  229                 // Phase 1: Execute 1 degree-reduction or normalization step while deg_S >= 8
  230                 if (deg_S >= 5'd8) begin
  231                     if (reg_S[16] == 8'd0) begin
  232                         // Rule 1: Leading coefficient of reg_S is zero -> normalize reg_S left by 1
  233                         for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  234                             reg_S[i] <= reg_S[i - 1];
  235                         end
  236                         reg_S[0] <= 8'd0;
  237                         deg_S    <= deg_S - 5'd1;
  238                     end else if (deg_A > deg_S) begin
  239                         // Rule 2a (deg_A > deg_S): Eliminate reg_A[16], shift A remainder left by 1
  240                         for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  241                             reg_A[i] <= C[i - 1];
  242                         end
  243                         reg_A[0] <= 8'd0;
  244                         deg_A    <= deg_A - 5'd1;
  245 
  246                         for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  247                             reg_W[i] <= Y[i];
  248                         end
  249                     end else begin
  250                         // Rule 2b (deg_A == deg_S): Eliminate reg_A[16], swap (A, W) <-> (S, T),
  251                         // and shift new S remainder left by 1
  252                         for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  253                             reg_A[i] <= reg_S[i];
  254                             reg_W[i] <= reg_T[i];
  255                             reg_T[i] <= Y[i];
  256                         end
  257                         deg_A <= deg_S;
  258 
  259                         for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  260                             reg_S[i] <= C[i - 1];
  261                         end
  262                         reg_S[0] <= 8'd0;
  263                         deg_S    <= deg_S - 5'd1;
  264                     end
  265                 end
  266                 // Rule 3 (deg_S == 5'd7): Termination reached (deg(Omega) < 8); hold all registers steady
  267             end
  268 
  269             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  270                 reg_C[i] <= C[i];
  271                 reg_Y[i] <= Y[i];
  272             end
  273         end
  274     end
  275 
  276     // Galois Field Inverter and Multipliers
  277     inverter   invert_0 (reg_S[16], inv_0);
  278     multiplier gf_B     (reg_inv_0, reg_A[16], fold_B);
  279     multiplier gf_D     (reg_inv_0, reg_C[15], fold_D);
  280

  302     multiplier gf_D14 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[15], D[14]);

  124     multiplier gf_0     (inv_0, C0,   C1);

  134     assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7];

   67     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   68         if (~rst_n)
   69             state   <= IDLE;
   70         else
   71             state   <= next_state;
   72     end
   73 
   74     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75         if (~rst_n)
   76             count   <= 8'd0;
   77         else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH)
   78             count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79         else
   80             count   <= 8'd0;
   81     end
   82 
   83     always @(*) begin
   84         case(state)
   85             IDLE:   begin
   86                         if (en) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   87                         else    next_state <= IDLE;
   88                     end
   89             ACTIVE: begin
   90                         // Read Data Phase
   91                         if (count < MAX_CYCLE - 16) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   92                         else                        next_state <= FLUSH;
   93                     end
   94             FLUSH:  begin
   95                         // Dump 16 Parity Bytes Phase
   96                         if (count < MAX_CYCLE) next_state <= FLUSH;
   97                         else                   next_state <= END;
   98                     end
   99             END:    next_state <= IDLE;
  100             default: next_state <= IDLE;
  101         endcase
  102     end
  103 
  104     // =======================================================
  105     // DATA PIPELINE & SHIFT REGISTERS
  106     // =======================================================
  107     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  108         if (~rst_n)
  109             data_d0 <= 8'b0;
  110         else
  111             data_d0 <= data_in;
  112     end
  113 
  114     reg [7:0] i;
  115     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116         if (~rst_n) begin
  117             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  118                 Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  119         end 
  120         else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH) begin
  121             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  122                 Q[i]  <= D[i];
  123         end 
  124         else begin
  125             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  126                 Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  127         end
  128     end
  129 
  130     // =======================================================
  131     // GALOIS FIELD MULTIPLIERS
  132     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Updated to SDA OISL v2.1.2 Page 37
  133     // roots alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 over GF(2^8) 0x187:
  134     // =======================================================
  135     multiplier gf_0 (8'h01, C1, R[0]);
  136     multiplier gf_1 (8'ha5, C1, R[1]);
  137     multiplier gf_2 (8'h69, C1, R[2]);
  138     multiplier gf_3 (8'h1b, C1, R[3]);
  139     multiplier gf_4 (8'h9f, C1, R[4]);
  140     multiplier gf_5 (8'h68, C1, R[5]);
  141     multiplier gf_6 (8'h98, C1, R[6]);
  142     multiplier gf_7 (8'h65, C1, R[7]);
  143     multiplier gf_8 (8'h4a, C1, R[8]);
  144     multiplier gf_9 (8'h65, C1, R[9]);
  145     multiplier gf_a (8'h98, C1, R[10]);
  146     multiplier gf_b (8'h68, C1, R[11]);
  147     multiplier gf_c (8'h9f, C1, R[12]);
  148     multiplier gf_d (8'h1b, C1, R[13]);
  149     multiplier gf_e (8'h69, C1, R[14]);
  150     multiplier gf_f (8'ha5, C1, R[15]);
  151 
  152     assign  D[0]  = R[0];
  153     assign  D[1]  = R[1]  ^ Q[0];
  154     assign  D[2]  = R[2]  ^ Q[1];
  155     assign  D[3]  = R[3]  ^ Q[2];
  156     assign  D[4]  = R[4]  ^ Q[3];
  157     assign  D[5]  = R[5]  ^ Q[4];
  158     assign  D[6]  = R[6]  ^ Q[5];

  160     assign  D[8]  = R[8]  ^ Q[7];

  165     assign  D[13] = R[13] ^ Q[12];

  167     assign  D[15] = R[15] ^ Q[14];

  169     assign  C0       = Q[15] ^ data_d0;
  170     assign  C1       = (state == FLUSH) ? 8'b0 : C0;

  173     assign  flag     = (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH);
  174     assign  data_out = (state == FLUSH) ? Q[15] : data_d0;

   73     integer total_pld_words_out = 0;

   76         if (!rst_n) begin
   77             total_hdr_bytes_out <= 0;
   78             total_pld_words_out <= 0;
   79         end else begin

   97                 ST_STREAM: begin

   99                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 16'd1;
  100                     else begin
  101                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  102                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  103                     end

  111                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;

   89         .rs_load_dv (rs_load_dv), 
   90         .rs_load    (rs_load_out),
   91         .flag       (mux_dv), 
   92         .data_out   (mux_data_out)
   93     );
   94 
   95     // [Rev 2.0] Independent Golden-Vector Syndrome Checkers over GF(0x187), roots j=120..135
   96     wire         hdr_synd_done;
   97     wire [127:0] hdr_syndrome_vec;
   98     wire         pld_synd_done;
   99     wire [127:0] pld_syndrome_vec;
  100 
  101     syndrome_unit #(.max(31)) u_hdr_synd_chk (
  102         .clk      (clk),
  103         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  104         .en       (rs_head_dv),
  105         .data_in  (rs_head_out),
  106         .flag     (hdr_synd_done),
  107         .syndrome (hdr_syndrome_vec)
  108     );
  109 
  110     syndrome_unit #(.max(254)) u_pld_synd_chk_lane7 (
  111         .clk      (clk),
  112         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  113         .en       (rs_load_dv),
  114         .data_in  (rs_load_out[63:56]),
  115         .flag     (pld_synd_done),
  116         .syndrome (pld_syndrome_vec)
  117     );
  118 
  119     // =======================================================
  120     // 4. CLOCK & FSM GENERATION
  121     // =======================================================
  122     initial begin
  123         clk = 1'b0;
  124         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk; 
  125     end
  126 
  127     localparam ST_HEAD      = 3'd0;
  128     localparam ST_MATH_GAP  = 3'd1;
  129     localparam ST_LOAD      = 3'd2;
  130     localparam ST_FRAME_GAP = 3'd3;
  131     localparam ST_DONE      = 3'd4;
  132 
  133     reg [2:0]  tb_state;
  134     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  135     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  136 
  137     initial begin
  138         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  139         tb_state  = ST_HEAD;
  140         frame_id  = 4'd1;
  141         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
  142         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
  143     end
  144 
  145     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  146         if (rst_n) begin
  147             case (tb_state)
  148                 ST_HEAD: begin
  149                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  150                     else begin tb_state <= ST_MATH_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  151                 end
  152                 ST_MATH_GAP: begin
  153                     // 16 Cycles latency gap for RS Header Parity
  154                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  155                     else begin tb_state <= ST_LOAD; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  156                 end
  157                 ST_LOAD: begin
  158                     if (cycle_cnt < 239) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  159                     else begin tb_state <= ST_FRAME_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  160                 end
  161                 ST_FRAME_GAP: begin
  162                     // 35 Cycles gap between frames
  163                     if (cycle_cnt < 35) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  164                     else begin
  165                         if (frame_id < 4) begin
  166                             frame_id <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  167                             tb_state <= ST_HEAD;
  168                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  169                         end else begin
  170                             tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  171                         end
  172                     end
  173                 end
  174             endcase
  175         end
  176     end
  177 
  178     // =======================================================
  179     // 5. DATA INJECTION (Strict SDA OISL Formatting)
  180     // =======================================================
  181     always @(*) begin
  182         en_head   = 1'b0; header_in  = 8'd0;
  183         en_load   = 1'b0; payload_in = 64'd0;
  184 
  185         if (tb_state != ST_DONE) begin
  186             // --- HEADER MAPPING (16 Bytes per Table 2-10: d0=TXFN[7:0], d1=TXFN[15:8]) ---
  187             if (tb_state == ST_HEAD) begin
  188                 en_head = 1'b1;
  189                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)  header_in = {4'd0, frame_id}; // d0: TXFN[7:0] (LSB)
  190                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)  header_in = 8'h00;            // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  191                 else if (cycle_cnt == 5)  header_in = (frame_id == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (frame_id == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD; // d4: Reserved=1111 + Frame Type
  192                 else if (cycle_cnt == 15) header_in = 8'hC1; // CRC-16 MSB
  193                 else if (cycle_cnt == 16) header_in = 8'hC2; // CRC-16 LSB
  194                 else                      header_in = 8'hAA; // ARQ / FCCH Dummy
  195             end
  196             
  197             // --- PAYLOAD MAPPING (239 Words / 1912 Bytes) ---
  198             else if (tb_state == ST_LOAD) begin
  199                 en_load = 1'b1;
  200                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)   payload_in = 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0; // Payload Hdr + Packet Hdr (Table 2-18)
  201                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)   payload_in = 64'hAABB_CCDD_EEFF_1122; // Eth MAC Header
  202                 else if (cycle_cnt == 239) payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C3C3_C3C3; // CRC-32 Tail at [31:0]
  203                 else begin
  204                     if (frame_id <= 2)      payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  205                     else if (frame_id == 3) payload_in = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E; // IDLE Pattern
  206                     else                    payload_in = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  207                 end
  208             end
  209         end
  210     end
  211 
  212     // =======================================================
  213     // 6. PERFECT WAVEFORM DUAL-TRACKERS (BYTES & WORDS)
  214     // =======================================================
  215     
  216     // String Indicator
  217     reg [31:0] mux_frame_type_str;
  218     always @(*) begin
  219         if      (frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  220         else if (frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  221         else if (frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  222         else if (frame_id == 4) mux_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  223         else                    mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  224     end
  225 
  226     // --- A. INPUT TRACKERS ---
  227     // 8-bit bus (1 cycle = 1 byte)
  228     wire [4:0]  in_header_byte_idx  = en_head ? cycle_cnt[4:0] : 5'd0;                        // 1 to 16 Bytes
  229     wire [2:0]  in_header_word_idx  = en_head ? ((cycle_cnt[4:0] - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;        // 1 to 2 Words
  230 
  231     // 64-bit bus (1 cycle = 8 bytes)
  232     wire [8:0]  in_payload_word_idx = en_load ? cycle_cnt[8:0] : 9'd0;                        // 1 to 239 Words
  233     wire [11:0] in_payload_byte_idx = en_load ? (cycle_cnt[8:0] * 8) : 12'd0;                 // 8 to 1912 Bytes
  234 
  235     // --- B. RS ENCODER OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  236     reg [5:0] r_rs_head_cnt = 0;
  237     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  238         if (!rst_n) r_rs_head_cnt <= 0;
  239         else r_rs_head_cnt <= rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  240     end
  241     wire [5:0] cur_rs_head_cnt = rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  242 
  243     // 8-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 32 cycles)
  244     wire [5:0]  rs_head_out_byte_idx = cur_rs_head_cnt;                                       // 1 to 32 Bytes
  245     wire [2:0]  rs_head_out_word_idx = rs_head_dv ? ((cur_rs_head_cnt - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;   // 1 to 4 Words
  246 
  247     reg [8:0] r_rs_load_cnt = 0;
  248     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  249         if (!rst_n) r_rs_load_cnt <= 0;
  250         else r_rs_load_cnt <= rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  251     end
  252     wire [8:0] cur_rs_load_cnt = rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  253 
  254     // 64-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 255 cycles)
  255     wire [8:0]  rs_load_out_word_idx = cur_rs_load_cnt;                                       // 1 to 255 Words
  256     wire [11:0] rs_load_out_byte_idx = rs_load_dv ? (cur_rs_load_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;            // 8 to 2040 Bytes
  257 
  258     // --- C. FEC MUX OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  259     reg [8:0] r_mux_cnt = 0;
  260     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261         if (!rst_n) r_mux_cnt <= 0;
  262         else r_mux_cnt <= mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  263     end
  264     wire [8:0] cur_mux_cnt = mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  265 
  266     // 64-bit bus (4 Words Header + 255 Words Payload = 259 cycles)
  267     wire [8:0]  mux_out_word_idx = cur_mux_cnt;                                               // 1 to 259 Words
  268     wire [11:0] mux_out_byte_idx = mux_dv ? (cur_mux_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;                        // 8 to 2072 Bytes
  269 
  270     // [Rev 2.0] Syndrome Verification Counters (Proves GF(0x187) & roots j=120..135)
  271     integer hdr_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  272     integer pld_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  273     always @(posedge clk) begin
  274         if (hdr_synd_done) begin
  275             if (hdr_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) hdr_synd_pass_cnt = hdr_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  276             $display(" [%0t] RS(32,16) Header Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135)  = 0x%032X", $time, hdr_syndrome_vec);
  277         end
  278         if (pld_synd_done) begin
  279             if (pld_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) pld_synd_pass_cnt = pld_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  280             $display(" [%0t] RS(255,239) Payload Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135) = 0x%032X", $time, pld_syndrome_vec);
  281         end
  282     end
  283 
  284     // =======================================================
  285     // 7. SIMULATION TERMINATION & LOGGING
  286     // =======================================================
  287     initial begin
  288         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  289         #5000;
  290         $display("\n=======================================================");
  291         $display(" FEC SUBSYSTEM GEOMETRY & GF(0x187) VERIFICATION COMPLETE");
  292         $display("=======================================================");
  293         $display(" MUX Out successfully packed Header and Payload seamlessly.");
  294         $display(" Output Profile: 259 Words (2072 Bytes) per Continuous Frame.");
  295         $display(" Header  RS(32,16)   Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", hdr_synd_pass_cnt);
  296         $display(" Payload RS(255,239) Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", pld_synd_pass_cnt);
  297         if (hdr_synd_pass_cnt == 4 && pld_synd_pass_cnt == 4)
  298             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL PAGE 37 (GF 0x187, j=120..135)!");
  299         $display("=======================================================\n");
  300         $finish;
  301     end
  302 
  303 endmodule

  125         .rx_dec_pld_tdata    (rx_dec_pld_tdata),
  126         .rx_dec_pld_tvalid   (rx_dec_pld_tvalid),
  127         .pc2_xgmii_txd       (pc2_xgmii_txd),
  128         .pc2_xgmii_txc       (pc2_xgmii_txc),
  129         .rx_preamble_locked  (rx_preamble_locked),
  130         .rx_block_locked     (rx_block_locked),
  131         .gth_link_up         (gth_link_up),
  132         .eth_data_error_flag (eth_data_error_flag)

  135     // Configure Error Injector Channel Mode via hierarchy parameter override
  136     defparam u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_error_injector.SIM_MODE  = (CH_ERROR_MODE == 0) ? 0 : 1;
  137     defparam u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.u_error_injector.max_error = (CH_ERROR_MODE == 1) ? 18 : 47;

  139     // =========================================================================
  140     // 4. CLOCK GENERATORS
  141     // =========================================================================
  142     initial begin
  143         sys_clk_p = 1'b0;
  144         forever #2.5 sys_clk_p = ~sys_clk_p; // 200.0 MHz System Differential Clock
  145     end
  146 
  147     initial begin
  148         mgtrefclk_p = 1'b0;
  149         forever #3.2 mgtrefclk_p = ~mgtrefclk_p; // 156.25 MHz Ethernet RefClk
  150     end

  152     initial begin

  154         forever #(GTH_REFCLK_HALF) fso_refclk_p = ~fso_refclk_p; // 156.25 MHz GTH Optical RefClk
  155     end

  157     // Internal Domain Clocks Probed for Stage-Accurate Counters

  166     // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  167     // GROUP 1: PC 1 INGRESS PACKET GEN, XGMII RX & 1900B SEGMENTATION (clk_tx)

  169     wire        grp1_pc1_gen_valid     = u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tvalid && u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tready;

  173     wire [3:0]  grp1_pc1_xgmii_rxc     = u_dut.xgmii_txc_in;
  174     wire        grp1_seg_valid         = u_dut.seg_axis_tvalid && u_dut.seg_axis_tready;
  175     wire [31:0] grp1_seg_data          = u_dut.seg_axis_tdata;
  176     wire        grp1_seg_last          = u_dut.seg_axis_tlast;

  179     reg  [15:0] grp1_pc1_clk_cnt       = 16'd0; // 1..500 Clocks
  180     reg  [15:0] grp1_pc1_byte_cnt      = 16'd0; // 4..2000 Bytes
  181     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_clk_cnt       = 16'd0; // 1..475 Clocks
  182     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_byte_cnt      = 16'd0; // 4..1900 Bytes
  183     reg  [15:0] grp1_seg_frame_id      = 16'd0;

  185     always @(posedge clk_tx) begin
  186         if (grp1_pc1_gen_valid) begin
  187             if (grp1_pc1_clk_cnt == 16'd500) begin
  188                 grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  189                 grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  190             end else begin
  191                 grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= grp1_pc1_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  192                 grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= grp1_pc1_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  193             end
  194         end else if (!u_dut.gen_sim_mode.gen_axis_tvalid) begin
  195             grp1_pc1_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  196             grp1_pc1_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  197         end

  199         if (grp1_seg_valid) begin
  200             if (grp1_seg_clk_cnt == 16'd475 || grp1_seg_clk_cnt == 16'd0) begin
  201                 grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= 16'd1;
  202                 grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  203                 grp1_seg_frame_id <= grp1_seg_frame_id + 16'd1;
  204             end else begin
  205                 grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= grp1_seg_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  206                 grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= grp1_seg_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  207             end
  208         end else if (!u_dut.seg_axis_tvalid) begin
  209             grp1_seg_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  210             grp1_seg_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  211         end
  212     end

  254                 grp2_pld_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  255             end else begin

  437     reg  [31:0]  grp8_captured_fcs     = 32'd0; // Captures 0xDEADBEEF
  438 
  439     // =========================================================================
  440     // [Rev 2.2] FULL WORD-BY-WORD / BYTE-BY-BYTE END-TO-END SCOREBOARD QUEUE
  441     // =========================================================================
  442     reg [31:0] scb_fifo [0:16383];
  443     integer    scb_wr_ptr        = 0;
  444     integer    scb_rd_ptr        = 0;
  445     integer    scb_matched_words = 0;
  446     integer    scb_error_words   = 0;
  447 
  448     always @(posedge clk_tx) begin
  449         if (grp1_pc1_gen_valid) begin
  450             scb_fifo[scb_wr_ptr] <= grp1_pc1_gen_data;
  451             scb_wr_ptr           <= scb_wr_ptr + 1;
  452         end
  453     end
  454 
  455     always @(posedge clk_rx) begin
  456         if (grp8_reasm_eth_valid) begin
  457             grp8_reasm_clk_cnt  <= grp8_reasm_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  458             grp8_reasm_byte_cnt <= grp8_reasm_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  459 
  460             // Words 0..1 are 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble (55555555_555555D5); Words 2..501 are Payload
  461             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd0) begin
  462                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data !== 32'h5555_5555) begin
  463                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  464                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Ethernet Preamble Word 0 Mismatch: got 0x%08X", grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  465                 end
  466             end else if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd1) begin
  467                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data !== 32'h5555_55D5) begin
  468                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  469                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Ethernet Preamble Word 1 Mismatch: got 0x%08X", grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  470                 end
  471             end else begin
  472                 if (grp8_reasm_eth_data === scb_fifo[scb_rd_ptr]) begin
  473                     scb_matched_words <= scb_matched_words + 1;
  474                 end else begin
  475                     scb_error_words <= scb_error_words + 1;
  476                     $fatal(1, "[SCOREBOARD FATAL] Payload Word #%0d Mismatch! Expected=0x%08X, Got=0x%08X",
  477                            scb_rd_ptr, scb_fifo[scb_rd_ptr], grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  478                 end
  479                 scb_rd_ptr <= scb_rd_ptr + 1;
  480             end
  481 
  482             // Words 1..2 are Ethernet Preamble; Words 3..502 are Ethernet Packet (Words 12..14 = ASCII Tag)
  483             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd11) grp8_captured_ascii[95:64] <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  484             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd12) grp8_captured_ascii[63:32] <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  485             if (grp8_reasm_clk_cnt == 16'd13) grp8_captured_ascii[31:0]  <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  486             if (grp8_reasm_eth_last)          grp8_captured_fcs          <= grp8_reasm_eth_data;
  487         end else begin
  488             grp8_reasm_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  489             grp8_reasm_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  490         end
  491     end
  492 
  493     // [Rev 2.3] Inject 1-cycle MGMT 1Hz trigger right after Jumbo Segment 2 (DAT2) starts
  494     // so the Grand Top simulation visibly transmits & receives IDLE, DAT1, DAT2, AND MGMT!
  495     initial begin
  496         wait(grp1_seg_frame_id == 16'd2);
  497         @(posedge clk_tx);
  498         force u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.mgmt_trigger_1hz = 1'b1;
  499         @(posedge clk_tx);
  500         release u_dut.sda_encoder_inst.mgmt_trigger_1hz;
  501     end
  502 
  503     // =========================================================================
  504     // 6. REAL-TIME SDA OISL TABLE 2-4 METRICS & EVENT TELEMETRY LOGGER
  505     // =========================================================================
  506     real tx_fso_frame_start_ns         = 0.0;
  507     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  508     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  509     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  510 
  511     always @(grp4_tx_frame_id) begin
  512         if (grp4_tx_frame_id >= 32'd1) begin
  513             if (tx_fso_frame_start_ns > 0.0) begin
  514                 OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = ($realtime - tx_fso_frame_start_ns) / 1000.0;
  515                 OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  516                 OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  517                 $display(" [GRP4 TX OPTICAL] Frame %0d Completed -> Exact Duration = %0.6f us | Rate = %0.3f Mbps",
  518                          grp4_tx_frame_id - 1, OISL_Frame_Duration_us, OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  519             end
  520             tx_fso_frame_start_ns = $realtime;
  521         end
  522     end
  523 
  524     always @(posedge clk_rx) begin
  525         if (u_dut.sda_decoder_inst.u_core_rx.preamble_valid) begin
  526             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP6 RX PREAMBLE] Extracted = 0x%018X | Link Locked = %0b",
  527                      $realtime, grp6_rx_preamble_72b, grp6_rx_preamble_lock);
  528         end
  529         if (grp7_arq_fb_valid) begin
  530             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP7 ARQ FEEDBACK] RXFN = %0d | Status = %s (hdr_crc_ok=%0b, pld_crc_ok=%0b)",
  531                      $realtime, grp7_arq_fb_rxfn, grp7_arq_fb_ack ? "ACK (1)" : "NAK (0)",
  532                      grp7_hdr_crc16_ok, grp7_pld_crc32_ok);
  533         end
  534         if (grp8_reasm_eth_valid && grp8_reasm_eth_last) begin
  535             $display(" [%0.1f ns] [GRP8 PC 2 EGRESS] Reassembled Jumbo Packet #%0d Completed (%0d Bytes + 8B Preamble = 2008B) | ASCII=\"%s\" | FCS=0x%08X",
  536                      $realtime, grp8_reasm_pkt_cnt, grp8_reasm_pkt_bytes, grp8_captured_ascii, grp8_reasm_eth_data);
  537         end
  538     end

  541     initial begin

  543         $fatal(1, "[WATCHDOG FATAL] Simulation timed out before completing %0d Jumbo packets!", TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS);
  544     end

  554         $display(" -> TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS : %0d Packets (Full Byte-by-Byte Scoreboard Active)", TARGET_JUMBO_PKTS);

  588         end else begin

  590         end
  591         $display("================================================================================\n");
  592         $finish;
  593     end

  226             // Cycles 244 to 259: 16-Word (128-Byte) Payload RS Parity

  255     integer    ref_rd_ptr      = 0;
  256     integer    loopback_ok_cnt = 0;
  257     integer    loopback_err_cnt = 0;
  258 
  259     // Byte & Word Counters for Waveform
  260     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261         if (!rst_n) begin
  262             in_mux_word_idx  <= 9'd0;
  263             in_mux_byte_idx  <= 12'd0;
  264             out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  265             out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  266             out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  267             out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  268             ref_wr_ptr       <= 0;
  269             ref_rd_ptr       <= 0;
  270             loopback_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  271             loopback_err_cnt <= 0;
  272         end else begin
  273             // Record every accepted TX input word into Reference Queue
  274             if (mux_dv) begin
  275                 ref_queue[ref_wr_ptr] <= mux_data;
  276                 ref_wr_ptr            <= ref_wr_ptr + 1;
  277             end
  278 
  279             // Verify every recovered RX Descrambled word against Reference Queue
  280             if (rx_desc_dv) begin
  281                 if (rx_desc_data === ref_queue[ref_rd_ptr])
  282                     loopback_ok_cnt <= loopback_ok_cnt + 1;
  283                 else
  284                     loopback_err_cnt <= loopback_err_cnt + 1;
  285                 ref_rd_ptr <= ref_rd_ptr + 1;
  286             end
  287 
  288             // Track Input from MUX
  289             if (mux_dv) begin
  290                 in_mux_word_idx <= in_mux_word_idx + 1'b1;
  291                 in_mux_byte_idx <= in_mux_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  292             end else begin
  293                 in_mux_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  294                 in_mux_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  295             end
  296 
  297             // Track Scrambler Output
  298             if (scr_dv) begin
  299                 if (out_scr_word_idx == 9'd0) begin
  300                     $display(" [%0t] Frame %0d Scrambler Word 1: State Q = 25'h%07X (Seed=0x0000007) | PRBS Mask S = 0x%016X",
  301                              $time, frame_id, scr_state_25b, scr_prbs_mask_64b);
  302                 end
  303                 out_scr_word_idx <= out_scr_word_idx + 1'b1;
  304                 out_scr_byte_idx <= out_scr_byte_idx + 12'd8;
  305             end else begin
  306                 out_scr_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  307                 out_scr_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  308             end
  309 
  310             // Track LPC Output (96-bit = 12 Bytes per cycle!)
  311             if (lpc_dv) begin
  312                 out_lpc_word_idx <= out_lpc_word_idx + 1'b1;
  313                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= out_lpc_byte_idx + 12'd12;
  314             end else begin
  315                 out_lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  316                 out_lpc_byte_idx <= 12'd0;
  317             end
  318         end
  319     end
  320 
  321     // Simulation Termination
  322     initial begin
  323         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  324         wait(loopback_ok_cnt + loopback_err_cnt == 1036);
  325         #200;
  326         $display("\n=======================================================");
  327         $display(" SCRAMBLER (25-BIT SEED 0x0000007) & LPC(24,16) REPORT");
  328         $display("=======================================================");
  329         $display(" Scrambler aligned to 259-cycle processing (25-bit PRBS).");
  330         $display(" LPC expanded 64-bit words to 96-bit structures with Active Disparity.");
  331         $display(" Final output profile : 259 Words (3108 Bytes) per frame.");
  332         $display(" Loopback Verified    : %0d / 1036 Words Matched (Errors: %0d)", loopback_ok_cnt, loopback_err_cnt);
  333         if (loopback_ok_cnt == 1036 && loopback_err_cnt == 0)
  334             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 4 & ITEM 6!");
  335         else
  336             $fatal(1, " RESULT: [FAIL] Mismatches detected in Scrambler/LPC loopback!");
  337         $display("=======================================================\n");

  152                 cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;

  154             end else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd194) begin

  156                 data_in  = {32'hAAAA_BBBB, 32'hCCCC_DDDD, {28'd0, frame_id}, {16'd0, cycle_cnt}};
  157             end else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd195) begin
  158                 cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF;
  159                 data_in  = {104'h9999_8888_7777_6666_5555_4444_33, 24'h000000};
  160             end
  161         end
  162     end

  165     // 5. WAVEFORM TRACKERS FOR DATA IN & DATA OUT
  166     // =======================================================
  167     // Group 1: Data In from MUX (200 MHz)

  169     wire [11:0] in_byte_cnt = data_in_dv ?

  183     real measured_gth_period_ns;
  184     real measured_byte_time_ns;

  198         measured_byte_time_ns         = 0.0;
  199         prev_frame_id                 = 32'd0;

  204         OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  205         OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  206     end
  207 
  208     // Continuously measure the real GTH clock period from simulation events
  209     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  210         if (last_gth_edge_ns > 0.0) begin
  211             measured_gth_period_ns = $realtime - last_gth_edge_ns;
  212             measured_byte_time_ns  = measured_gth_period_ns / 4.0; // 4 Bytes per 32-bit word
  213         end
  214         last_gth_edge_ns = $realtime;
  215     end
  216 
  217     // Update metrics synchronously with frame_out_id so values sit directly 
  218     // underneath their respective frame (1, 2, 3, 4) in the waveform!
  219     always @(frame_out_id) begin
  220         if (frame_out_id >= 32'd1 && frame_out_id <= 32'd4) begin
  221             // Verify previous frame completion timestamp if transitioning between frames
  222             if (prev_frame_id >= 32'd1) begin

  225             end

  227             // Capture live start time of the current active frame
  228             time_start = $realtime;
  229             // Compute end time of the 3117-byte frame from live-measured byte duration
  230             time_end   = time_start + (3117.0 * measured_byte_time_ns);

  232             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = (time_end - time_start) / 1000.0;
  233             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  234             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;

  239             $display(" time_start     : %0.1f ns", time_start);
  240             $display(" time_end       : %0.1f ns", time_end);
  241             $display(" Duration       : %0.6f us", OISL_Frame_Duration_us);
  242             $display(" Effective Rate : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  243             $display(" Frame Rate     : %0.6f kHz", OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz);
  244             $display(" FCCH Rate      : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_FCCH_Mbps);
  245             $display("---------------------------------------------------");
  246         end
  247         else if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  248             if (prev_frame_id == 32'd4) begin
  249                 $display(" [VERIFIED] Frame 4 completed at exact $realtime = %0.1f ns", $realtime);
  250             end
  251             // Reset all metrics cleanly to 0.0 during IDLE (before Frame 1 & after Frame 4)
  252             time_start                    = 0.0;
  253             time_end                      = 0.0;
  254             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  255             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  256             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  257             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  258         end
  259         prev_frame_id = frame_out_id;
  260     end
  261 
  262     // =======================================================
  263     // 7. SIMULATION TERMINATION
  264     // =======================================================
  265     initial begin
  266         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  267         wait(flag == 1'b0);
  268         #500;
  269         $display("\n[%0t] ALL 4 FRAMES (4 x 3117B = 12,468B in 3117 GTH Clocks) TRANSMITTED CLEANLY.\n", $time);
  270         $finish;

  128                 12'd3117:            get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
  129                 default:             get_frame_byte = b_idx[7:0];
  130             endcase
  131         end
  132     endfunction
  133 
  134     integer total_word_idx;
  135     integer b0_abs, b1_abs, b2_abs, b3_abs;

  137     integer preamble_match_cnt       = 0;
  138 
  139     always @(posedge clk_logic) begin
  140         if (preamble_valid) begin
  141             $display(" [%0.1f ns] Frame %0d Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",

  161         repeat (10) @(posedge clk_gth);
  162 
  163         // Stream 4 continuous 3117-Byte frames (12,468 Bytes = 3117 words x 32-bit)
  164         for (total_word_idx = 0; total_word_idx < 3117; total_word_idx = total_word_idx + 1) begin
  165             b0_abs = total_word_idx * 4;
  166             b1_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 1;

  168             b3_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 3;

  173                 get_frame_byte((b0_abs / 3117) + 1, (b0_abs % 3117) + 1),
  174                 get_frame_byte((b1_abs / 3117) + 1, (b1_abs % 3117) + 1),

  178         end

  181         gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b0;
  182         gth_rx_data <= 32'd0;

  185         wait(demux_frame_id == 32'd0);
  186         #200;
  187

  190         $display(" -> Official Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) Matches : %0d / 4", preamble_match_cnt);

  102     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-16 (x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1)
  103     function [15:0] step_crc16(input [15:0] q, input [7:0] d);
  104         reg [15:0] nxt;
  105         begin
  106             nxt[0]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12];
  107             nxt[1]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  108             nxt[2]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  109             nxt[3]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  110             nxt[4]  = d[4] ^ q[12];
  111             nxt[5]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[5] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[13];
  112             nxt[6]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ d[6] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13] ^ q[14];
  113             nxt[7]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ d[7] ^ q[10] ^ q[14] ^ q[15];
  114             nxt[8]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[0]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  115             nxt[9]  = d[4] ^ q[1]  ^ q[12];
  116             nxt[10] = d[5] ^ q[2]  ^ q[13];
  117             nxt[11] = d[6] ^ q[3]  ^ q[14];
  118             nxt[12] = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[7] ^ q[4]  ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[15];
  119             nxt[13] = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[5]  ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  120             nxt[14] = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[6]  ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  121             nxt[15] = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[7]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  122             step_crc16 = nxt;
  123         end
  124     endfunction
  125 
  126     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-32 (0x04C11DB7)
  127     function [31:0] step_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
  128         reg [31:0] v;
  129         integer k;
  130         begin
  131             v = c ^ d;
  132             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  133                 if (v[31]) v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
  134                 else       v = (v << 1);
  135             end
  136             step_crc32 = v;
  137         end
  138     endfunction

  143         64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000, 40'd0, 6'd15,
  144         40'd16678204759, 6'd15
