  147     task send_fso_frame(
  148         input [15:0] txfn,
  149         input [1:0]  ftype,
  150         input        corrupt_pld_crc
  151     );
  152         integer idx;
  153         reg [7:0]  hb;
  154         reg [15:0] crc16_acc;
  155         reg [31:0] pw;
  156         reg [31:0] crc32_acc;
  157         begin
  158             crc16_acc = 16'd0;
  159             crc32_acc = 32'd0;
  160 
  161             for (idx = 0; idx < 478; idx = idx + 1) begin
  162                 // 1. 16-Byte Header on Cycles 0..15
  163                 if (idx < 14) begin
  164                     case (idx)
  165                         0:  hb = txfn[7:0];
  166                         1:  hb = txfn[15:8];
  167                         2:  hb = 8'h01;
  168                         3:  hb = 8'h00;
  169                         4:  hb = {4'b1111, 1'b1, 1'b1, ftype};
  170                         10: hb = {2'b11, 6'd15};
  171                         11: hb = {1'b1, 3'b000, 4'hA};
  172                         12: hb = 8'h01;
  173                         13: hb = 8'hF0;
  174                         default: hb = 8'h55;
  175                     endcase
  176                     crc16_acc = step_crc16(crc16_acc, hb);
  177                 end else if (idx == 14) begin
  178                     hb = crc16_acc[15:8];
  179                 end else if (idx == 15) begin
  180                     hb = crc16_acc[7:0];
  181                 end else begin
  182                     hb = 8'd0;
  183                 end
  184 
  185                 // 2. 478-Word Payload (477 Data Words + 478th Word CRC-32)
  186                 if (idx < 477) begin
  187                     if (ftype == 2'b10) begin
  188                         // MGMT Frame (Table 2-14 LSB-first)
  189                         if (idx < 8) pw = mgmt_lsb_vec[(idx * 32) +: 32];
  190                         else         pw = 32'd0;
  191                     end else if (ftype == 2'b00) begin
  192                         // IDLE Frame
  193                         pw = 32'h1D1E_0000 + idx[31:0];
  194                     end else begin
  195                         // DATA Frame (Table 2-18)
  196                         if      (idx == 0) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAB00_4064 : 32'hAB00_0000;
  197                         else if (idx == 1) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAAAA_0001 : 32'hCDEF_07D0;
  198                         else               pw = {txfn, idx[15:0]};
  199                     end
  200                     crc32_acc = step_crc32(crc32_acc, pw);
  201                 end else begin
  202                     pw = corrupt_pld_crc ? (crc32_acc ^ 32'hDEAD_DEAD) : crc32_acc;
  203                 end
  204 
  205                 @(posedge clk);
  206                 s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= (idx < 16);
  207                 s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= (idx < 16) ? hb : 8'd0;
  208                 s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  209                 s_axis_fso_tdata  <= pw;
  210             end
  211 
  212             @(posedge clk);
  213             s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  214             s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= 8'd0;
  215             s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  216             s_axis_fso_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  217             repeat (25) @(posedge clk);
  218         end
  219     endtask

  222     always @(posedge clk) begin

  126     always #1.6 clk_312_5 = ~clk_312_5;

  132     always #3.103 gt_refclk_p = ~gt_refclk_p;
  133 
  134     // Standardized 4-Frame Byte Generator (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)
  135     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
  136         begin
  137             case (b_idx)
  138                 12'd1:   get_frame_byte = 8'h77; // Official SDA OISL Preamble MSB
  139                 12'd2:   get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
  140                 12'd3:   get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
  141                 12'd4:   get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
  142                 12'd5:   get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
  143                 12'd6:   get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
  144                 12'd7:   get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
  145                 12'd8:   get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
  146                 12'd9:   get_frame_byte = 8'h26; // Official SDA OISL Preamble LSB
  147                 12'd10:  get_frame_byte = 8'hAB; // FSO Payload Header
  148                 12'd13:  get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
  149                 12'd3117:get_frame_byte = 8'h33; // Frame Boundary Tail Byte
  150                 default: begin
  151                     if      (f_idx <= 32'd2) get_frame_byte = 8'hDA; // DAT1 / DAT2
  152                     else if (f_idx == 32'd3) get_frame_byte = 8'h1D; // IDLE
  153                     else                     get_frame_byte = 8'hA1; // MGMT
  154                 end
  155             endcase
  156         end
  157     endfunction
  158 
  159     // Standardized Counters for TX Input & RX Output
  160     reg  [31:0] in_frame_id;
  161     reg  [31:0] in_frame_type_str;
  162     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;
  163     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;

  174             32'd2:   in_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  175             32'd3:   in_frame_type_str = "IDLE";

  183             32'd4:   out_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  184             default: out_frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  185         endcase
  186     end

  188     // --- SKENARIO PENGUJIAN ---
  189     integer i, b0, b1, b2, b3;
  190     integer rx_word_cnt = 0;
  191 
  192     always @(posedge clk_312_5) begin
  193         if (fso_rx_valid) begin
  194             if (rx_word_cnt == 0)
  195                 $display("Waktu %0t: Kata Pertama Diterima di RX = 0x%08X (Expected: 0x77AD5B58)", $time, fso_rx_data);
  196             rx_word_cnt <= rx_word_cnt + 1;
  197         end
  198     end

  200     initial begin
  201         // Kondisi Awal (Mati)
  202         clk_312_5   = 0;

  205         sys_rst_n   = 0;
  206         fso_tx_data = 32'd0;
  207         fso_tx_en   = 0;
  208         in_frame_id = 32'd0;
  209         in_clk_cnt  = 16'd0;
  210         in_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  211 
  212         // Nyalakan Power (Reset Dilepas)
  213         #100;
  214         sys_rst_n = 1;
  215         $display("Waktu %0t: Power On, menunggu GTH PLL Lock...", $time);
  216 
  217         // CATATAN PENTING: Model GTH butuh waktu lama untuk Lock di simulasi!
  218         // Kita harus menunggu sampai gth_link_up dan rx_block_locked bernilai 1.
  219         wait(gth_link_up == 1'b1);
  220         $display("Waktu %0t: GTH Link Up! Menunggu 64B/66B Gearbox Block Lock...", $time);
  221         wait(rx_block_locked == 1'b1);
  222         $display("Waktu %0t: 64B/66B Gearbox Locked! Memulai transmisi 4 Frame (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)...", $time);
  223         
  224         // Jeda stabilitas setelah Lock
  225         #500;
  226 
  227         // --- MENGIRIM 4 FSO FRAME KONTINU (3117 Kata = 12,468 Byte: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT) ---
  228         for (i = 0; i < 3117; i = i + 1) begin
  229             b0 = i * 4;
  230             b1 = i * 4 + 1;
  231             b2 = i * 4 + 2;
  232             b3 = i * 4 + 3;
  233 
  234             @(posedge clk_312_5);
  235             fso_tx_en   <= 1'b1;
  236             fso_tx_data <= {
  237                 get_frame_byte((b0 / 3117) + 1, (b0 % 3117) + 1),
  238                 get_frame_byte((b1 / 3117) + 1, (b1 % 3117) + 1),
  239                 get_frame_byte((b2 / 3117) + 1, (b2 % 3117) + 1),
  240                 get_frame_byte((b3 / 3117) + 1, (b3 % 3117) + 1)
  241             };
  242             in_frame_id <= (b0 / 3117) + 1;
  243             in_clk_cnt  <= ((b0 % 3117) / 4) + 1;
  244             in_byte_cnt <= (b3 % 3117) + 1;
  245         end
  246 
  247         // Selesai Kirim, kembali ke Idle
  248         @(posedge clk_312_5);
  249         fso_tx_en   <= 1'b0;
  250         fso_tx_data <= 32'd0;
  251         in_frame_id <= 32'd0;
  252         in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  253         in_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  254 
  255         // Tunggu seluruh 3117 kata (12,468 Byte) keluar dari RX
  256         wait(rx_word_cnt == 3117);
  257         #500;
  258         $display("Waktu %0t: Simulasi Selesai. Total Kata Diterima di RX = %0d / 3117 (12,468 Byte).", $time, rx_word_cnt);
  259         $finish;
  260     end

  149     task fire_one_header(
  150         input [3:0]  f_id,
  151         input [1:0]  scen_id,
  152         input [15:0] txfn,
  153         input [15:0] rxfn,
  154         input        ack,
  155         input        ack_val,
  156         input [1:0]  ftype,
  157         input [3:0]  fcch_op,
  158         input [15:0] fcch_payload
  159     );
  160         begin
  161             frame_id       = f_id;
  162             scenario_id    = scen_id;
  163             txfn_in        = txfn;
  164             rxfn_in        = rxfn;
  165             ack_in         = ack;
  166             ack_valid_in   = ack_val;
  167             frame_type_in  = ftype;
  168             fcch_opcode_in = fcch_op;
  169             fcch_pl_in     = fcch_payload;
  170             // Fire the FSM
  171             @(posedge clk); trigger_header_gen = 1'b1;
  172             @(posedge clk); trigger_header_gen = 1'b0;
  173             // Wait until all 16 bytes are streamed out
  174             wait(byte_tracker == 5'd16);
  175             wait(!final_header_valid);
  176             repeat (6) @(posedge clk);
  177         end
  178     endtask

    6 Description  : Testbench for fso_payload.v (Data Path Sub-Top Module).

  206                     in_byte_cnt <= 16'd4;
  207                 end else begin

  209                     in_byte_cnt <= in_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  210                 end
  211             end else if (!seg_tvalid) begin

  213                 in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  214             end
  215 
  216             if (fifo_data_tvalid && fifo_data_tready) begin

  232             end else begin

  234             end

  239                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd0)   f1_pld_hdr <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  240                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   f1_pkt_hdr <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  241                     if (u_fso_payload.crc_tlast)      f1_crc32   <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  242                 end else if (rx_frame_idx == 2'd1) begin
  243                     frame2_word_cnt <= frame2_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  244                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd0)   f2_pld_hdr    <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  245                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   f2_word1_data <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  246                     if (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd25)  f2_word25_fcs <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  247                     if (u_fso_payload.crc_tlast)      f2_crc32      <= u_fso_payload.crc_tdata;
  248                 end
  249

  260                 retx_word_cnt <= retx_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  261                 if (retx_data_tlast) begin
  262                     retx_last_word_crc32 <= retx_data_tdata;
  263                 end
  264             end
  265         end
  266     end

  300         $display("       -> Word 0 (FSO Payload Hdr) : 0x%08X (Expected: 0xAB004064, seq=1, Cont_Len=100B)", f2_pld_hdr);

  302         $display("       -> Word 25 (100th B Eth FCS): 0x%08X (Expected: 0xDEADBEEF)", f2_word25_fcs);
  303         $display("       -> Word 477 (FSO CRC-32)    : 0x%08X", f2_crc32);
  304         
  305         @(posedge clk);

  313         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);

  315                  $time, retx_word_cnt, retx_word_cnt * 4, retx_last_word_crc32);
  316         if ((frame1_word_cnt == 16'd478) && (frame2_word_cnt == 16'd478) &&
  317             (retx_word_cnt == 16'd478) && (retx_last_word_crc32 == f1_crc32) &&
  318             (f1_pkt_hdr == 32'hCDEF_07D0) && (f2_pld_hdr == 32'hAB00_4064) &&
  319             (f2_word25_fcs == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))

  192                         5:  tx_hdr_in <= (f == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (f == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD;

  194                         16: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h28;   // d15: CRC-16 LSB

  200                 end

  216         end

  219         wait(pld_ok_cnt + pld_err_cnt == 956);

  224         $display(" -> RS(32,16) Header Bytes Recovered   : %0d / 64  (Errors: %0d)", hdr_ok_cnt, hdr_err_cnt);
  225         $display(" -> 8xRS(255,239) Payload Words Recov. : %0d / 956 (Errors: %0d)", pld_ok_cnt, pld_err_cnt);

  227         $display(" -> Total Repaired Payload Symbols     : %0d", total_repaired_pld_bytes);
  228         if (hdr_ok_cnt == 64 && hdr_err_cnt == 0 && pld_ok_cnt == 956 && pld_err_cnt == 0)
  229             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 2 & ITEM 3!");

  110         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth; // 312.5 MHz
  111     end
  112 
  113     initial begin
  114         clk_logic = 1'b0;
  115         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
  116     end
  117 
  118     // Sequential Tracker Logic for Outputs
  119     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  120         if (!rst_n) begin
  121             out_header_cnt_reg     <= 5'd0;
  122             out_payload_cnt_reg    <= 8'd0;
  123             verified_header_bytes  <= 0;
  124             verified_payload_words <= 0;
  125             hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  126             pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  127         end else begin
  128             // Track Header (16 Bytes: d0..d15)
  129             if (header_dv) begin
  130                 out_header_cnt_reg    <= out_header_cnt_reg + 1'b1;
  131                 verified_header_bytes <= verified_header_bytes + 1;
  132                 if ((out_header_Byte_idx == 5'd16) && (header_out == 8'hC2))
  133                     hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt <= hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt + 1;
  134             end else begin
  135                 out_header_cnt_reg    <= 5'd0;
  136             end
  137 
  138             // Track Payload (239 Words @ 64-bit = 1912 Bytes)
  139             if (payload_dv) begin
  140                 out_payload_cnt_reg    <= out_payload_cnt_reg + 1'b1;
  141                 verified_payload_words <= verified_payload_words + 1;
  142                 if ((out_payload_word_idx == 8'd239) && (payload_out[31:0] == 32'hC3C3_C3C3))
  143                     pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt <= pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt + 1;
  144             end else begin
  145                 out_payload_cnt_reg    <= 8'd0;
  146             end
  147         end
  148     end
  149 
  150     // =======================================================
  151     // 6. MAIN SCENARIO: TWO-PROCESS FSM ARCHITECTURE
  152     // =======================================================
  153     localparam ST_INIT   = 2'd0;
  154     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd1;
  155     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
  156     reg [1:0] tb_state;
  157 
  158     // --- PROCESS 1: SEQUENTIAL LOGIC (Index & State Management) ---
  159     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  160         if (!rst_n) begin
  161             tb_state           <= ST_INIT;
  162             current_frame_id   <= 4'd1;
  163             header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  164             payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  165         end else begin
  166             case (tb_state)
  167                 ST_INIT: begin
  168                     // Wait for CDC FIFOs to assert ready before transmitting
  169                     if (cdc_ready) begin
  170                         tb_state           <= ST_STREAM;
  171                         header_byte_index  <= 5'd1;
  172                         payload_word_index <= 16'd1;
  173                     end
  174                 end
  175 
  176                 ST_STREAM: begin
  177                     // Backpressure Check: Freeze counters if CDC is not ready
  178                     if (cdc_ready) begin
  179                         
  180                         // 1. Advance Payload Index (Max 478 Words)
  181                         if (payload_word_index < 478) begin
  182                             payload_word_index <= payload_word_index + 1'b1;
  183                         end else begin
  184                             // End of Frame Reached
  185                             if (current_frame_id < 4) begin
  186                                 // Zero-Gap Transition to next frame
  187                                 current_frame_id   <= current_frame_id + 1'b1;
  188                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd1;
  189                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd1;
  190                             end else begin
  191                                 // All 4 frames transmitted
  192                                 tb_state           <= ST_DONE;
  193                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  194                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  195                             end
  196                         end
  197 
  198                         // 2. Advance Header Index (Max 16 Bytes)
  199                         if (header_byte_index >= 1 && header_byte_index < 16) begin
  200                             header_byte_index <= header_byte_index + 1'b1;
  201                         end else if (header_byte_index == 16) begin
  202                             // Park index to 0 after 16 bytes are sent
  203                             header_byte_index <= 5'd0; 
  204                         end
  205                     end
  206                 end
  207 
  208                 ST_DONE: begin
  209                     // Keep indices parked
  210                     header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  211                     payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  212                 end
  213             endcase
  214         end
  215     end
  216 
  217     // --- PROCESS 2: COMBINATIONAL LOGIC (Data Injection) ---
  218     always @(*) begin
  219         // Default Assignments (Prevents Latches)
  220         en_head            = 1'b0;
  221         header_in          = 8'd0;
  222         en_load            = 1'b0;
  223         payload_in         = 32'd0;
  224         mux_frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  225 
  226         if (tb_state == ST_STREAM) begin
  227             
  228             // Apply combinational Backpressure to signals
  229             if (cdc_ready) begin
  230                 
  231                 // --- MUX IDENTIFIER FOR WAVEFORM ---
  232                 if      (current_frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1"; 
  233                 else if (current_frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2"; 
  234                 else if (current_frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE"; 
  235                 else                            mux_frame_type_str = "MGMT"; 
  236 
  237                 // --- HEADER DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 16 per Table 2-10) ---
  238                 if (header_byte_index >= 1 && header_byte_index <= 16) begin
  239                     en_head = 1'b1;
  240                     case (header_byte_index)
  241                         5'd1:  header_in = {4'd0, current_frame_id};    // d0: TXFN[7:0] (LSB)
  242                         5'd2:  header_in = 8'h00;                       // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  243                         5'd15: header_in = 8'hC1;                       // d14: CRC-16 MSB
  244                         5'd16: header_in = 8'hC2;                       // d15: CRC-16 LSB
  245                         default: header_in = 8'hAA;                     // Dummy PNT/Config
  246                     endcase
  247                 end
  248 
  249                 // --- PAYLOAD DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 478) ---
  250                 if (payload_word_index >= 1 && payload_word_index <= 478) begin
  251                     en_load = 1'b1;
  252                     case (payload_word_index)
  253                         16'd1:   payload_in = 32'hAB00_0000; // FSO Payload Header (Table 2-18)
  254                         16'd2:   payload_in = 32'hCDEF_07D0; // FSO Packet Header (Len = 2000B)
  255                         16'd478: payload_in = 32'hC3C3_C3C3; // FSO CRC-32 Tail
  256                         default: begin
  257                             // Main Data Body Patterns
  258                             if (current_frame_id == 1 || current_frame_id == 2) 
  259                                 payload_in = 32'hDA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  260                             else if (current_frame_id == 3)             
  261                                 payload_in = 32'h1D1E_1D1E; // IDLE Pattern
  262                             else                                
  263                                 payload_in = 32'hA1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  264                         end
  265                     endcase
  266                 end
  267             end // End if (cdc_ready)
  268             else begin
  269                 // If CDC asserts Backpressure, freeze data (TREADY=0 behavior)
  270                 mux_frame_type_str = "HOLD";
  271             end
  272         end 
  273         else if (tb_state == ST_DONE) begin
  274             mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  275         end
  276     end
  277 
  278     // =======================================================
  279     // 7. EVALUATION & VERIFICATION REPORT
  280     // =======================================================
  281     initial begin
  282         rst_n = 1'b0;
  283         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
  284 
  285         // Wait for FSM to complete injection
  286         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  287         
  288         // Provide sufficient time for the slower 200 MHz domain to drain FIFOs
  289         #15000;
  290 
  291         $display("\n=======================================================");
  292         $display(" CDC 1 (x_gth_logic) PRECISION REPORT (TARGET B2 FIX)");
  293         $display("=======================================================");
  294         
  295         $display(" 1. HEADER DOMAIN CROSSING (8-bit -> 8-bit, Latency +2)");
  296         $display("    Expected : 64 Bytes   (4 Frames x 16 Bytes)");
  297         $display("    Captured : %0d Bytes  (CRC-16 Tail 0xC2 Intact: %0d / 4)", verified_header_bytes, hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt);
  298         if (verified_header_bytes == 64 && hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt == 4) $display("    Result   : [PASS]");
  299         else $display("    Result   : [FAIL]");
  300 
  301         $display("\n 2. PAYLOAD ASYMMETRIC CROSSING (32-bit -> 64-bit, Latency +2)");
  302         $display("    Expected : 956 Words  (4 Frames x 239 Words @ 64-bit)");
  303         $display("    Captured : %0d Words  (CRC-32 Tail 0xC3C3C3C3 Intact: %0d / 4)", verified_payload_words, pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt);
  304         if (verified_payload_words == 956 && pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt == 4) $display("    Result   : [PASS]");
  305         else $display("    Result   : [FAIL]");
  306         $display("=======================================================\n");
  307 
  308         $finish;
  309     end
  310 
  311 endmodule

  100                         count <= 0;

   81                         end
   82                     end else begin
   83                         // End of Packet: Inject XGMII Terminate /T/ (0xFD) in Lane 0 + 3 Idles
   84                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_07FD;
   85                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   86                         state     <= IPG_WAIT;
   87                         count     <= 16'd0;
   88                     end
   89                 end
   90 
   91                 IPG_WAIT: begin
   92                     // Enforce minimum 12-Byte (3-cycle) Inter-Packet Gap (IPG)
   93                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   94                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   95                     if (count == 16'd2) begin
   96                         state <= IDLE;
   97                         count <= 16'd0;
   98                     end else begin
   99                         count <= count + 16'd1;
  100                     end
  101                 end
  102 
  103                 default: state <= IDLE;
  104             endcase
  105         end
  106     end
  107 
  108 endmodule
Lampiran D — testbench, script dan paket reproduksi
SatuZIP berisi source asli, manifest, diff, script, model dan log. Source asli tidak diubah. Baca README_REPRODUCE.md. Simulator binary tidak dibundel.
Unduh evidence ZIP (1,414,851 byte)README_REPRODUCE.md# Reproduksi audit Rev2.9 18:47

Source asli dalam source/ diverifikasi SHA-256 sebelum runner berjalan. Icarus12.0, Python3. Tidak memerlukan Vivado untuk curated unit tests; full vendor simulation tidak disediakan.

```
python3 reproduce_1847.py
python3 reproduce_1847.py arq_delete_two_acks
python3 reproduce_1847.py --all
```

Default menjalankan8kasus pembeda. --all mencakup LPCexhaustive/RSextended yang lebih lama. PATH harus berisi iverilog dan vvp. Instalasi relocatable dapat memakai environment IVERILOG,VVP,IVL_BASE. Tes dieksekusi dengan cwd evidence root agar file.mem tersedia.

MATCH berarti observasi laporan terulang, termasuk counterexample FAIL. Lihat recorded_rtl_status dan source_variant dalam rerun/results.json. Jangan menganggap MATCH sebagai RTL PASS.

ORIGINAL_PARSER_ONLY dan ORIGINAL_CDC_LOCAL memakai -i untuk mengabaikan child hierarchy yang tidak diuji. Tidak membuktikan integrasi. DIAGNOSTIC memakai file diagnostic/ dan patch terlampir; source/ tidak diubah. Syntax diagnostic menghapus part-select function result pada assignment32bit. RX diagnostic hanya mengganti tiga nama output dan menghapus ready port yang tidak ada. Itu belum perbaikan pipeline stall.

tests.json adalah katalog terkurasi, bukan seluruh eksperimen. Log dan script lain dipertahankan sebagai riwayat: beberapa memakai path absolut dari lingkungan auditor, oracle lama, reset kurang tepat, timeout pendek, atau filelist all-RTL yang blockedsyntax. Perhatikan Bab7 laporan sebelum mengutipnya. Gunakan reproduce_1847.py untuk pertukaran antar-akun.

Oracle trace TX dan IDLE disimpan pada current_tx_oracle.json serta *_oracle.json; script closure_checks.py/final_regression.py menjelaskan perhitungan. RS independent GF model dibangkitkan oleh rs_extended.py dengan seed301037+k; mem dan testcase list disertakan. BRAM audit memakai readlatency2cycle, bukan vendor IP. Tidak ada executable simulator dibundel.

findings.json dan tracking.json mempertahankan B01-B24 serta IDsbaru C-A001..006. Bandingkan hashZIP,sourcevariant,clock,parameter,defines,models,reset danseed sebelum menyatukan dua audit. Sourcehashberbeda berarti baselinebaru.

Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v

               - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
                 1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
                 2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
                    (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
                    0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
                    Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
                 3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
                    1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
                    (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).

module audit();
    reg clk;
    reg rst_n;
    reg [31:0] data_in;
    reg        en;
    
    wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
    wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
    wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;

    // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
    reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
    wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
    wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
    wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd4) : 16'd0; // 4..2012

    eth_tx_back_end_top #(
        .RUN_MODE (1)
    ) uut (
        .clk       (clk),
        .rst_n     (rst_n),
        .data_in   (data_in),
        .en        (en),
        .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd),
        .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc),
        .refclk_p  (1'b0),
        .refclk_n  (1'b1),
        .reset     (~rst_n),
        .dclk      (clk),
        .txp       (txp_unused),
        .txn       (txn_unused)
    );

    always #1.6 clk = ~clk; // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)

    integer i;

    initial begin
        clk         = 0;
        rst_n       = 0;
        data_in     = 32'd0;
        en          = 0;
        in_word_cnt = 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
        
        #20;
        rst_n = 1;
        repeat (10) @(posedge clk);

        // Simulation of input from ethernet_frame_reassembly (Exact 2008 Byte = 502 cycles:
        // 8 Byte Preamble + 2000 Byte Ethernet Jumbo Package)
        for (i = 0; i < 502; i = i + 1) begin
            @(posedge clk);
            en          <= 1'b1;
            in_word_cnt <= i[15:0] + 16'd1;
            in_byte_cnt <= (i[15:0] + 16'd1) * 16'd4;

            case (i)
                0:   data_in <= 32'h5555_5555; // Preamble Word 1 (Bytes 1..4)
                1:   data_in <= 32'h5555_55D5; // Preamble + SFD Word 2 (Bytes 5..8)
                2:   data_in <= 32'hDA01_0203; // Dest MAC [47:16]
                3:   data_in <= 32'h0405_5A01; // Dest MAC [15:0] + Src MAC [47:32]
                4:   data_in <= 32'h0203_0405; // Src MAC [31:0]
                5:   data_in <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4 (0x0800)
                11:  data_in <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // ASCII "Kook"
                12:  data_in <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // ASCII "min "
                13:  data_in <= 32'h4653_4F20; // ASCII "FSO "
                501: data_in <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // 502nd Word (Byte 2008): Ethernet FCS
                default: data_in <= 32'hA0A0_B0B0 + i;
            endcase
        end

        // stop send
        @(posedge clk);
        data_in     <= 32'd0;
        en          <= 1'b0;
        in_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;

        #100;
        $display("AUDIT_PACKET_COUNTER %0d",uut.dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt);$finish;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
        else if (xgmii_active)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1;
        else
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
    end

  q=2;crc=0;bad=0;crc_bad=0;lastbad=0

/*
===========================================================================
Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v
               (eth_mac_packing_tx + xgmii_tx_formatter) at 312.5 MHz.

               Revision History:
               - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic stimulus testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.
               - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
                 1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
                 2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
                    (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
                    0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
                    Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
                 3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
                    1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
                    (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).
===========================================================================
*/

module audit();
    reg clk;
    reg rst_n;
    reg [31:0] data_in;
    reg        en;
    
    wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
    wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
    wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;

    // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
    reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
    wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
    wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
    wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd4) : 16'd0; // 4..2012

    eth_tx_back_end_top #(
        .RUN_MODE (1)
    ) uut (
        .clk       (clk),
        .rst_n     (rst_n),
        .data_in   (data_in),
        .en        (en),
        .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd),
        .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc),
        .refclk_p  (1'b0),
        .refclk_n  (1'b1),
        .reset     (~rst_n),
        .dclk      (clk),
        .txp       (txp_unused),
        .txn       (txn_unused)
    );

    always #1.6 clk = ~clk; // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)

    integer i;

    initial begin
        clk         = 0;
        rst_n       = 0;
        data_in     = 32'd0;
        en          = 0;
        in_word_cnt = 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
        
        #20;
        rst_n = 1;
        repeat (10) @(posedge clk);

        // Simulation of input from ethernet_frame_reassembly (Exact 2008 Byte = 502 cycles:
        // 8 Byte Preamble + 2000 Byte Ethernet Jumbo Package)
        for (i = 0; i < 502; i = i + 1) begin
            @(posedge clk);
            en          <= 1'b1;
            in_word_cnt <= i[15:0] + 16'd1;
            in_byte_cnt <= (i[15:0] + 16'd1) * 16'd4;

            case (i)
                0:   data_in <= 32'h5555_5555; // Preamble Word 1 (Bytes 1..4)
                1:   data_in <= 32'h5555_55D5; // Preamble + SFD Word 2 (Bytes 5..8)
                2:   data_in <= 32'hDA01_0203; // Dest MAC [47:16]
                3:   data_in <= 32'h0405_5A01; // Dest MAC [15:0] + Src MAC [47:32]
                4:   data_in <= 32'h0203_0405; // Src MAC [31:0]
                5:   data_in <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4 (0x0800)
                11:  data_in <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // ASCII "Kook"
                12:  data_in <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // ASCII "min "
                13:  data_in <= 32'h4653_4F20; // ASCII "FSO "
                501: data_in <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // 502nd Word (Byte 2008): Ethernet FCS
                default: data_in <= 32'hA0A0_B0B0 + i;
            endcase
        end

        // stop send
        @(posedge clk);
        data_in     <= 32'd0;
        en          <= 1'b0;
        in_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;

        #100;
        $display("AUDIT_PACKET_COUNTER %0d",uut.dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt);$finish;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
        else if (xgmii_active)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1;
        else
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
    end

endmodulediag_demux_reorder_backpressure.sv`timescale 1ns/1ps

/*
===========================================================================
Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v
               (eth_mac_packing_tx + xgmii_tx_formatter) at 312.5 MHz.

               Revision History:
               - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic stimulus testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.
               - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
                 1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
                 2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
                    (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
                    0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
                    Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
                 3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
                    1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
                    (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).
===========================================================================
*/

module audit();
    reg clk;
    reg rst_n;
    reg [31:0] data_in;
    reg        en;
    
    wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
    wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
    wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;

    // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
    reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
    wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
    wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
    wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd4) : 16'd0; // 4..2012

    eth_tx_back_end_top #(
        .RUN_MODE (1)
    ) uut (
        .clk       (clk),
        .rst_n     (rst_n),
        .data_in   (data_in),
        .en        (en),
        .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd),
        .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc),
        .refclk_p  (1'b0),
        .refclk_n  (1'b1),
        .reset     (~rst_n),
        .dclk      (clk),
        .txp       (txp_unused),
        .txn       (txn_unused)
    );

    always #1.6 clk = ~clk; // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)

    integer i;

    initial begin
        clk         = 0;
        rst_n       = 0;
        data_in     = 32'd0;
        en          = 0;
        in_word_cnt = 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
        
        #20;
        rst_n = 1;
        repeat (10) @(posedge clk);

        // Simulation of input from ethernet_frame_reassembly (Exact 2008 Byte = 502 cycles:
        // 8 Byte Preamble + 2000 Byte Ethernet Jumbo Package)
        for (i = 0; i < 502; i = i + 1) begin
            @(posedge clk);
            en          <= 1'b1;
            in_word_cnt <= i[15:0] + 16'd1;
            in_byte_cnt <= (i[15:0] + 16'd1) * 16'd4;

            case (i)
                0:   data_in <= 32'h5555_5555; // Preamble Word 1 (Bytes 1..4)
                1:   data_in <= 32'h5555_55D5; // Preamble + SFD Word 2 (Bytes 5..8)
                2:   data_in <= 32'hDA01_0203; // Dest MAC [47:16]
                3:   data_in <= 32'h0405_5A01; // Dest MAC [15:0] + Src MAC [47:32]
                4:   data_in <= 32'h0203_0405; // Src MAC [31:0]
                5:   data_in <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4 (0x0800)
                11:  data_in <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // ASCII "Kook"
                12:  data_in <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // ASCII "min "
                13:  data_in <= 32'h4653_4F20; // ASCII "FSO "
                501: data_in <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // 502nd Word (Byte 2008): Ethernet FCS
                default: data_in <= 32'hA0A0_B0B0 + i;
            endcase
        end

        // stop send
        @(posedge clk);
        data_in     <= 32'd0;
        en          <= 1'b0;
        in_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
        in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;

        #100;
        $display("AUDIT_COUNTER packet=%0d last_MAC_bytes=%0d expected2000",uut.dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt,uut.last_eth_data_byte_cnt);$finish;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
        else if (xgmii_active)
            raw_xgmii_idx <= raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1;
        else
            raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
    end

endmoduleoriginal_backend_counter.sv`timescale 1ns / 1ps

def mul(a,b):
 c=0
 for _ in range(8):
  if b&1:c^=a
  a=((a<<1)^(0x187 if a&128 else 0))&255;b>>=1
 return c

/*
===========================================================================
Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
Module Name  : tb_rs_decoder_rx
Description  : End-to-End Verification Testbench for Receiver Reed-Solomon 
               Decoders:
               - rs_decoder #(33) : Shortened RS(32,16) Header Decoder 
                 (32 Bytes in -> 16 corrected Header Bytes out).
               - rs_decoder_64    : 8-Lane Parallel RS(255,239) Payload Decoder 
                 (255 Words / 2040 Bytes in -> 239 Words / 1912 Bytes out).

               KEY VERIFICATION OBJECTIVES:
               1. Encodes 4 frames using Golden Reference rs_encoder #(31) 
                  and rs_encoder_64 #(254) over GF(2^8) primitive polynomial 
                  F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187) and generator roots 
                  alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 (SDA OISL Page 37).
               2. Injects symbol errors into both the 32-Byte Header (up to 
                  4 symbol errors) and all 8 lanes of the 2040-Byte Payload 
                  (up to 8 symbol errors per codeword = 64 corrupted bytes/frame).
               3. Verifies 100% error correction and exact recovery of all 
                  16 Header bytes and 1912 Payload bytes per frame.

Revision History:
  - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : RS(32,16) Header & 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder TB.
  - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & Item 3 Verification]
    Verified unified GF(2^8) 0x187 lookup tables (decimal_value.mem & 
    alpha_value.mem) and generator roots alpha^(11*j) (j = 120..135) across 
    TX rs_encoder and RX syndrome_unit, euclid_proc, chien_search, and 
    forney_math with multi-symbol error injection and Table 2-18 headers.
  - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:30 KST) : [Audit Fix A10 - Explicit 64-Bit Integer Zero-Extension]
    Replaced out-of-range 32-bit integer part-select 'f[63:0]' on word 239 with 
    explicitly zero-extended '{32'd0, f[31:0]}' so simulators such as Icarus Verilog 
    never inject 32 upper 'X' bits into the reference stimulus, and added strict 
    $fatal assertion on any header/payload mismatch.
===========================================================================
*/

module audit();

    reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock (5.0 ns)
    reg rst_n;

    // Golden Reference TX Inputs
    reg         tx_hdr_en;
    reg  [7:0]  tx_hdr_in;
    reg         tx_pld_en;
    reg  [63:0] tx_pld_in;

    // Golden Reference TX RS Encoder Outputs
    wire        enc_hdr_dv;
    wire [7:0]  enc_hdr_out;
    wire        enc_pld_dv;
    wire [63:0] enc_pld_out;

    // Symbol Error Injection (Up to E = 8 symbol errors per codeword)
    reg  [5:0]  hdr_sym_idx;
    reg  [8:0]  pld_sym_idx;
    wire [7:0]  hdr_err_mask = (enc_hdr_dv && (hdr_sym_idx >= 6'd3 && hdr_sym_idx <= 6'd6)) ?
                               8'hA5 : 8'h00; // 4 symbol errors in RS(32,16) Header
    wire [63:0] pld_err_mask = (enc_pld_dv && (pld_sym_idx >= 9'd10 && pld_sym_idx <= 9'd17)) ?
                               64'hE175_0023_4600_8792 : 64'd0; // 8 symbol errors per RS(255,239) codeword

    wire [7:0]  noisy_hdr_in = enc_hdr_out ^ hdr_err_mask;
    wire [63:0] noisy_pld_in = enc_pld_out ^ pld_err_mask;

    // Receiver DUT Outputs
    wire        dec_hdr_dv;
    wire [7:0]  dec_hdr_out;
    wire        dec_pld_dv;
    wire [63:0] dec_pld_out;

    // Hierarchical Probes
    wire [11:0] repaired_hdr_bytes       = u_dut_rs_hdr_dec.repaired_symbol_cnt;
    wire [11:0] total_repaired_pld_bytes = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.total_repaired_pld_bytes;
    wire [31:0] fso_payload_header       = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_payload_header;
    wire [31:0] fso_packet_header        = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_packet_header;
    wire [31:0] fso_crc32_out            = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_crc32_out;
    wire [7:0]  pld_byte_stream          = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.pld_byte_stream;
    wire [11:0] pld_byte_cnt             = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.pld_byte_cnt;
    wire [31:0] rs_frame_id              = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.rs_frame_id;

    // 1. Golden Reference TX Encoders (GF 0x187, roots j=120..135)
    rs_encoder #(31) u_ref_rs_hdr_enc (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (tx_hdr_en),
        .data_in  (tx_hdr_in),
        .flag     (enc_hdr_dv),
        .data_out (enc_hdr_out)
    );

    rs_encoder_64 #(254) u_ref_rs_pld_enc (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (tx_pld_en),
        .data_in  (tx_pld_in),
        .flag     (enc_pld_dv),
        .data_out (enc_pld_out)
    );

    // 2. Receiver DUT Decoders (GF 0x187, roots j=120..135)
    rs_decoder #(33) u_dut_rs_hdr_dec (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (enc_hdr_dv),
        .data_in  (noisy_hdr_in),
        .flag     (dec_hdr_dv),
        .data_out (dec_hdr_out)
    );

    rs_decoder_64 u_dut_rs_pld_dec (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (enc_pld_dv),
        .data_in  (noisy_pld_in),
        .flag     (dec_pld_dv),
        .data_out (dec_pld_out)
    );

    initial begin
        clk = 1'b0;
        forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            hdr_sym_idx <= 6'd0;
            pld_sym_idx <= 9'd0;
        end else begin
            hdr_sym_idx <= enc_hdr_dv ? (hdr_sym_idx + 6'd1) : 6'd0;
            pld_sym_idx <= enc_pld_dv ? (pld_sym_idx + 9'd1) : 9'd0;
        end
    end

    // Reference FIFOs to Verify Decoded Outputs against Original TX Inputs
    reg [7:0]  exp_hdr_q [0:255];
    reg [63:0] exp_pld_q [0:2047];
    integer    hdr_wr_p = 0, hdr_rd_p = 0;
    integer    pld_wr_p = 0, pld_rd_p = 0;
    integer    hdr_ok_cnt = 0, hdr_err_cnt = 0;
    integer    pld_ok_cnt = 0, pld_err_cnt = 0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst_n) begin
            if (tx_hdr_en) begin
                exp_hdr_q[hdr_wr_p] = tx_hdr_in;
                hdr_wr_p            = hdr_wr_p + 1;
            end
            if (tx_pld_en) begin
                exp_pld_q[pld_wr_p] = tx_pld_in;
                pld_wr_p            = pld_wr_p + 1;
            end
            if (dec_hdr_dv) begin
                if (dec_hdr_out === exp_hdr_q[hdr_rd_p])
                    hdr_ok_cnt = hdr_ok_cnt + 1;
                else
                    hdr_err_cnt = hdr_err_cnt + 1;
                hdr_rd_p = hdr_rd_p + 1;
            end
            if (dec_pld_dv) begin
                if (dec_pld_out === exp_pld_q[pld_rd_p])
                    pld_ok_cnt = pld_ok_cnt + 1;
                else
                    pld_err_cnt = pld_err_cnt + 1;
                pld_rd_p = pld_rd_p + 1;
            end
        end
    end

    integer f, c;
    initial begin
        rst_n     = 1'b0;
        tx_hdr_en = 1'b0;
        tx_hdr_in = 8'd0;
        tx_pld_en = 1'b0;
        tx_pld_in = 64'd0;
        #100;
        rst_n     = 1'b1;
        repeat (5) @(posedge clk);

        for (f = 1; f <= 4; f = f + 1) begin
            // 1. Feed 16 Bytes of Header + 239 Words of Payload
            for (c = 1; c <= 239; c = c + 1) begin
                @(posedge clk);
                if (c <= 16) begin
                    tx_hdr_en <= 1'b1;
                    case (c)
                        1:  tx_hdr_in <= f[7:0];  // d0: TXFN[7:0]
                        2:  tx_hdr_in <= 8'h00;   // d1: TXFN[15:8]
                        5:  tx_hdr_in <= (f == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (f == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD;
                        15: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h0F;   // d14: CRC-16 MSB
                        16: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h28;   // d15: CRC-16 LSB
                        default: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h55 + c[7:0];
                    endcase
                end else begin
                    tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
                    tx_hdr_in <= 8'd0;
                end

                tx_pld_en <= 1'b1;
                // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A10] Use explicit {32'd0, f[31:0]} to prevent out-of-bounds 'X' bits
                if      (c == 1)   tx_pld_in <= (f == 2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
                else if (c == 239) tx_pld_in <= 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {32'd0, f[31:0]};
                else               tx_pld_in <= {32'h4B6F_6F6B, f[15:0], c[15:0]};
            end

            @(posedge clk);
            tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
            tx_pld_en <= 1'b0;
            tx_pld_in <= 64'd0;

            // Wait for RS Decoder BRAM + Euclid + Chien/Forney pipeline before next frame
            repeat (320) @(posedge clk);
        end

        wait(hdr_ok_cnt + hdr_err_cnt == 64);
        wait(pld_ok_cnt + pld_err_cnt == 956);
        #500;

        $display("\n======================================================================");
        $display(" REED-SOLOMON DECODER VERIFICATION REPORT (GF 0x187, ROOTS j=120..135)");
        $display(" -> RS(32,16) Header Bytes Recovered   : %0d / 64  (Errors: %0d)", hdr_ok_cnt, hdr_err_cnt);
        $display(" -> 8xRS(255,239) Payload Words Recov. : %0d / 956 (Errors: %0d)", pld_ok_cnt, pld_err_cnt);
        $display(" -> Total Repaired Header Symbols      : %0d", repaired_hdr_bytes);
        $display(" -> Total Repaired Payload Symbols     : %0d", total_repaired_pld_bytes);
        if (hdr_ok_cnt == 64 && hdr_err_cnt == 0 && pld_ok_cnt == 956 && pld_err_cnt == 0)
            $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 2 & ITEM 3!");
        else
            $fatal(1, " -> RESULT: [FAIL] Reed-Solomon Decoder mismatch detected!");
        $display("======================================================================\n");
        $finish;
    end

endmoduleshipped_rs_tb_defined_width.sv`timescale 1ns / 1ps

    wire [7:0]  pld_byte_stream         = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.pld_byte_stream;

    rs_encoder_64 #(254) u_ref_rs_pld_enc (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (tx_pld_en),
        .data_in  (tx_pld_in),
        .flag     (enc_pld_dv),
        .data_out (enc_pld_out)
    );

    // 2. Receiver DUT Decoders (GF 0x187, roots j=120..135)
    rs_decoder #(33) u_dut_rs_hdr_dec (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (enc_hdr_dv),
        .data_in  (noisy_hdr_in),
        .flag     (dec_hdr_dv),
        .data_out (dec_hdr_out)
    );

    rs_decoder_64 u_dut_rs_pld_dec (
        .clk      (clk),
        .rst_n    (rst_n),
        .en       (enc_pld_dv),
        .data_in  (noisy_pld_in),
        .flag     (dec_pld_dv),
        .data_out (dec_pld_out)
    );

    initial begin
        clk = 1'b0;
        forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
    end

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            hdr_sym_idx <= 6'd0;
            pld_sym_idx <= 9'd0;
        end else begin
            hdr_sym_idx <= enc_hdr_dv ? (hdr_sym_idx + 6'd1) : 6'd0;
            pld_sym_idx <= enc_pld_dv ? (pld_sym_idx + 9'd1) : 9'd0;
        end
    end

    // Reference FIFOs to Verify Decoded Outputs against Original TX Inputs
    reg [7:0]  exp_hdr_q [0:255];
    reg [63:0] exp_pld_q [0:2047];
    integer    hdr_wr_p = 0, hdr_rd_p = 0;
    integer    pld_wr_p = 0, pld_rd_p = 0;
    integer    hdr_ok_cnt = 0, hdr_err_cnt = 0;
    integer    pld_ok_cnt = 0, pld_err_cnt = 0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst_n) begin
            if (tx_hdr_en) begin
                exp_hdr_q[hdr_wr_p] = tx_hdr_in;
                hdr_wr_p            = hdr_wr_p + 1;
            end
            if (tx_pld_en) begin
                exp_pld_q[pld_wr_p] = tx_pld_in;
                pld_wr_p            = pld_wr_p + 1;
            end
            if (dec_hdr_dv) begin
                if (dec_hdr_out == exp_hdr_q[hdr_rd_p])
                    hdr_ok_cnt = hdr_ok_cnt + 1;
                else
                    hdr_err_cnt = hdr_err_cnt + 1;
                hdr_rd_p = hdr_rd_p + 1;
            end
            if (dec_pld_dv) begin
                if (dec_pld_out == exp_pld_q[pld_rd_p])
                    pld_ok_cnt = pld_ok_cnt + 1;
                else
                    pld_err_cnt = pld_err_cnt + 1;
                pld_rd_p = pld_rd_p + 1;
            end
        end
    end

    integer f, c;
    initial begin
        rst_n     = 1'b0;
        tx_hdr_en = 1'b0;
        tx_hdr_in = 8'd0;
        tx_pld_en = 1'b0;
        tx_pld_in = 64'd0;
        #100;
        rst_n     = 1'b1;
        repeat (5) @(posedge clk);

        for (f = 1; f <= 4; f = f + 1) begin
            // 1. Feed 16 Bytes of Header + 239 Words of Payload
            for (c = 1; c <= 239; c = c + 1) begin
                @(posedge clk);
                if (c <= 16) begin
                    tx_hdr_en <= 1'b1;
                    case (c)
                        1:  tx_hdr_in <= f[7:0];  // d0: TXFN[7:0]
                        2:  tx_hdr_in <= 8'h00;   // d1: TXFN[15:8]
                        5:  tx_hdr_in <= (f == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (f == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD;
                        15: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h0F;   // d14: CRC-16 MSB
                        16: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h28;   // d15: CRC-16 LSB
                        default: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h55 + c[7:0];
                    endcase
                end else begin
                    tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
                    tx_hdr_in <= 8'd0;
                end

                tx_pld_en <= 1'b1;
                if      (c == 1)   tx_pld_in <= (f == 2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
                else if (c == 239) tx_pld_in <= 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {32'd0,f[31:0]};
                else               tx_pld_in <= {32'h4B6F_6F6B, f[15:0], c[15:0]};
            end

            @(posedge clk);
            tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
            tx_pld_en <= 1'b0;
            tx_pld_in <= 64'd0;

            // Wait for RS Decoder BRAM + Euclid + Chien/Forney pipeline before next frame
            repeat (320) @(posedge clk);
        end

        wait(hdr_ok_cnt + hdr_err_cnt == 64);
        wait(pld_ok_cnt + pld_err_cnt == 956);
        #500;

        $display("\n======================================================================");
        $display(" REED-SOLOMON DECODER VERIFICATION REPORT (GF 0x187, ROOTS j=120..135)");
        $display(" -> RS(32,16) Header Bytes Recovered   : %0d / 64  (Errors: %0d)", hdr_ok_cnt, hdr_err_cnt);
        $display(" -> 8xRS(255,239) Payload Words Recov. : %0d / 956 (Errors: %0d)", pld_ok_cnt, pld_err_cnt);
        $display(" -> Total Repaired Header Symbols      : %0d", repaired_hdr_bytes);
        $display(" -> Total Repaired Payload Symbols     : %0d", total_repaired_pld_bytes);
        if (hdr_ok_cnt == 64 && hdr_err_cnt == 0 && pld_ok_cnt == 956 && pld_err_cnt == 0)
            $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 2 & ITEM 3!");
        $display("======================================================================\n");
        $finish;
    end
